en_def: to consist of, or to be made up of, particular parts or members
hi_def: से मिलकर बनना, में शामिल होना, संघटित होना
hi_nuance: 'Comprised of' is widely used but considered incorrect in careful formal writing, because 'comprise' already means 'to be made up of'. The precise forms are 'X comprises Y' or 'X is composed of Y', never 'X is comprised of Y'.

examples.en: The security team comprises six analysts and one manager.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा टीम छह विश्लेषकों और एक मैनेजर से मिलकर बनी है।

examples.en: The report comprises five sections, including a risk summary.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट पाँच खंडों से मिलकर बनी है, जिनमें एक जोखिम सारांश भी शामिल है।

examples.en: Our test suite comprises unit tests, integration tests, and load tests.
examples.hi: हमारा टेस्ट सूट यूनिट टेस्ट, इंटीग्रेशन टेस्ट और लोड टेस्ट से मिलकर बना है।

examples.en: The committee comprises representatives from legal, IT, and HR.
examples.hi: समिति कानूनी, आईटी और एचआर विभागों के प्रतिनिधियों से मिलकर बनी है।

examples.en: The database comprises three tables that store user activity.
examples.hi: डेटाबेस तीन टेबलों से मिलकर बना है जो उपयोगकर्ता गतिविधि को संग्रहीत करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: The report is comprised of five sections.
common_mistake.right: The report comprises five sections.
common_mistake.why: 'Comprise' already means 'to be made up of', so adding 'is ... of' is considered redundant in careful formal style; say 'comprises' or 'is composed of'.

cloze.sentence: The security team ____ six analysts and one manager.

en_def: to make sure that a rule, law, or policy is obeyed
hi_def: लागू करवाना, नियम या कानून का सख्ती से पालन करवाना
hi_nuance: Confused with 'force' (जबरदस्ती करना) since they sound similar. 'Enforce' specifically refers to making sure a rule or policy is followed by everyone, as in 'enforce a password policy'.

examples.en: IT must enforce the new password policy across every department.
examples.hi: आईटी को हर विभाग में नई पासवर्ड नीति को सख्ती से लागू करवाना होगा।

examples.en: The firewall enforces rules that block traffic from blacklisted IPs.
examples.hi: फ़ायरवॉल उन नियमों को लागू करता है जो ब्लैकलिस्ट की गई IP से आने वाले ट्रैफ़िक को रोकते हैं।

examples.en: Regulators enforce data protection laws strictly in this industry.
examples.hi: इस उद्योग में नियामक डेटा सुरक्षा कानूनों को सख्ती से लागू करते हैं।

examples.en: The system enforces multi-factor authentication for all admin accounts.
examples.hi: सिस्टम सभी एडमिन खातों के लिए बहु-कारक प्रमाणीकरण को अनिवार्य रूप से लागू करता है।

examples.en: Managers rarely enforced the clean-desk policy before the audit.
examples.hi: ऑडिट से पहले मैनेजर शायद ही कभी क्लीन-डेस्क नीति को सख्ती से लागू करते थे।

common_mistake.wrong: The company forces the password policy on all employees.
common_mistake.right: The company enforces the password policy for all employees.
common_mistake.why: 'Force' means to make someone do something directly and physically; 'enforce' means to make sure a rule is followed, which is the correct word for policies.

cloze.sentence: IT must ____ the new password policy across every department.

en_def: to officially force a rule, tax, punishment, etc. to be obeyed or accepted
hi_def: (नियम, कर, दंड आदि) थोपना, ज़बरदस्ती लागू करना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often confuse with 'propose' (प्रस्ताव रखना). 'Impose' carries a sense of authority forcing something, often used negatively ('impose restrictions').

examples.en: The new policy will impose stricter access controls on all contractors.
examples.hi: नई नीति सभी ठेकेदारों पर सख्त पहुँच नियंत्रण लागू करेगी।

examples.en: The regulator imposed a heavy fine on the company after the breach.
examples.hi: उल्लंघन के बाद नियामक ने कंपनी पर भारी जुर्माना लगाया।

examples.en: Management imposed a strict deadline for fixing the critical bug.
examples.hi: प्रबंधन ने गंभीर बग ठीक करने के लिए सख्त समय-सीमा तय कर दी।

examples.en: The government imposed new rules on how companies store customer data.
examples.hi: सरकार ने कंपनियों द्वारा ग्राहक डेटा संग्रहीत करने के तरीके पर नए नियम लागू कर दिए।

examples.en: We shouldn't impose our coding style on an open-source project we don't own.
examples.hi: जिस ओपन-सोर्स प्रोजेक्ट के मालिक हम नहीं हैं, उस पर हमें अपनी कोडिंग शैली नहीं थोपनी चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: The regulator will propose a fine on the company.
common_mistake.right: The regulator will impose a fine on the company.
common_mistake.why: 'Propose' means to suggest something; 'impose' means to force a rule, fine, or punishment onto someone with authority.

cloze.sentence: The new policy will ____ stricter access controls on all contractors.

en_def: to check that something is true or accurate
hi_nuance: Confused with 'clarify' or 'confirm.' 'Verify' specifically means checking facts/evidence for accuracy, common in security ('verify the signature', 'verify identity').

examples.en: Always verify the sender's email address before clicking a link.
examples.hi: किसी लिंक पर क्लिक करने से पहले हमेशा भेजने वाले का ईमेल पता सत्यापित करें।

examples.en: The system verifies the digital signature before installing any update.
examples.hi: कोई भी अपडेट इंस्टॉल करने से पहले सिस्टम डिजिटल हस्ताक्षर को सत्यापित करता है।

examples.en: Please verify that the backup completed successfully before deleting old files.
examples.hi: पुरानी फ़ाइलें हटाने से पहले कृपया पुष्टि करें कि बैकअप सफलतापूर्वक पूरा हुआ है।

examples.en: Auditors verified the company's compliance records for the past year.
examples.hi: ऑडिटरों ने पिछले साल के लिए कंपनी के अनुपालन रिकॉर्ड सत्यापित किए।

examples.en: We verified the user's identity with a second form of ID.
examples.hi: हमने पहचान के दूसरे प्रमाण से उपयोगकर्ता की पहचान सत्यापित की।

common_mistake.wrong: Please confirm the certificate's checksum matches by looking at it quickly.
common_mistake.right: Please verify that the certificate's checksum matches before installing it.
common_mistake.why: 'Verify' is the precise technical term for checking accuracy against evidence, such as a checksum; 'confirm' is vaguer and used more for agreeing to a statement.

cloze.sentence: Always ____ the sender's email address before clicking a link.

en_def: to officially forbid something, especially by law or rule
hi_def: आधिकारिक रूप से मना करना, प्रतिबंधित करना (कानून या नियम द्वारा)
hi_nuance: Often used with the wrong preposition; the correct pattern is 'prohibit someone FROM doing something', not 'prohibit someone TO do something'. It is more formal than 'not allow'.

examples.en: Company policy prohibits employees from using personal USB drives.
examples.hi: कंपनी की नीति कर्मचारियों को निजी USB ड्राइव इस्तेमाल करने से रोकती है।

examples.en: The new law prohibits companies from selling user data without consent.
examples.hi: नया कानून कंपनियों को सहमति के बिना उपयोगकर्ता डेटा बेचने से रोकता है।

examples.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the server room.
examples.hi: सर्वर रूम के अंदर धूम्रपान सख्ती से प्रतिबंधित है।

examples.en: The contract prohibits the vendor from sharing our source code.
examples.hi: अनुबंध वेंडर को हमारा सोर्स कोड साझा करने से रोकता है।

examples.en: Our security policy prohibits sharing passwords over email.
examples.hi: हमारी सुरक्षा नीति ईमेल पर पासवर्ड साझा करने पर रोक लगाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The policy prohibits employees to bring personal laptops to work.
common_mistake.right: The policy prohibits employees from bringing personal laptops to work.
common_mistake.why: 'Prohibit' takes the pattern 'prohibit someone from doing something', not 'prohibit someone to do something'.

cloze.sentence: Company policy ____ employees from using personal USB drives at work.

en_def: to behave according to accepted rules or standards, or to match an expected type or pattern
hi_def: अनुरूप होना, नियमों या मानकों का पालन करना
hi_nuance: Confused with 'confirm' (पुष्टि करना) due to similar spelling and sound. 'Conform' means to follow a rule or standard, not to verify that something is true.

examples.en: All new software must conform to the company's security standards before deployment.
examples.hi: सभी नए सॉफ़्टवेयर को तैनाती से पहले कंपनी के सुरक्षा मानकों के अनुरूप होना चाहिए।

examples.en: The device failed to conform to industry safety regulations.
examples.hi: यह उपकरण उद्योग सुरक्षा नियमों के अनुरूप नहीं पाया गया।

examples.en: Employees are expected to conform to the dress code during client visits.
examples.hi: ग्राहकों से मिलते समय कर्मचारियों से ड्रेस कोड का पालन करने की उम्मीद की जाती है।

examples.en: The API response did not conform to the expected schema, so the integration broke.
examples.hi: API का जवाब अपेक्षित स्कीमा के अनुरूप नहीं था, इसलिए इंटीग्रेशन टूट गया।

examples.en: Her report conforms closely to the standard incident template.
examples.hi: उसकी रिपोर्ट मानक घटना टेम्प्लेट के काफी अनुरूप है।

common_mistake.wrong: Please confirm to the new dress code before the client meeting.
common_mistake.right: Please conform to the new dress code before the client meeting.
common_mistake.why: 'Confirm' means to verify that something is true; 'conform' means to follow a rule or standard, which is what is intended here.

cloze.sentence: All new software must ____ to the company's security standards before deployment.

en_def: to change the shape, sound, or meaning of something so that it is no longer accurate or normal
hi_def: विकृत करना, तोड़ना-मरोड़ना (आकार, आवाज़ या अर्थ को)
hi_nuance: Often known only from audio or image contexts; in professional writing it also applies to facts or data being twisted or misrepresented, as in 'distort the figures'.

examples.en: The attacker distorted the log timestamps to hide the real order of events.
examples.hi: हमलावर ने घटनाओं के असली क्रम को छिपाने के लिए लॉग टाइमस्टैम्प को विकृत कर दिया।

examples.en: A small sample size can distort the survey's overall results.
examples.hi: छोटा नमूना आकार सर्वेक्षण के समग्र परिणामों को विकृत कर सकता है।

examples.en: The speaker's voice was distorted by the poor microphone during the call.
examples.hi: कॉल के दौरान खराब माइक्रोफ़ोन की वजह से वक्ता की आवाज़ विकृत हो गई थी।

examples.en: Cherry-picking a few data points can distort the true trend.
examples.hi: कुछ चुनिंदा डेटा बिंदुओं को छाँटकर दिखाना असली रुझान को विकृत कर सकता है।

examples.en: Management accused the reporter of distorting the facts about the breach.
examples.hi: प्रबंधन ने रिपोर्टर पर उल्लंघन के तथ्यों को विकृत करने का आरोप लगाया।

common_mistake.wrong: The chart wrongly shows the data much higher than it really is.
common_mistake.right: The chart distorts the data by starting the axis at fifty instead of zero.
common_mistake.why: Use the precise verb 'distort' to describe how data or facts are misleadingly changed, rather than a vague general description.

cloze.sentence: The attacker ____ the log timestamps to hide the real order of events.

en_def: to control or influence someone or something cleverly, unfairly, or dishonestly; also, to handle or operate something skillfully
hi_def: चालाकी से प्रभावित करना या नियंत्रित करना; कुशलता से संचालित करना
hi_nuance: Two senses: a neutral/technical one, 'to handle or work with something' (manipulate data), and a negative one, 'to control someone unfairly' (manipulate a person). Hindi speakers often know only the negative sense.

examples.en: The attacker manipulated the API request to bypass the authorization check.
examples.hi: हमलावर ने प्राधिकरण जाँच को दरकिनार करने के लिए API अनुरोध में हेरफेर किया।

examples.en: Scammers manipulate victims' emotions to make them act quickly without thinking.
examples.hi: ठग पीड़ितों की भावनाओं में हेरफेर करके उन्हें बिना सोचे-समझे जल्दी काम करने पर मजबूर करते हैं।

examples.en: This tool lets analysts manipulate large datasets without writing code.
examples.hi: यह टूल विश्लेषकों को बिना कोड लिखे बड़े डेटासेट को संसाधित करने देता है।

examples.en: The malware manipulated system files to hide its presence from antivirus scans.
examples.hi: मैलवेयर ने एंटीवायरस स्कैन से खुद को छिपाने के लिए सिस्टम फ़ाइलों में हेरफेर किया।

examples.en: He felt manipulated into approving the deal without reading the contract fully.
examples.hi: उसे लगा कि उसे बिना अनुबंध पूरा पढ़े ही सौदे को मंज़ूरी देने के लिए हेरफेर से राज़ी किया गया।

common_mistake.wrong: He manages the numbers in the spreadsheet every day to build the report.
common_mistake.right: He manipulates the numbers in the spreadsheet to build the report.
common_mistake.why: 'Manipulate' is the precise verb for directly handling or altering data; 'manage' refers to overseeing a broader process or team, not handling data itself.

cloze.sentence: The attacker ____ the API request to bypass the authorization check.

en_def: to notice or discover that something is present, especially something not obvious
hi_nuance: Confused with 'find', which is more general; 'detect' specifically implies discovering something hidden or hard to notice, often through careful observation or a monitoring system.

examples.en: The intrusion detection system detected unusual traffic at 2 a.m.
examples.hi: घुसपैठ पहचान प्रणाली ने रात 2 बजे असामान्य ट्रैफ़िक का पता लगाया।

examples.en: Doctors detected the fault early thanks to the new monitoring tool.
examples.hi: नए मॉनिटरिंग टूल की बदौलत डॉक्टरों ने गड़बड़ी का जल्दी पता लगा लिया।

examples.en: Our antivirus failed to detect the new strain of malware.
examples.hi: हमारा एंटीवायरस मैलवेयर की नई किस्म का पता लगाने में असफल रहा।

examples.en: The audit detected several accounts that had never changed their password.
examples.hi: ऑडिट में कई ऐसे खाते मिले जिन्होंने कभी अपना पासवर्ड नहीं बदला था।

examples.en: Sensors are designed to detect even a small rise in temperature.
examples.hi: सेंसर तापमान में मामूली वृद्धि का भी पता लगाने के लिए डिज़ाइन किए गए हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: The tool finds unusual login attempts from unknown locations, in this technical report.
common_mistake.right: The tool detects unusual login attempts from unknown locations.
common_mistake.why: 'Detect' is the standard technical verb for security tools noticing hidden or hard-to-spot activity; 'find' sounds more casual and general for a technical report.

cloze.sentence: The intrusion detection system ____ unusual traffic at 2 a.m.

en_def: to interrupt or prevent something from continuing normally
hi_def: बाधित करना, सामान्य क्रम में रुकावट डालना
hi_nuance: Sometimes confused with 'destroy'; 'disrupt' means to interrupt something or throw it into temporary disorder, not to destroy it completely and permanently.

examples.en: The DDoS attack disrupted the website for nearly three hours.
examples.hi: DDoS हमले ने वेबसाइट को लगभग तीन घंटे तक बाधित कर दिया।

examples.en: A power outage disrupted operations at the data center overnight.
examples.hi: रात भर बिजली गुल रहने से डेटा सेंटर का कामकाज बाधित हो गया।

examples.en: The new update disrupted several workflows that depended on the old interface.
examples.hi: नए अपडेट ने कई कार्यप्रवाहों को बाधित कर दिया जो पुराने इंटरफ़ेस पर निर्भर थे।

examples.en: Ransomware can disrupt an entire hospital's ability to treat patients.
examples.hi: रैंसमवेयर पूरे अस्पताल की मरीज़ों का इलाज करने की क्षमता को बाधित कर सकता है।

examples.en: Protests disrupted the conference where the CEO was due to speak.
examples.hi: विरोध प्रदर्शनों ने उस सम्मेलन को बाधित कर दिया जहाँ CEO को बोलना था।

common_mistake.wrong: The attack destroyed our website for three hours, but afterward it was completely fine.
common_mistake.right: The attack disrupted our website for three hours, and it was fully restored afterward.
common_mistake.why: 'Disrupt' correctly conveys a temporary interruption that can be fixed, matching the described recovery; 'destroy' wrongly implies permanent damage.

cloze.sentence: The DDoS attack ____ the website for nearly three hours.

en_def: to formally or officially tell someone about something
hi_def: सूचित करना, आधिकारिक रूप से जानकारी देना
hi_nuance: More formal than 'tell'; used in the pattern 'notify someone OF/ABOUT something', common in legal and security contexts such as 'notify the authorities' or 'notify affected users'.

examples.en: The company must notify all affected users within seventy-two hours of a data breach.
examples.hi: कंपनी को डेटा उल्लंघन के बहत्तर घंटों के भीतर सभी प्रभावित उपयोगकर्ताओं को सूचित करना होगा।

examples.en: Please notify the security team immediately if you suspect a phishing email.
examples.hi: यदि आपको किसी ईमेल पर फ़िशिंग का शक हो तो कृपया तुरंत सुरक्षा टीम को सूचित करें।

examples.en: Customers were notified by email about the change in the privacy policy.
examples.hi: गोपनीयता नीति में बदलाव के बारे में ग्राहकों को ईमेल द्वारा सूचित किया गया।

examples.en: The bank is legally required to notify regulators of any major fraud.
examples.hi: किसी भी बड़े धोखाधड़ी की स्थिति में बैंक कानूनी रूप से नियामकों को सूचित करने के लिए बाध्य है।

examples.en: He forgot to notify his manager before taking the server offline for maintenance.
examples.hi: वह रखरखाव के लिए सर्वर ऑफ़लाइन करने से पहले अपने मैनेजर को सूचित करना भूल गया।

common_mistake.wrong: Please notify to the security team about this suspicious email.
common_mistake.right: Please notify the security team about this suspicious email.
common_mistake.why: 'Notify' is followed directly by the person being told (notify someone), not by 'to someone'; the correct pattern is 'notify someone of/about something'.

cloze.sentence: The company must ____ all affected users within seventy-two hours of a data breach.

en_def: to find a solution to a problem or difficulty, or to settle a dispute
hi_nuance: Confused with 'solve', which fits puzzles or math problems more naturally; 'resolve' is broader and more formal, used for disputes, complaints, and incidents in professional or legal writing.

examples.en: The support team resolved the ticket within two hours.
examples.hi: सपोर्ट टीम ने टिकट को दो घंटे के भीतर सुलझा लिया।

examples.en: It took weeks to resolve the dispute between the two departments.
examples.hi: दोनों विभागों के बीच के विवाद को सुलझाने में हफ़्तों लग गए।

examples.en: The patch resolved the memory leak that had been causing crashes.
examples.hi: पैच ने उस मेमोरी लीक को ठीक कर दिया जो क्रैश का कारण बन रही थी।

examples.en: We could not resolve the issue remotely, so an engineer visited the site.
examples.hi: हम इस समस्या को दूर से नहीं सुलझा सके, इसलिए एक इंजीनियर साइट पर गया।

examples.en: Management is under pressure to resolve the outage before the weekend.
examples.hi: प्रबंधन पर सप्ताहांत से पहले आउटेज को सुलझाने का दबाव है।

common_mistake.wrong: We need to solve this ticket before the customer calls again, like a puzzle.
common_mistake.right: We need to resolve this ticket before the customer calls again.
common_mistake.why: 'Resolve' is the standard, more formal verb used in support and incident reports; 'solve' sounds more like solving a puzzle or math problem.

cloze.sentence: The support team ____ the ticket within two hours.

en_def: to remain strong or unharmed despite force, pressure, or difficult conditions
hi_def: सहन करना, झेलना (दबाव या मुश्किल हालात में भी मज़बूत बने रहना)
hi_nuance: Confused with 'tolerate', which is more about accepting something unpleasant socially or personally; 'withstand' is about physically or structurally surviving pressure, force, or an attack without breaking.

examples.en: The server must withstand a sudden surge of traffic during a sale.
examples.hi: सर्वर को सेल के दौरान अचानक बढ़े ट्रैफ़िक को झेल पाना चाहिए।

examples.en: This encryption is designed to withstand attacks for at least a decade.
examples.hi: यह एन्क्रिप्शन कम से कम एक दशक तक हमलों को झेलने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है।

examples.en: The building was built to withstand earthquakes up to magnitude seven.
examples.hi: यह इमारत सात तीव्रता तक के भूकंपों को झेलने के लिए बनाई गई थी।

examples.en: Our backup system withstood the ransomware attack without any data loss.
examples.hi: हमारा बैकअप सिस्टम बिना किसी डेटा हानि के रैंसमवेयर हमले को झेल गया।

examples.en: Few passwords can withstand a determined brute-force attack for long.
examples.hi: बहुत कम पासवर्ड लंबे समय तक एक दृढ़ ब्रूट-फ़ोर्स हमले को झेल पाते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This lock can tolerate a lot of pressure before it breaks.
common_mistake.right: This lock can withstand a lot of pressure before it breaks.
common_mistake.why: 'Tolerate' is for accepting unpleasant situations or behaviour; 'withstand' is for physically resisting force or pressure, which fits a lock.

cloze.sentence: The server must ____ a sudden surge of traffic during a sale.

en_def: a clear, deep understanding of a complicated problem or situation
hi_nuance: Confused with 'information' (सामान्य जानकारी, raw facts). 'Insight' implies a deeper understanding gained through analysis, not just raw data.

examples.en: The report gave the team new insight into how the attacker moved across the network.
examples.hi: इस रिपोर्ट ने टीम को यह गहरी समझ दी कि हमलावर नेटवर्क में कैसे आगे बढ़ा।

examples.en: Talking to real users gave us valuable insight into why they ignore security warnings.
examples.hi: असली उपयोगकर्ताओं से बात करने पर हमें यह गहरी समझ मिली कि वे सुरक्षा चेतावनियों को क्यों नज़रअंदाज़ करते हैं।

examples.en: The dashboard offers insight into attacker behaviour across the last thirty days.
examples.hi: यह डैशबोर्ड पिछले तीस दिनों में हमलावर के व्यवहार की गहरी समझ प्रदान करता है।

examples.en: Years of experience gave her deep insight into how phishing campaigns evolve.
examples.hi: वर्षों के अनुभव ने उसे यह गहरी समझ दी कि फ़िशिंग अभियान कैसे बदलते रहते हैं।

examples.en: This survey provides insight into employee attitudes toward remote work security.
examples.hi: यह सर्वेक्षण दूरस्थ कार्य सुरक्षा को लेकर कर्मचारियों के रवैये की गहरी समझ प्रदान करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The dashboard gives us a lot of information about attacker behaviour, so it is enough.
common_mistake.right: The dashboard gives us valuable insight into attacker behaviour.
common_mistake.why: 'Information' means raw facts; 'insight' is the deeper understanding gained by analysing that information, which is the stronger point being made.

cloze.sentence: The report gave the team new ____ into how the attacker moved across the network.

en_def: a particular way of viewing or thinking about something, shaped by experience or position
hi_nuance: Confused with 'opinion' (राय, a single view on one topic). 'Perspective' is broader — the whole viewpoint or angle from which someone sees a situation, shaped by their role or background.

examples.en: From a security perspective, collecting this much user data is risky.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा के दृष्टिकोण से, इतना ज़्यादा उपयोगकर्ता डेटा जमा करना जोखिम भरा है।

examples.en: Talking to the support team gave us a different perspective on the outage.
examples.hi: सपोर्ट टीम से बात करने पर हमें इस आउटेज को लेकर एक अलग दृष्टिकोण मिला।

examples.en: It helps to put the risk into perspective by comparing it with last year's data.
examples.hi: पिछले साल के डेटा से तुलना करके जोखिम को उसके सही परिप्रेक्ष्य में देखना मददगार होता है।

examples.en: From the customer's perspective, a slow app feels just as bad as a broken one.
examples.hi: ग्राहक के नज़रिए से, धीमा ऐप उतना ही खराब लगता है जितना खराब हुआ ऐप।

examples.en: The workshop offered a fresh perspective on how to design secure APIs.
examples.hi: वर्कशॉप ने सुरक्षित एपीआई डिज़ाइन करने पर एक नया दृष्टिकोण दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: In my opinion as a security person, collecting this much data is risky.
common_mistake.right: From a security perspective, collecting this much data is risky.
common_mistake.why: 'From a ___ perspective' is the natural formal pattern for viewing something through a particular professional lens, rather than framing it as a personal opinion.

cloze.sentence: From a ____ of user privacy, collecting this much data is risky.

en_def: the basic systems and structures, such as networks, servers, or power supply, that an organization or system needs to function
hi_def: बुनियादी ढाँचा (जैसे नेटवर्क, बिजली, सर्वर आदि जो किसी संगठन के लिए ज़रूरी हों)
hi_nuance: Often thought of only as roads and buildings; in IT it commonly refers to servers, networks, and cloud systems, as in 'cloud infrastructure' or 'critical infrastructure'. It is usually uncountable, with no plural 's'.

examples.en: The company moved its entire infrastructure to the cloud last year.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने पिछले साल अपना पूरा बुनियादी ढाँचा क्लाउड पर स्थानांतरित कर दिया।

examples.en: Power grids are considered critical infrastructure and are a common target for attackers.
examples.hi: बिजली ग्रिड को महत्वपूर्ण बुनियादी ढाँचा माना जाता है और यह हमलावरों का आम निशाना है।

examples.en: Poor infrastructure planning led to frequent outages during peak hours.
examples.hi: खराब बुनियादी ढाँचा योजना के कारण पीक आवर्स में बार-बार आउटेज होते थे।

examples.en: Our security team monitors the infrastructure around the clock for anomalies.
examples.hi: हमारी सुरक्षा टीम असामान्यताओं के लिए चौबीसों घंटे बुनियादी ढाँचे की निगरानी करती है।

examples.en: Upgrading the network infrastructure took the whole IT budget for the quarter.
examples.hi: नेटवर्क बुनियादी ढाँचे को अपग्रेड करने में पूरी तिमाही का आईटी बजट लग गया।

common_mistake.wrong: We need to fix the infrastructures of three data centers this month.
common_mistake.right: We need to fix the infrastructure of three data centers this month.
common_mistake.why: 'Infrastructure' is usually uncountable in English and does not take a plural '-s', even when referring to several sites.

cloze.sentence: The company moved its entire ____ to the cloud last year.

en_def: a system or process by which something works or is achieved; also, a part of a machine
hi_def: तंत्र, प्रणाली (जिसके ज़रिए कोई काम होता है)
hi_nuance: Used both literally (a machine's mechanism) and abstractly for a process or system, e.g. 'a mechanism for reporting bugs'. 'Mechanism' implies a specific, structured way something functions, unlike the vaguer 'process'.

examples.en: The company needs a clear mechanism for employees to report security concerns.
examples.hi: कंपनी को कर्मचारियों के लिए सुरक्षा चिंताएँ बताने का एक स्पष्ट तंत्र चाहिए।

examples.en: The malware uses a clever mechanism to hide its network traffic.
examples.hi: यह मैलवेयर अपने नेटवर्क ट्रैफ़िक को छिपाने के लिए एक चतुर तंत्र का उपयोग करता है।

examples.en: There is no mechanism in place to verify vendor security practices.
examples.hi: वेंडर की सुरक्षा प्रथाओं को सत्यापित करने के लिए कोई तंत्र मौजूद नहीं है।

examples.en: The locking mechanism on the safe failed during the drill.
examples.hi: अभ्यास के दौरान तिजोरी का लॉकिंग तंत्र काम करना बंद कर गया।

examples.en: Encryption is the key mechanism that protects data in transit.
examples.hi: एन्क्रिप्शन वह मुख्य तंत्र है जो डेटा को यात्रा के दौरान सुरक्षित रखता है।

common_mistake.wrong: We need a good process for reporting bugs, like a form or something similar.
common_mistake.right: We need a clear mechanism for employees to report security concerns.
common_mistake.why: 'Mechanism' sounds more precise and professional for a specific structured system, which is appropriate in a formal policy document.

cloze.sentence: The company needs a clear ____ for employees to report security concerns.

en_def: an official or accepted way of doing something, especially in a formal situation; also, a set of rules for computers to communicate
hi_def: प्रोटोकॉल, औपचारिक नियम या प्रक्रिया (जैसे कंप्यूटरों के बीच संचार के नियम)
hi_nuance: Two senses are often confused: (1) formal procedure or etiquette ('follow protocol'), and (2) technical computer communication rules ('the HTTPS protocol'). Hindi speakers may know only the technical sense.

examples.en: The team followed the incident response protocol step by step.
examples.hi: टीम ने घटना-प्रतिक्रिया प्रोटोकॉल का चरण-दर-चरण पालन किया।

examples.en: HTTPS is the protocol used to encrypt traffic between the browser and the server.
examples.hi: HTTPS वह प्रोटोकॉल है जो ब्राउज़र और सर्वर के बीच ट्रैफ़िक को एन्क्रिप्ट करने के लिए इस्तेमाल होता है।

examples.en: Breaking protocol during an emergency can sometimes cause more harm than good.
examples.hi: आपातकाल के दौरान प्रोटोकॉल तोड़ना कभी-कभी फ़ायदे से ज़्यादा नुकसान कर सकता है।

examples.en: The hospital's data-sharing protocol was updated after the new privacy law.
examples.hi: नए गोपनीयता कानून के बाद अस्पताल का डेटा-साझाकरण प्रोटोकॉल अपडेट किया गया।

examples.en: According to protocol, every incident must be reported within one hour.
examples.hi: प्रोटोकॉल के अनुसार, हर घटना की सूचना एक घंटे के भीतर दी जानी चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: We need to follow the rule about speaking to the press only after checking with legal.
common_mistake.right: We need to follow protocol and speak to the press only after checking with legal.
common_mistake.why: 'Protocol' is the natural, more formal word for an established official procedure, rather than the vaguer word 'rule'.

cloze.sentence: The team followed the incident response ____ step by step.

en_def: one of the parts that together make up a whole system or machine
hi_def: घटक, हिस्सा (जो मिलकर पूरा सिस्टम बनाते हैं)
hi_nuance: Confused with 'part', which is more general; 'component' specifically refers to a distinct part within a larger engineered system, common in software and hardware writing.

examples.en: Authentication is a critical component of any secure application.
examples.hi: प्रमाणीकरण किसी भी सुरक्षित एप्लिकेशन का एक महत्वपूर्ण घटक है।

examples.en: One faulty component caused the entire assembly line to stop.
examples.hi: एक खराब घटक की वजह से पूरी असेंबली लाइन रुक गई।

examples.en: The report identifies training as a key component of the security strategy.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट प्रशिक्षण को सुरक्षा रणनीति के एक मुख्य घटक के रूप में पहचानती है।

examples.en: Each microservice is a separate component that can be updated independently.
examples.hi: हर माइक्रोसर्विस एक अलग घटक है जिसे स्वतंत्र रूप से अपडेट किया जा सकता है।

examples.en: The vulnerability was found in a third-party component used by the app.
examples.hi: यह भेद्यता ऐप द्वारा इस्तेमाल किए जाने वाले एक तृतीय-पक्ष घटक में पाई गई थी।

common_mistake.wrong: Authentication is a critical part of any secure application, just like many other parts.
common_mistake.right: Authentication is a critical component of any secure application.
common_mistake.why: 'Component' is more precise than the generic 'part' when describing a distinct, engineered piece of a system, and it avoids sounding repetitive.

cloze.sentence: Authentication is a critical ____ of any secure application.

en_def: something that exists separately from other things and has its own distinct identity, especially an organization
hi_def: इकाई, स्वतंत्र अस्तित्व रखने वाली वस्तु या संगठन
hi_nuance: Learners often say 'organization' or 'company' for everything; 'entity' is a broader, more formal legal or technical term that can refer to a company, a government body, or even a record in a database.

examples.en: The attack was traced back to a foreign threat entity, not an individual hacker.
examples.hi: यह हमला एक विदेशी खतरा-इकाई से जुड़ा पाया गया, न कि किसी अकेले हैकर से।

examples.en: Each subsidiary is treated as a separate legal entity for tax purposes.
examples.hi: कर उद्देश्यों के लिए हर सहायक कंपनी को एक अलग कानूनी इकाई माना जाता है।

examples.en: The database stores each customer as a distinct entity with its own ID.
examples.hi: डेटाबेस हर ग्राहक को अपनी खुद की ID वाली एक अलग इकाई के रूप में संग्रहीत करता है।

examples.en: Regulators can fine any entity that mishandles personal data.
examples.hi: नियामक व्यक्तिगत डेटा का दुरुपयोग करने वाली किसी भी इकाई पर जुर्माना लगा सकते हैं।

examples.en: The report avoided naming the entity behind the attack for legal reasons.
examples.hi: कानूनी कारणों से रिपोर्ट ने हमले के पीछे की इकाई का नाम नहीं लिया।

common_mistake.wrong: The attack was traced back to a foreign hacker group, but we can't say the company or country.
common_mistake.right: The attack was traced back to a foreign threat entity.
common_mistake.why: 'Entity' is the standard formal or legal term used when the specific nature of the group or organization is deliberately left unspecified.

cloze.sentence: The attack was traced back to a foreign threat ____, not an individual hacker.

en_def: information discovered as a result of an investigation, study, or piece of research
hi_def: निष्कर्ष, जाँच या अध्ययन से प्राप्त जानकारी
hi_nuance: Often used in the plural 'findings'; Hindi speakers sometimes say 'result' for everything, but 'finding(s)' specifically refers to what was discovered during an investigation or audit, not a final score or output.

examples.en: The audit's key finding was that half the servers had never been patched.
examples.hi: ऑडिट का मुख्य निष्कर्ष यह था कि आधे सर्वरों को कभी पैच ही नहीं किया गया था।

examples.en: Investigators presented their findings to the board in a closed meeting.
examples.hi: जाँचकर्ताओं ने बंद बैठक में बोर्ड के सामने अपने निष्कर्ष प्रस्तुत किए।

examples.en: According to the report's findings, the breach began with a phishing email.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट के निष्कर्षों के अनुसार, उल्लंघन एक फ़िशिंग ईमेल से शुरू हुआ था।

examples.en: The penetration test findings were shared with the development team immediately.
examples.hi: पेनेट्रेशन टेस्ट के निष्कर्ष तुरंत विकास टीम के साथ साझा किए गए।

examples.en: One surprising finding was that most incidents happened outside office hours.
examples.hi: एक चौंकाने वाला निष्कर्ष यह था कि अधिकांश घटनाएँ दफ़्तर के समय के बाहर हुईं।

common_mistake.wrong: The result of the audit was that half the servers had never been patched, among other results.
common_mistake.right: The audit's key finding was that half the servers had never been patched.
common_mistake.why: 'Finding' is the standard word for a specific discovery made during an investigation or audit, more precise here than the general word 'result'.

cloze.sentence: The audit's key ____ was that half the servers had never been patched.

en_def: a piece of advice or a rule about how something should be done, though not always compulsory
hi_def: दिशा-निर्देश (सलाह या नियम, जो हमेशा अनिवार्य न हो)
hi_nuance: Weaker than 'rule' or 'law'; a guideline is recommended good practice, whereas a 'policy' or 'regulation' is usually mandatory. Hindi speakers sometimes treat the two as identical.

examples.en: The security guidelines recommend changing passwords every ninety days.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा दिशा-निर्देश हर नब्बे दिनों में पासवर्ड बदलने की सलाह देते हैं।

examples.en: These are only guidelines, not strict rules, so use your judgment.
examples.hi: ये केवल दिशा-निर्देश हैं, सख्त नियम नहीं, इसलिए अपनी समझ का उपयोग करें।

examples.en: The company published new guidelines for working safely from home.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने घर से सुरक्षित रूप से काम करने के लिए नए दिशा-निर्देश प्रकाशित किए।

examples.en: The vendor did not follow industry guidelines when storing customer data.
examples.hi: वेंडर ने ग्राहक डेटा संग्रहीत करते समय उद्योग दिशा-निर्देशों का पालन नहीं किया।

examples.en: We updated our coding guidelines after the last security review.
examples.hi: पिछली सुरक्षा समीक्षा के बाद हमने अपने कोडिंग दिशा-निर्देश अपडेट किए।

common_mistake.wrong: This is a strict law you must obey, or you will be punished immediately for not following the coding guideline.
common_mistake.right: This is a guideline, so try to follow it, though small exceptions are sometimes acceptable.
common_mistake.why: A 'guideline' is recommended practice, not a mandatory law; treating it as strictly enforceable misrepresents how binding a guideline actually is.

cloze.sentence: The security ____ recommend changing passwords every ninety days.

en_def: exact and accurate, with every small detail correct
hi_def: सटीक, बिल्कुल ठीक (हर छोटे विवरण में सही)
hi_nuance: Confused with 'accurate'; very similar, but 'precise' often emphasizes exactness of detail or measurement, while 'accurate' emphasizes correctness relative to the truth. The two are commonly used together.

examples.en: We need a precise timestamp of when the attacker first logged in.
examples.hi: हमें यह जानने के लिए एक सटीक टाइमस्टैम्प चाहिए कि हमलावर ने पहली बार कब लॉगिन किया था।

examples.en: Her precise description of the error helped the team fix it in minutes.
examples.hi: गड़बड़ी के उसके सटीक विवरण ने टीम को इसे मिनटों में ठीक करने में मदद की।

examples.en: The report gives a precise breakdown of costs for each department.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट हर विभाग की लागत का सटीक विवरण देती है।

examples.en: It is hard to give a precise number of affected users this early in the investigation.
examples.hi: जाँच के इतने शुरुआती चरण में प्रभावित उपयोगकर्ताओं की सटीक संख्या बताना मुश्किल है।

examples.en: The instructions were so precise that even a new hire could follow them.
examples.hi: निर्देश इतने सटीक थे कि एक नया कर्मचारी भी उन्हें आसानी से समझ सकता था।

common_mistake.wrong: Please give me a roughly-exact time, sometime around when this happened, that's fine for now.
common_mistake.right: Please give me a precise timestamp of when this happened.
common_mistake.why: 'Precise' asks for exact, detailed accuracy, which is appropriate for an investigation; a vague approximation does not meet that requirement.

cloze.sentence: We need a ____ timestamp of when the attacker first logged in.

en_def: changing constantly, full of energy, or characterized by continuous activity
hi_def: गतिशील, लगातार बदलता रहने वाला या ऊर्जावान
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes use 'active' or 'energetic' only for people; 'dynamic' is also widely used for systems, markets, and threats that constantly change, as in 'a dynamic threat landscape'.

examples.en: The threat landscape is dynamic, so our defenses must keep evolving too.
examples.hi: खतरे का परिदृश्य गतिशील है, इसलिए हमारी सुरक्षा को भी लगातार विकसित होते रहना होगा।

examples.en: She is a dynamic leader who adapts quickly to new challenges.
examples.hi: वह एक गतिशील नेता है जो नई चुनौतियों के अनुरूप जल्दी ढल जाती है।

examples.en: The pricing model is dynamic and changes based on real-time demand.
examples.hi: मूल्य निर्धारण मॉडल गतिशील है और वास्तविक समय की माँग के आधार पर बदलता रहता है।

examples.en: A dynamic firewall rule adjusts automatically based on traffic patterns.
examples.hi: एक गतिशील फ़ायरवॉल नियम ट्रैफ़िक पैटर्न के आधार पर स्वतः समायोजित हो जाता है।

examples.en: The startup operates in a highly dynamic and competitive market.
examples.hi: यह स्टार्टअप एक अत्यंत गतिशील और प्रतिस्पर्धी बाज़ार में काम करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The market changes very fast, but let's just call it an active market for our report.
common_mistake.right: The market is highly dynamic, changing week to week.
common_mistake.why: 'Dynamic' is the precise, professional word for something that changes continuously; 'active' usually describes a person's energy, not a fast-changing system.

cloze.sentence: The threat landscape is ____, so our defenses must keep evolving too.

en_def: existing or happening before something else, or before a particular time
hi_def: पूर्व, पहले का (किसी और चीज़ से पहले का)
hi_nuance: Similar to 'previous' but more formal, common in the pattern 'prior to' (before) and 'prior approval/experience'. Hindi speakers sometimes confuse 'prior' with 'priority' because of the similar spelling.

examples.en: Prior to the merger, the two companies used completely different systems.
examples.hi: विलय से पहले, दोनों कंपनियाँ पूरी तरह अलग-अलग सिस्टम इस्तेमाल करती थीं।

examples.en: No prior experience with cloud security is required for this course.
examples.hi: इस कोर्स के लिए क्लाउड सुरक्षा में पूर्व अनुभव की कोई ज़रूरत नहीं है।

examples.en: The change required prior approval from the compliance team.
examples.hi: इस बदलाव के लिए अनुपालन टीम की पूर्व मंज़ूरी ज़रूरी थी।

examples.en: We had no prior warning that the vendor's servers were being decommissioned.
examples.hi: हमें कोई पूर्व चेतावनी नहीं मिली थी कि वेंडर के सर्वर बंद किए जा रहे हैं।

examples.en: Her prior role at a bank gave her useful experience with fraud detection.
examples.hi: एक बैंक में उसकी पूर्व भूमिका ने उसे धोखाधड़ी पहचान का उपयोगी अनुभव दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: This change needs prior of approval from the compliance team before we proceed.
common_mistake.right: This change needs prior approval from the compliance team before we proceed.
common_mistake.why: 'Prior' is used directly before a noun ('prior approval') or as 'prior to', and is never followed by 'of'.

cloze.sentence: The change required ____ approval from the compliance team.

en_def: important, interesting, or unusual enough to deserve attention
hi_def: उल्लेखनीय, ध्यान देने योग्य (महत्वपूर्ण या असामान्य होने के कारण)
hi_nuance: Confused with 'notorious' (famous for something bad); 'notable' is neutral or positive, simply meaning worth noticing or remembering, unlike 'notorious'.

examples.en: One notable exception to the outage was the payments service, which stayed online.
examples.hi: आउटेज का एक उल्लेखनीय अपवाद भुगतान सेवा थी, जो ऑनलाइन बनी रही।

examples.en: There were several notable improvements in this year's security audit.
examples.hi: इस साल की सुरक्षा ऑडिट में कई उल्लेखनीय सुधार देखे गए।

examples.en: It is notable that none of the affected accounts had two-factor authentication enabled.
examples.hi: यह उल्लेखनीय है कि किसी भी प्रभावित खाते में दो-कारक प्रमाणीकरण सक्षम नहीं था।

examples.en: The conference had a notable absence of talks about AI security this year.
examples.hi: इस साल सम्मेलन में AI सुरक्षा पर चर्चाओं की एक उल्लेखनीय कमी रही।

examples.en: Her notable contribution was designing the new incident response workflow.
examples.hi: उसका उल्लेखनीय योगदान नए घटना-प्रतिक्रिया कार्यप्रवाह को डिज़ाइन करना था।

common_mistake.wrong: That hacker is quite notable for stealing millions of records; everyone knows the name.
common_mistake.right: That hacker is quite notorious for stealing millions of records.
common_mistake.why: 'Notorious' is used for someone or something well known for bad reasons; 'notable' is neutral and simply means worth noticing, which is not the intended meaning here.

cloze.sentence: It is ____ that none of the affected accounts had two-factor authentication enabled.

en_def: the same in all parts or cases; not varying
hi_def: एकसमान, हर जगह एक जैसा (बिना बदलाव के)
hi_nuance: As an adjective (not the noun for clothing), 'uniform' describes consistency across a system or group, e.g. 'uniform standards across all offices'. Hindi speakers sometimes only recognize the noun sense (school uniform).

examples.en: The company enforces a uniform password policy across all offices worldwide.
examples.hi: कंपनी दुनिया भर के सभी दफ़्तरों में एकसमान पासवर्ड नीति लागू करती है।

examples.en: Server logs were not uniform in format, which slowed down the investigation.
examples.hi: सर्वर लॉग एकसमान प्रारूप में नहीं थे, जिससे जाँच धीमी हो गई।

examples.en: We need a uniform approach to reporting incidents across every team.
examples.hi: हमें हर टीम में घटनाओं की रिपोर्टिंग के लिए एक एकसमान तरीका चाहिए।

examples.en: The training ensures uniform understanding of the security policy among new hires.
examples.hi: यह प्रशिक्षण नए कर्मचारियों के बीच सुरक्षा नीति की एकसमान समझ सुनिश्चित करता है।

examples.en: Response times were far from uniform across the different regional data centers.
examples.hi: विभिन्न क्षेत्रीय डेटा सेंटरों में प्रतिक्रिया समय एकसमान से बहुत दूर था।

common_mistake.wrong: Every office should wear the same uniform rules for passwords, just like matching clothes.
common_mistake.right: Every office should follow uniform password rules.
common_mistake.why: As an adjective, 'uniform' describes consistency across a system; it should not be confused with the noun 'uniform' meaning matching clothing.

cloze.sentence: The company enforces a ____ password policy across all offices worldwide.

en_def: belonging to the present time, modern; or existing at the same time as something else
hi_def: समकालीन, वर्तमान समय का; या किसी और चीज़ के साथ उसी समय का
hi_nuance: Two senses: modern or current ('contemporary security threats'), and existing at the same time as something else ('a contemporary of the company's founder'). Hindi speakers usually know only the first sense.

examples.en: Contemporary security threats look very different from those of a decade ago.
examples.hi: समकालीन सुरक्षा खतरे एक दशक पहले के खतरों से बहुत अलग दिखते हैं।

examples.en: The training covers contemporary attack techniques such as supply-chain compromise.
examples.hi: यह प्रशिक्षण समकालीन हमले की तकनीकों को कवर करता है, जैसे सप्लाई-चेन समझौता।

examples.en: This old firewall was designed for a very different, less contemporary threat model.
examples.hi: यह पुराना फ़ायरवॉल एक बहुत अलग, कम समकालीन खतरा मॉडल के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया था।

examples.en: He was a contemporary of the company's founder and joined in its first year.
examples.hi: वह कंपनी के संस्थापक का समकालीन था और उसके पहले साल में ही शामिल हो गया था।

examples.en: Contemporary best practice recommends multi-factor authentication for all accounts.
examples.hi: समकालीन सर्वोत्तम अभ्यास सभी खातों के लिए बहु-कारक प्रमाणीकरण की सलाह देता है।

common_mistake.wrong: This is a modern threat, like the kind you'd read about in today's newspaper, very new.
common_mistake.right: This is a contemporary threat, unlike the outdated ones this old policy was written for.
common_mistake.why: 'Contemporary' precisely and formally names threats belonging to the present time, and pairs naturally with a contrast to something outdated, as intended here.

cloze.sentence: Contemporary security threats look very different from those of a decade ago, so this ____ training must be updated.

en_def: happening all the time or repeatedly; not changing
hi_def: निरंतर, लगातार (बिना रुके या बदले हुए)
hi_nuance: Confused with 'continuous', which is very close in meaning; 'constant' often implies something repeated frequently or unchanging over time, while 'continuous' emphasizes there being no interruption at all.

examples.en: The system faces constant attempts to guess weak passwords.
examples.hi: सिस्टम को कमज़ोर पासवर्ड अंदाज़ा लगाने के निरंतर प्रयासों का सामना करना पड़ता है।

examples.en: Constant monitoring is needed to catch threats as soon as they appear.
examples.hi: खतरों को उभरते ही पकड़ने के लिए निरंतर निगरानी ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: There has been a constant increase in phishing attempts this quarter.
examples.hi: इस तिमाही में फ़िशिंग प्रयासों में निरंतर वृद्धि हुई है।

examples.en: Her constant complaints about the slow VPN finally led to an upgrade.
examples.hi: धीमे VPN के बारे में उसकी निरंतर शिकायतों ने आख़िरकार एक अपग्रेड करवा दिया।

examples.en: The server temperature remained constant throughout the stress test.
examples.hi: स्ट्रेस टेस्ट के दौरान सर्वर का तापमान निरंतर एक जैसा बना रहा।

common_mistake.wrong: The system faces continuous attempts to guess weak passwords, again and again, over and over.
common_mistake.right: The system faces constant attempts to guess weak passwords.
common_mistake.why: 'Constant' already captures the sense of ongoing repetition, so adding 'again and again, over and over' is unnecessary and repetitive.

cloze.sentence: The system faces ____ attempts to guess weak passwords.

en_def: shared or felt by two or more people or groups toward each other
hi_def: पारस्परिक, आपसी (दो या अधिक पक्षों के बीच साझा)
hi_nuance: Common in the phrase 'mutual agreement' or 'mutual trust'; describes something shared between two specific parties, unlike 'common', which can describe something shared by many unrelated people or things.

examples.en: The two companies signed a mutual non-disclosure agreement before sharing threat data.
examples.hi: दोनों कंपनियों ने खतरे का डेटा साझा करने से पहले एक पारस्परिक गोपनीयता अनुबंध पर हस्ताक्षर किए।

examples.en: Mutual trust between the security team and developers made the rollout smoother.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा टीम और डेवलपरों के बीच पारस्परिक भरोसे ने रोलआउट को आसान बना दिया।

examples.en: Both sides reached a mutual understanding about how incidents would be reported.
examples.hi: दोनों पक्षों ने इस बारे में पारस्परिक समझ बना ली कि घटनाओं की सूचना कैसे दी जाएगी।

examples.en: The partnership relies on mutual respect for each other's security requirements.
examples.hi: यह साझेदारी एक-दूसरे की सुरक्षा आवश्यकताओं के प्रति पारस्परिक सम्मान पर निर्भर करती है।

examples.en: It was a mutual decision to delay the launch until testing was complete.
examples.hi: परीक्षण पूरा होने तक लॉन्च टालने का यह एक पारस्परिक निर्णय था।

common_mistake.wrong: We have a common agreement not to share each other's client data, common to everyone in the industry.
common_mistake.right: We have a mutual agreement not to share each other's client data.
common_mistake.why: 'Mutual' specifically describes something shared between two particular parties toward each other; 'common' is used for something shared more broadly, which is not the intended meaning.

cloze.sentence: The two companies signed a ____ non-disclosure agreement before sharing threat data.

en_def: to examine something carefully in order to understand it or explain it
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'do analysis of' where a native speaker simply says 'analyze'. Also note the American spelling 'analyze'; British is 'analyse'.

examples.en: We need to analyze the data before we draw any conclusions.
examples.hi: निष्कर्ष निकालने से पहले हमें डेटा का विश्लेषण करना होगा।

examples.en: The team analyzed the logs and found the root cause.
examples.hi: टीम ने लॉग का विश्लेषण किया और मूल कारण खोज लिया।

examples.en: She analyzed the survey results in a short report.
examples.hi: उसने सर्वे के नतीजों का विश्लेषण एक छोटी रिपोर्ट में किया।

examples.en: It takes time to analyze why customers leave.
examples.hi: ग्राहक क्यों छोड़ते हैं, इसका विश्लेषण करने में समय लगता है।

examples.en: Let's analyze the problem step by step.
examples.hi: चलिए समस्या का चरण-दर-चरण विश्लेषण करते हैं।

examples.en: The doctor analyzed the blood sample overnight.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने रात भर में खून के नमूने का विश्लेषण किया।

common_mistake.wrong: We did analysis on the data.
common_mistake.right: We analyzed the data.
common_mistake.why: Prefer the verb; 'do analysis on' is heavy Indian-English phrasing.

cloze.sentence: Engineers ____ the crash logs to find the bug.

en_def: to judge the quality, size, or value of something
hi_nuance: Learners confuse 'assess' with 'access' (पहुँच). 'Assess' is about judging; 'access' is about entering or reaching.

examples.en: The manager will assess your performance every quarter.
examples.hi: मैनेजर हर तिमाही आपके प्रदर्शन का आकलन करेगा।

examples.en: We assessed the risk before launching the feature.
examples.hi: फ़ीचर लॉन्च करने से पहले हमने जोखिम का आकलन किया।

examples.en: It is hard to assess the damage from here.
examples.hi: यहाँ से नुकसान का आकलन करना कठिन है।

examples.en: Teachers assess students through projects, not just exams.
examples.hi: शिक्षक छात्रों का मूल्यांकन सिर्फ़ परीक्षा से नहीं, प्रोजेक्ट से भी करते हैं।

examples.en: Please assess whether the plan is realistic.
examples.hi: कृपया आकलन करें कि योजना व्यावहारिक है या नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: We need to access the risk first.
common_mistake.right: We need to assess the risk first.
common_mistake.why: 'Access' means to reach or enter; 'assess' means to judge.

cloze.sentence: Before we upgrade, we should ____ the impact on users.

en_def: an idea or principle, especially an abstract one
hi_nuance: In Indian English 'concept' is often used for any simple idea ('I have a concept for lunch'). In natural English it is an abstract or general idea, not a small plan.

examples.en: The concept of zero trust is central to modern security.
examples.hi: ज़ीरो ट्रस्ट की अवधारणा आधुनिक सुरक्षा के केंद्र में है।

examples.en: Students found the concept difficult to grasp at first.
examples.hi: छात्रों को पहले यह अवधारणा समझना मुश्किल लगा।

examples.en: She explained the basic concept in two minutes.
examples.hi: उसने मूल अवधारणा दो मिनट में समझा दी।

examples.en: This is a new concept for our customers.
examples.hi: यह हमारे ग्राहकों के लिए एक नई अवधारणा है।

examples.en: The whole concept of the app is simplicity.
examples.hi: इस ऐप की पूरी अवधारणा सरलता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I got the concept of your point.
common_mistake.right: I understood your point.
common_mistake.why: 'Concept' is for abstract ideas, not for someone's remark.

cloze.sentence: The ____ of least privilege limits what each account can do.

en_def: always behaving or happening in the same way; not contradicting something
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes use 'consistent' to mean 'continuous' (लगातार). It actually means 'the same every time', not 'without stopping'.

examples.en: Her work is consistent, so the team trusts her.
examples.hi: उसका काम हमेशा एक जैसा अच्छा होता है, इसलिए टीम उस पर भरोसा करती है।

examples.en: The results were consistent with our hypothesis.
examples.hi: नतीजे हमारी परिकल्पना के अनुरूप थे।

examples.en: Be consistent: use the same naming style everywhere.
examples.hi: एकरूप रहें: हर जगह एक ही नामकरण शैली अपनाएँ।

examples.en: A consistent routine helps you learn faster.
examples.hi: एक नियमित दिनचर्या आपको तेज़ी से सीखने में मदद करती है।

examples.en: His story was not consistent with the evidence.
examples.hi: उसकी कहानी सबूतों से मेल नहीं खाती थी।

common_mistake.wrong: It rained consistent for three days.
common_mistake.right: It rained continuously for three days.
common_mistake.why: 'Consistent' means the same each time, not 'without stopping'.

cloze.sentence: The error message is ____ with a timeout, not a crash.

en_def: to get or obtain something from a source; to come from something
hi_def: प्राप्त करना, व्युत्पन्न होना, से निकलना
hi_nuance: Always 'derive X from Y'. Learners drop 'from' or say 'derive out of'.

examples.en: Many English words derive from Latin.
examples.hi: अंग्रेज़ी के कई शब्द लैटिन से निकले हैं।

examples.en: She derives great satisfaction from teaching.
examples.hi: उसे पढ़ाने से बहुत संतोष मिलता है।

examples.en: The password hash is derived from the user's input.
examples.hi: पासवर्ड हैश उपयोगकर्ता के इनपुट से बनाया जाता है।

examples.en: We derived the formula from three simple rules.
examples.hi: हमने तीन सरल नियमों से यह सूत्र निकाला।

examples.en: The company derives most of its income from subscriptions.
examples.hi: कंपनी अपनी अधिकांश आय सब्सक्रिप्शन से प्राप्त करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: This word is derived out of Sanskrit.
common_mistake.right: This word is derived from Sanskrit.
common_mistake.why: The preposition after 'derive' is always 'from'.

cloze.sentence: The key is ____ from a passphrase using a hashing function.

en_def: easily seen or understood; obvious
hi_nuance: Learners often write 'it is evident to see that'. Just say 'it is evident that'. Do not confuse with 'evidence' (noun).

examples.en: It was evident that he had not read the report.
examples.hi: यह स्पष्ट था कि उसने रिपोर्ट नहीं पढ़ी थी।

examples.en: The benefits of the change were evident within a week.
examples.hi: बदलाव के फ़ायदे एक हफ़्ते में ही स्पष्ट हो गए।

examples.en: Her frustration was evident in her voice.
examples.hi: उसकी आवाज़ में उसकी झुंझलाहट साफ़ झलक रही थी।

examples.en: From the logs, it is evident that the server rebooted twice.
examples.hi: लॉग से स्पष्ट है कि सर्वर दो बार रीबूट हुआ।

examples.en: The damage was evident even from a distance.
examples.hi: नुकसान दूर से भी साफ़ दिखाई दे रहा था।

common_mistake.wrong: It is evident to see that sales fell.
common_mistake.right: It is evident that sales fell.
common_mistake.why: 'Evident' already means 'easy to see'; 'to see' is redundant.

cloze.sentence: It was ____ from the traffic spike that the site had gone viral.

en_def: one of several things that influence or cause a situation
hi_nuance: Indian English overuses 'factor' in 'a major factor behind'. Natural collocation is 'a factor in' something.

examples.en: Cost was the deciding factor in our choice.
examples.hi: हमारे चुनाव में लागत निर्णायक कारक थी।

examples.en: Several factors contributed to the outage.
examples.hi: कई कारकों ने आउटेज में योगदान दिया।

examples.en: Human error is a key factor in most breaches.
examples.hi: अधिकांश सुरक्षा उल्लंघनों में मानवीय भूल एक प्रमुख कारक है।

examples.en: We must take every factor into account.
examples.hi: हमें हर कारक को ध्यान में रखना होगा।

examples.en: Weather is an important factor in flight delays.
examples.hi: उड़ान में देरी का मौसम एक महत्वपूर्ण कारक है।

examples.en: Time is a factor we cannot ignore.
examples.hi: समय एक ऐसा कारक है जिसे हम नज़रअंदाज़ नहीं कर सकते।

common_mistake.wrong: Price is a big factor behind the customers.
common_mistake.right: Price is a big factor for customers.
common_mistake.why: 'Factor behind' needs an event ('the factor behind the delay'), not a group of people.

cloze.sentence: Sleep is a major ____ in how well you remember new words.

en_def: to show, point out, or suggest that something is true
hi_nuance: In Hindi 'इंगित करना' is direct; in English 'indicate' is softer than 'prove'. Use it for signs and suggestions, not certainty.

examples.en: The red light indicates that the battery is low.
examples.hi: लाल बत्ती दर्शाती है कि बैटरी कम है।

examples.en: Early results indicate a small improvement.
examples.hi: शुरुआती नतीजे थोड़े सुधार का संकेत देते हैं।

examples.en: Please indicate your preferred time on the form.
examples.hi: कृपया फ़ॉर्म में अपना पसंदीदा समय बताएँ।

examples.en: Nothing in the logs indicates an attack.
examples.hi: लॉग में कुछ भी हमले का संकेत नहीं देता।

examples.en: She indicated that she might leave the company.
examples.hi: उसने संकेत दिया कि वह कंपनी छोड़ सकती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The report is indicating the growth.
common_mistake.right: The report indicates growth.
common_mistake.why: Reporting verbs like 'indicate' are rarely used in the continuous.

cloze.sentence: A sudden rise in failed logins may ____ a brute-force attempt.

en_def: to explain the meaning of something; to understand something in a particular way
hi_def: व्याख्या करना, अर्थ निकालना, अनुवाद करना (मौखिक)
hi_nuance: An 'interpreter' translates speech; a 'translator' works with text. Hindi speakers use 'translate' for both.

examples.en: How do you interpret this clause in the contract?
examples.hi: आप अनुबंध की इस धारा की व्याख्या कैसे करते हैं?

examples.en: The data can be interpreted in several ways.
examples.hi: इस डेटा की कई तरह से व्याख्या की जा सकती है।

examples.en: She interpreted his silence as anger.
examples.hi: उसने उसकी चुप्पी को गुस्सा समझा।

examples.en: We need someone to interpret for the visitors from Japan.
examples.hi: जापान से आए मेहमानों के लिए हमें एक दुभाषिये की ज़रूरत है।

examples.en: Do not interpret the numbers without context.
examples.hi: संदर्भ के बिना आँकड़ों का अर्थ न निकालें।

common_mistake.wrong: Please translate for the guest during the meeting.
common_mistake.right: Please interpret for the guest during the meeting.
common_mistake.why: Spoken, live translation is 'interpreting'.

cloze.sentence: Two auditors may ____ the same log line differently.

en_def: happening or coming after something else
hi_nuance: Do not confuse with 'consequent' (resulting). 'Subsequent' is only about time order.

examples.en: The first patch failed, but subsequent patches worked.
examples.hi: पहला पैच विफल रहा, लेकिन बाद के पैच सफल रहे।

examples.en: Subsequent events proved her right.
examples.hi: बाद की घटनाओं ने उसे सही साबित किया।

examples.en: We will discuss this in a subsequent meeting.
examples.hi: हम इस पर आगामी बैठक में चर्चा करेंगे।

examples.en: The subsequent investigation found no data loss.
examples.hi: बाद की जाँच में कोई डेटा हानि नहीं मिली।

examples.en: Each subsequent request is slower than the last.
examples.hi: हर अगला अनुरोध पिछले वाले से धीमा है।

common_mistake.wrong: The outage and the subsequent loss of revenue was consequent.
common_mistake.right: The outage caused a subsequent loss of revenue.
common_mistake.why: 'Subsequent' = later in time; do not stack it with 'consequent'.

cloze.sentence: The first alert was ignored, and ____ alerts were missed too.

en_def: to give part of your work or authority to someone else
hi_nuance: As a noun (/ˈdelɪɡət/) it means a representative at a conference. Note the different final vowel sound.

examples.en: Good managers delegate tasks instead of doing everything themselves.
examples.hi: अच्छे प्रबंधक सब कुछ ख़ुद करने के बजाय काम सौंपते हैं।

examples.en: I delegated the testing to a junior engineer.
examples.hi: मैंने टेस्टिंग का काम एक जूनियर इंजीनियर को सौंप दिया।

examples.en: She finds it hard to delegate.
examples.hi: उसे काम सौंपना कठिन लगता है।

examples.en: You can delegate responsibility, but not accountability.
examples.hi: आप ज़िम्मेदारी सौंप सकते हैं, पर जवाबदेही नहीं।

examples.en: Delegate the routine work so you can focus on design.
examples.hi: नियमित काम दूसरों को सौंपें ताकि आप डिज़ाइन पर ध्यान दे सकें।

common_mistake.wrong: I delegated him the work.
common_mistake.right: I delegated the work to him.
common_mistake.why: 'Delegate' takes 'something to someone', not two objects.

cloze.sentence: Try to ____ small tasks so you have time for the important ones.

en_def: to decide which things are most important and deal with them first
hi_nuance: Indian English often says 'give priority to'; 'prioritize' is shorter and more natural in work emails.

examples.en: We need to prioritize the critical bugs.
examples.hi: हमें गंभीर बग को प्राथमिकता देनी होगी।

examples.en: Learn to prioritize your tasks each morning.
examples.hi: हर सुबह अपने कामों की प्राथमिकता तय करना सीखें।

examples.en: The company prioritizes security over speed.
examples.hi: कंपनी गति से ज़्यादा सुरक्षा को प्राथमिकता देती है।

examples.en: Which feature should we prioritize for the release?
examples.hi: रिलीज़ के लिए हमें किस फ़ीचर को प्राथमिकता देनी चाहिए?

examples.en: She prioritized her health and took a week off.
examples.hi: उसने अपने स्वास्थ्य को प्राथमिकता दी और एक हफ़्ते की छुट्टी ली।

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly give priority for this ticket.
common_mistake.right: Please prioritize this ticket.
common_mistake.why: 'Give priority to' (not 'for') is correct, but 'prioritize' is the natural verb.

cloze.sentence: When everything is urgent, you must ____ ruthlessly.

en_def: a person or group with an interest in a project or business decision
hi_nuance: Not the same as 'shareholder' (शेयरधारक). A stakeholder may hold no shares at all: users, staff, regulators are stakeholders.

examples.en: We shared the roadmap with all stakeholders.
examples.hi: हमने रोडमैप सभी हितधारकों के साथ साझा किया।

examples.en: Stakeholders were not happy with the delay.
examples.hi: हितधारक देरी से खुश नहीं थे।

examples.en: Identify the key stakeholders before the kickoff meeting.
examples.hi: किकऑफ़ मीटिंग से पहले मुख्य हितधारकों की पहचान करें।

examples.en: Customers are our most important stakeholders.
examples.hi: ग्राहक हमारे सबसे महत्वपूर्ण हितधारक हैं।

examples.en: The report goes to internal and external stakeholders.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट आंतरिक और बाहरी हितधारकों को जाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The shareholders of the project must approve the design.
common_mistake.right: The stakeholders of the project must approve the design.
common_mistake.why: Project participants are stakeholders; shareholders own company shares.

cloze.sentence: Before we change the API, we must inform every ____.

en_def: comments about how well or badly someone or something is doing
hi_nuance: Uncountable: never 'feedbacks' or 'a feedback'. Say 'some feedback' or 'a piece of feedback'.

examples.en: Thank you for your feedback on the draft.
examples.hi: मसौदे पर आपकी प्रतिक्रिया के लिए धन्यवाद।

examples.en: We collected feedback from fifty users.
examples.hi: हमने पचास उपयोगकर्ताओं से प्रतिक्रिया एकत्र की।

examples.en: Her manager gave her honest feedback.
examples.hi: उसके मैनेजर ने उसे ईमानदार प्रतिक्रिया दी।

examples.en: Negative feedback is useful if it is specific.
examples.hi: नकारात्मक प्रतिक्रिया तब उपयोगी होती है जब वह विशिष्ट हो।

examples.en: Please send feedback by Monday.
examples.hi: कृपया सोमवार तक अपनी प्रतिक्रिया भेजें।

common_mistake.wrong: We received many feedbacks from clients.
common_mistake.right: We received a lot of feedback from clients.
common_mistake.why: 'Feedback' is uncountable and has no plural.

cloze.sentence: Ask for ____ early, before you polish the design.

en_def: responsible for something and expected to explain your actions
hi_nuance: 'Responsible' = you do the task; 'accountable' = you answer for the result. Use 'accountable to (a person) for (a thing)'.

examples.en: Managers are accountable for their team's results.
examples.hi: प्रबंधक अपनी टीम के नतीजों के लिए जवाबदेह होते हैं।

examples.en: Who is accountable if the data leaks?
examples.hi: अगर डेटा लीक हो जाए तो कौन जवाबदेह है?

examples.en: The board is accountable to the shareholders.
examples.hi: बोर्ड शेयरधारकों के प्रति जवाबदेह है।

examples.en: We want to hold vendors accountable for delays.
examples.hi: हम देरी के लिए विक्रेताओं को जवाबदेह ठहराना चाहते हैं।

examples.en: Being accountable means owning your mistakes.
examples.hi: जवाबदेह होने का मतलब अपनी गलतियों को स्वीकार करना है।

common_mistake.wrong: He is accountable of the budget.
common_mistake.right: He is accountable for the budget.
common_mistake.why: 'Accountable' takes 'for' (the thing) or 'to' (the person).

cloze.sentence: Each team lead is ____ for the security of their service.

en_def: open and honest, with nothing hidden; or clear enough to see through
hi_nuance: In business the meaning is 'honest and open'. Learners sometimes use 'transparent' to mean 'obvious'; that is 'evident' or 'clear'.

examples.en: The company promised to be transparent about the breach.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने उल्लंघन के बारे में पारदर्शी रहने का वादा किया।

examples.en: Pricing should be transparent, with no hidden fees.
examples.hi: मूल्य निर्धारण पारदर्शी होना चाहिए, कोई छिपा शुल्क नहीं।

examples.en: Glass is transparent; frosted glass is not.
examples.hi: काँच पारदर्शी होता है; धुँधला काँच नहीं।

examples.en: A transparent process builds trust in the team.
examples.hi: पारदर्शी प्रक्रिया टीम में विश्वास बनाती है।

examples.en: The decision was made in a transparent way.
examples.hi: निर्णय पारदर्शी तरीके से लिया गया।

common_mistake.wrong: His lie was transparent to everyone.
common_mistake.right: His lie was obvious to everyone.
common_mistake.why: 'Transparent' for people or processes means honest, not 'easy to see through'.

cloze.sentence: Be ____ with users about what data you collect.

en_def: the situation, facts, or words around something that help explain its meaning
hi_nuance: Use 'in the context of', 'out of context'. Learners wrongly say 'on this context'.

examples.en: In this context, 'host' means a server, not a person.
examples.hi: इस संदर्भ में 'host' का अर्थ सर्वर है, व्यक्ति नहीं।

examples.en: His words were taken out of context.
examples.hi: उसके शब्दों को संदर्भ से हटकर पेश किया गया।

examples.en: Give me some context before you show the error.
examples.hi: त्रुटि दिखाने से पहले मुझे थोड़ा संदर्भ बताइए।

examples.en: The decision makes sense in the context of the budget cuts.
examples.hi: बजट कटौती के संदर्भ में यह निर्णय समझ में आता है।

examples.en: Words change meaning with context.
examples.hi: संदर्भ के साथ शब्दों का अर्थ बदल जाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: On this context, the fix is simple.
common_mistake.right: In this context, the fix is simple.
common_mistake.why: The preposition with 'context' is 'in'.

cloze.sentence: Never share a screenshot of an error without ____.

en_def: to judge how good, useful, or successful something is
hi_nuance: 'Evaluate' is broader than 'assess'; use it for options, tools, results. Hindi speakers often use 'check' where 'evaluate' is expected.

examples.en: We evaluated three vendors before choosing one.
examples.hi: एक को चुनने से पहले हमने तीन विक्रेताओं का मूल्यांकन किया।

examples.en: The course helps you evaluate your own writing.
examples.hi: यह कोर्स आपको अपने लेखन का मूल्यांकन करने में मदद करता है।

examples.en: It is too early to evaluate the results.
examples.hi: नतीजों का मूल्यांकन करना अभी जल्दबाज़ी होगी।

examples.en: Please evaluate the tool for two weeks and report back.
examples.hi: कृपया दो हफ़्ते टूल को परखें और रिपोर्ट दें।

examples.en: The panel will evaluate each proposal on cost and risk.
examples.hi: पैनल हर प्रस्ताव का मूल्यांकन लागत और जोखिम के आधार पर करेगा।

common_mistake.wrong: We checked the two frameworks and picked one.
common_mistake.right: We evaluated the two frameworks and picked one.
common_mistake.why: 'Check' means to look for errors; 'evaluate' means to compare and judge.

cloze.sentence: Before buying, ____ whether the product fits your needs.

en_def: a set of rules, ideas, or structures that supports how something is done
hi_nuance: In software it is a code library; in business it is a structure of rules. Learners sometimes use 'framework' where 'plan' or 'schedule' is meant.

examples.en: We follow the NIST framework for risk management.
examples.hi: हम जोखिम प्रबंधन के लिए NIST ढाँचे का पालन करते हैं।

examples.en: The app is built on a popular JavaScript framework.
examples.hi: यह ऐप एक लोकप्रिय जावास्क्रिप्ट फ़्रेमवर्क पर बना है।

examples.en: The policy provides a framework for making decisions.
examples.hi: नीति निर्णय लेने के लिए एक रूपरेखा प्रदान करती है।

examples.en: Without a legal framework, the contract is weak.
examples.hi: कानूनी ढाँचे के बिना अनुबंध कमज़ोर है।

examples.en: The team agreed on a simple framework for code reviews.
examples.hi: टीम कोड समीक्षा के लिए एक सरल ढाँचे पर सहमत हुई।

common_mistake.wrong: Send me the framework of tomorrow's meeting.
common_mistake.right: Send me the agenda for tomorrow's meeting.
common_mistake.why: A meeting has an agenda; a framework is a system of rules or a code library.

cloze.sentence: The security ____ lists controls every service must implement.

en_def: to put a plan, decision, or system into action
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'do implementation of'. Just use the verb: 'implement the change'.

examples.en: We implemented two-factor authentication last month.
examples.hi: हमने पिछले महीने दो-कारक प्रमाणीकरण लागू किया।

examples.en: The new policy will be implemented in January.
examples.hi: नई नीति जनवरी में लागू की जाएगी।

examples.en: It is easy to plan but hard to implement.
examples.hi: योजना बनाना आसान है, लागू करना कठिन।

examples.en: She implemented the feature in a single afternoon.
examples.hi: उसने वह फ़ीचर एक ही दोपहर में बना दिया।

examples.en: The recommendations were never fully implemented.
examples.hi: सिफ़ारिशें कभी पूरी तरह लागू नहीं की गईं।

common_mistake.wrong: We will do the implementation of the fix tomorrow.
common_mistake.right: We will implement the fix tomorrow.
common_mistake.why: Prefer the direct verb over 'do the implementation of'.

cloze.sentence: The team will ____ rate limiting on the login endpoint.

en_def: happening at the beginning; first
hi_nuance: Pronounced /ɪˈnɪʃl/, not 'in-i-shi-al'. Learners often use 'initially' where 'at first' is more natural in speech.

examples.en: The initial results look promising.
examples.hi: प्रारंभिक नतीजे आशाजनक दिख रहे हैं।

examples.en: My initial reaction was to say no.
examples.hi: मेरी पहली प्रतिक्रिया मना करने की थी।

examples.en: The initial cost is high, but it saves money later.
examples.hi: शुरुआती लागत ज़्यादा है, लेकिन बाद में यह पैसा बचाता है।

examples.en: Initial access was gained through a phishing email.
examples.hi: प्रारंभिक पहुँच एक फ़िशिंग ईमेल के ज़रिए हासिल की गई।

examples.en: After the initial setup, everything runs automatically.
examples.hi: शुरुआती सेटअप के बाद सब कुछ अपने आप चलता है।

common_mistake.wrong: In the initial, we had only two servers.
common_mistake.right: Initially, we had only two servers.
common_mistake.why: 'Initial' is an adjective; use the adverb 'initially' or 'at first'.

cloze.sentence: The ____ estimate was one week; it took a month.

en_def: a particular way of doing something
hi_nuance: Pronounce 'th' as /θ/ (tongue between teeth), not /t/ or /d/. 'Method of' + -ing or 'method for' + noun.

examples.en: What is the best method for learning vocabulary?
examples.hi: शब्दावली सीखने का सबसे अच्छा तरीका क्या है?

examples.en: We changed our method of testing after the incident.
examples.hi: घटना के बाद हमने अपनी टेस्टिंग की विधि बदल दी।

examples.en: The scientific method relies on evidence.
examples.hi: वैज्ञानिक पद्धति साक्ष्य पर निर्भर करती है।

examples.en: Choose a payment method at checkout.
examples.hi: चेकआउट पर एक भुगतान विधि चुनें।

examples.en: This method is slow but reliable.
examples.hi: यह तरीका धीमा है, पर भरोसेमंद है।

common_mistake.wrong: Tell me the method to solve this.
common_mistake.right: Tell me how to solve this.
common_mistake.why: 'Method to' is stiff; natural English uses 'how to' or 'method for'.

cloze.sentence: Shadowing is a proven ____ for improving accent.

en_def: to happen; to exist in a place; (occur to) to come into someone's mind
hi_nuance: Double the r: 'occurred', 'occurring'. 'It occurred to me' = an idea came to me; learners translate this as 'it came in my mind'.

examples.en: The error occurs only on the first login.
examples.hi: यह त्रुटि केवल पहले लॉगिन पर होती है।

examples.en: The accident occurred at night.
examples.hi: दुर्घटना रात में हुई।

examples.en: It never occurred to me that the cable was loose.
examples.hi: मुझे कभी नहीं सूझा कि केबल ढीली थी।

examples.en: Such errors occur when the disk is full.
examples.hi: ऐसी त्रुटियाँ तब होती हैं जब डिस्क भर जाती है।

examples.en: Earthquakes rarely occur in this region.
examples.hi: इस क्षेत्र में भूकंप शायद ही कभी आते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: An idea came in my mind.
common_mistake.right: An idea occurred to me.
common_mistake.why: 'Came in my mind' is a direct Hindi translation; use 'occurred to me' or 'came to mind'.

cloze.sentence: The crash seems to ____ only under heavy load.

en_def: to notice or become aware of something; to think of something in a particular way
hi_nuance: 'Perceive X as Y' is the key pattern. Learners confuse 'perceive' with 'receive'; the spelling 'ei' is the same, the meaning is not.

examples.en: Users perceive the app as slow, even though it is not.
examples.hi: उपयोगकर्ता ऐप को धीमा समझते हैं, हालाँकि यह धीमा नहीं है।

examples.en: She perceived a change in his tone.
examples.hi: उसने उसके लहजे में बदलाव महसूस किया।

examples.en: Risk is often perceived differently by engineers and managers.
examples.hi: इंजीनियर और प्रबंधक जोखिम को अक्सर अलग तरह से देखते हैं।

examples.en: We perceive colors through light.
examples.hi: हम रंगों को प्रकाश के माध्यम से देखते हैं।

examples.en: He is perceived as a difficult person to work with.
examples.hi: उसे एक ऐसे व्यक्ति के रूप में देखा जाता है जिसके साथ काम करना कठिन है।

common_mistake.wrong: The customers received the update as a downgrade.
common_mistake.right: The customers perceived the update as a downgrade.
common_mistake.why: 'Receive' means get; 'perceive' means see or understand as.

cloze.sentence: Slow feedback makes users ____ the product as broken.

en_def: a set of rules or a plan of action agreed by an organization or government
hi_nuance: Distinguish from 'politics' (राजनीति). An insurance 'policy' is a contract, a company 'policy' is a rule.

examples.en: Our password policy requires twelve characters.
examples.hi: हमारी पासवर्ड नीति में बारह अक्षर ज़रूरी हैं।

examples.en: The company has a strict policy on remote work.
examples.hi: कंपनी की रिमोट काम पर एक सख़्त नीति है।

examples.en: The new policy comes into effect next month.
examples.hi: नई नीति अगले महीने से लागू होती है।

examples.en: It is against policy to share your badge.
examples.hi: अपना बैज साझा करना नीति के विरुद्ध है।

examples.en: She works in public policy research.
examples.hi: वह सार्वजनिक नीति अनुसंधान में काम करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am not interested in office policy.
common_mistake.right: I am not interested in office politics.
common_mistake.why: 'Policy' is a rule; 'politics' is about power and influence.

cloze.sentence: The retention ____ says logs are deleted after ninety days.

en_def: possible in the future; (noun) the ability to develop or succeed
hi_nuance: As a noun it is uncountable: 'has great potential', never 'potentials'. Learners also confuse it with 'potent' (powerful).

examples.en: We identified three potential risks.
examples.hi: हमने तीन संभावित जोखिमों की पहचान की।

examples.en: She has the potential to lead the team.
examples.hi: उसमें टीम का नेतृत्व करने की क्षमता है।

examples.en: This is a potential customer, so be polite.
examples.hi: यह एक संभावित ग्राहक है, इसलिए विनम्र रहें।

examples.en: The tool has potential but needs more work.
examples.hi: इस टूल में क्षमता है, लेकिन इस पर और काम चाहिए।

examples.en: Every open port is a potential entry point.
examples.hi: हर खुला पोर्ट एक संभावित प्रवेश बिंदु है।

common_mistake.wrong: He has many potentials in coding.
common_mistake.right: He has a lot of potential in coding.
common_mistake.why: 'Potential' as a noun is uncountable.

cloze.sentence: Treat every unknown email attachment as a ____ threat.

en_def: a basic rule or belief that guides behavior or how something works
hi_nuance: 'Principle' (rule) vs 'principal' (head of a school, or main). Same sound, different spelling; Hindi speakers mix them in writing.

examples.en: The principle of least privilege limits damage from mistakes.
examples.hi: न्यूनतम विशेषाधिकार का सिद्धांत गलतियों से होने वाले नुकसान को सीमित करता है।

examples.en: She refused on principle to lie to the client.
examples.hi: उसने सिद्धांत के तौर पर ग्राहक से झूठ बोलने से मना कर दिया।

examples.en: In principle, the plan works; in practice, it is hard.
examples.hi: सिद्धांत रूप में योजना काम करती है; व्यवहार में कठिन है।

examples.en: The engine works on a simple principle.
examples.hi: इंजन एक सरल सिद्धांत पर काम करता है।

examples.en: He is a man of strong principles.
examples.hi: वह मज़बूत सिद्धांतों वाला आदमी है।

common_mistake.wrong: The principal of least privilege is important.
common_mistake.right: The principle of least privilege is important.
common_mistake.why: 'Principle' is the rule; 'principal' is a person or means 'main'.

cloze.sentence: A key ____ of good design is to keep things simple.

en_def: an official or established way of doing something, step by step
hi_nuance: 'Procedure' = the fixed steps; 'process' = the overall activity. Indian English uses 'procedure' for both.

examples.en: Follow the incident response procedure exactly.
examples.hi: घटना प्रतिक्रिया प्रक्रिया का ठीक-ठीक पालन करें।

examples.en: The procedure for requesting leave has changed.
examples.hi: छुट्टी माँगने की प्रक्रिया बदल गई है।

examples.en: It is a simple procedure that takes five minutes.
examples.hi: यह एक सरल प्रक्रिया है जिसमें पाँच मिनट लगते हैं।

examples.en: The surgeon explained the procedure to the patient.
examples.hi: सर्जन ने मरीज़ को प्रक्रिया समझाई।

examples.en: Standard operating procedures are stored in the wiki.
examples.hi: मानक संचालन प्रक्रियाएँ विकी में रखी गई हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: What is the procedure to hiring?
common_mistake.right: What is the procedure for hiring?
common_mistake.why: 'Procedure' takes 'for' + noun or -ing.

cloze.sentence: There is a written ____ for rotating the signing keys.

en_def: a series of actions taken to achieve a result; (verb) to deal with or handle
hi_nuance: Stress the first syllable. Learners say 'under process' when native speakers say 'in progress' or 'being processed'.

examples.en: Hiring is a slow process.
examples.hi: भर्ती एक धीमी प्रक्रिया है।
