examples.en: The server processes about a thousand requests per second.
examples.hi: सर्वर प्रति सेकंड लगभग एक हज़ार अनुरोध संसाधित करता है।

examples.en: Your refund is being processed.
examples.hi: आपका रिफ़ंड संसाधित किया जा रहा है।

examples.en: We improved the release process this quarter.
examples.hi: हमने इस तिमाही रिलीज़ प्रक्रिया में सुधार किया।

examples.en: Learning is a process, not an event.
examples.hi: सीखना एक प्रक्रिया है, कोई एक घटना नहीं।

examples.en: Kill the process that is using port 8080.
examples.hi: पोर्ट 8080 का उपयोग कर रही प्रोसेस को बंद करें।

common_mistake.wrong: Your application is under process.
common_mistake.right: Your application is being processed.
common_mistake.why: 'Under process' is Indian officialese; use the passive continuous.

cloze.sentence: Onboarding is a two-week ____ with several checkpoints.

en_def: to need something; to officially demand that something be done
hi_nuance: Not used in continuous: 'this requires', never 'this is requiring'. 'Require someone to do' or 'require that'.

examples.en: This job requires strong writing skills.
examples.hi: इस नौकरी के लिए मज़बूत लेखन कौशल चाहिए।

examples.en: All visitors are required to sign in.
examples.hi: सभी आगंतुकों के लिए साइन-इन करना ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: The update requires a restart.
examples.hi: अपडेट के लिए रीस्टार्ट आवश्यक है।

examples.en: Do you require any further information?
examples.hi: क्या आपको कोई और जानकारी चाहिए?

examples.en: The law requires companies to report breaches within 72 hours.
examples.hi: कानून कंपनियों से 72 घंटों के भीतर उल्लंघन की रिपोर्ट करने की माँग करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The system is requiring a password.
common_mistake.right: The system requires a password.
common_mistake.why: 'Require' is a state verb and is not used in the continuous.

cloze.sentence: Admin actions ____ a second approval.

en_def: something useful that can be used to help achieve a goal, such as money, staff, or materials
hi_nuance: Indian workplaces call people 'resources' ('we need two resources'); native speakers find it cold. Say 'two engineers' or 'two people'.

examples.en: We do not have the resources to rebuild the system.
examples.hi: हमारे पास सिस्टम को फिर से बनाने के संसाधन नहीं हैं।

examples.en: The website is a great resource for learners.
examples.hi: यह वेबसाइट सीखने वालों के लिए एक बेहतरीन संसाधन है।

examples.en: Water is a limited resource.
examples.hi: पानी एक सीमित संसाधन है।

examples.en: Allocate resources to the highest-risk items first.
examples.hi: संसाधनों को सबसे पहले उच्चतम जोखिम वाले मदों में लगाएँ।

examples.en: The container ran out of memory resources.
examples.hi: कंटेनर के मेमोरी संसाधन समाप्त हो गए।

common_mistake.wrong: We need two more resources for the project.
common_mistake.right: We need two more engineers for the project.
common_mistake.why: Calling people 'resources' sounds dehumanizing to native speakers.

cloze.sentence: The team lacked the ____ to test on every device.

en_def: to say or do something as a reaction to something
hi_nuance: 'Respond to' something. Indian English uses 'revert' for 'reply', which native speakers do not understand; use 'respond' or 'reply'.

examples.en: Please respond to the email by Friday.
examples.hi: कृपया शुक्रवार तक ईमेल का जवाब दें।

examples.en: The server did not respond for thirty seconds.
examples.hi: सर्वर ने तीस सेकंड तक कोई प्रतिक्रिया नहीं दी।

examples.en: How did the client respond to the proposal?
examples.hi: ग्राहक ने प्रस्ताव पर कैसी प्रतिक्रिया दी?

examples.en: The team responded quickly to the alert.
examples.hi: टीम ने अलर्ट पर तुरंत प्रतिक्रिया दी।

examples.en: She responded with a short 'no'.
examples.hi: उसने एक छोटे से 'नहीं' के साथ जवाब दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly revert back with the details.
common_mistake.right: Please respond with the details.
common_mistake.why: 'Revert' means to go back to a previous state, and 'revert back' repeats itself.

cloze.sentence: The vendor must ____ to critical reports within 24 hours.

en_def: the position or job someone has; the function something performs
hi_nuance: 'Role' (job) and 'roll' (rotate, bread) sound the same. 'Play a role in' is the main collocation.

examples.en: She applied for a senior role at a bank.
examples.hi: उसने एक बैंक में वरिष्ठ पद के लिए आवेदन किया।

examples.en: Logging plays a key role in incident investigation.
examples.hi: घटना की जाँच में लॉगिंग की एक अहम भूमिका होती है।

examples.en: What is your role on the team?
examples.hi: टीम में आपकी भूमिका क्या है?

examples.en: Assign roles before the meeting starts.
examples.hi: बैठक शुरू होने से पहले भूमिकाएँ तय करें।

examples.en: The admin role has full access.
examples.hi: एडमिन भूमिका के पास पूरी पहुँच है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am in a role of tester.
common_mistake.right: I am a tester.
common_mistake.why: 'In a role of' is heavy; just name the job, or say 'in the role of' for formal contexts.

cloze.sentence: Each user is assigned a ____ that limits what they can do.

en_def: one of the parts that something is divided into
hi_nuance: Learners say 'in the section of' where native speakers just say 'in the X section'. A 'section' of a law is a numbered clause.

examples.en: Read the section on authentication first.
examples.hi: पहले प्रमाणीकरण वाला खंड पढ़ें।

examples.en: The report has five sections.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट में पाँच खंड हैं।

examples.en: This section of the road is closed.
examples.hi: सड़क का यह हिस्सा बंद है।

examples.en: Please fill in every section of the form.
examples.hi: कृपया फ़ॉर्म का हर भाग भरें।

examples.en: The team sits in the back section of the office.
examples.hi: टीम दफ़्तर के पिछले हिस्से में बैठती है।

common_mistake.wrong: See the section of security in the manual.
common_mistake.right: See the security section in the manual.
common_mistake.why: Put the topic before 'section' as an adjective.

cloze.sentence: The findings ____ of the report is the one clients read.

en_def: clearly defined; relating to one particular thing
hi_nuance: Often pronounced 'pacific' by Indian learners; keep the initial /sp/ cluster. 'Specific to' something, 'specific about' details.

examples.en: Be specific: which page shows the error?
examples.hi: स्पष्ट बताइए: किस पेज पर त्रुटि दिखती है?

examples.en: The bug is specific to Safari.
examples.hi: यह बग केवल सफ़ारी में होता है।

examples.en: We need specific examples, not general complaints.
examples.hi: हमें सामान्य शिकायतें नहीं, विशिष्ट उदाहरण चाहिए।

examples.en: Is there a specific reason for the delay?
examples.hi: क्या देरी का कोई विशेष कारण है?

examples.en: The medicine targets a specific type of cell.
examples.hi: यह दवा एक विशिष्ट प्रकार की कोशिका को निशाना बनाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Can you be more specific on the issue?
common_mistake.right: Can you be more specific about the issue?
common_mistake.why: 'Specific about' is the natural collocation for details.

cloze.sentence: Good bug reports are ____ about steps to reproduce.

en_def: the way parts are arranged or organized; a building; (verb) to organize
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers use 'structure' mainly for buildings; in English it is common for essays, teams, and data.

examples.en: The essay has a clear structure: intro, body, conclusion.
examples.hi: निबंध की संरचना स्पष्ट है: भूमिका, मुख्य भाग, निष्कर्ष।

examples.en: We changed the team structure last year.
examples.hi: हमने पिछले साल टीम की संरचना बदली।

examples.en: The bridge is a steel structure.
examples.hi: यह पुल एक इस्पात संरचना है।

examples.en: Structure your day around deep work.
examples.hi: अपने दिन को गहन काम के इर्द-गिर्द व्यवस्थित करें।

examples.en: A JSON object has a nested structure.
examples.hi: एक JSON ऑब्जेक्ट की संरचना नेस्टेड होती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Your essay has no any structure.
common_mistake.right: Your essay has no structure.
common_mistake.why: 'No' and 'any' are not used together.

cloze.sentence: Add headings to give your report a clear ____.

en_def: a set of ideas intended to explain something; an idea not yet proven
hi_nuance: Pronounce the 'th' as /θ/. 'In theory' contrasts with 'in practice'. Learners say 'theoretically speaking' where 'in theory' is enough.

examples.en: In theory, the backup should restore in an hour.
examples.hi: सिद्धांत रूप में, बैकअप एक घंटे में रीस्टोर हो जाना चाहिए।

examples.en: My theory is that the cache is stale.
examples.hi: मेरा अनुमान है कि कैश पुराना है।

examples.en: The course covers both theory and practice.
examples.hi: कोर्स में सिद्धांत और अभ्यास दोनों शामिल हैं।

examples.en: Darwin's theory changed biology.
examples.hi: डार्विन के सिद्धांत ने जीव विज्ञान को बदल दिया।

examples.en: That is a nice theory, but the data disagrees.
examples.hi: यह एक अच्छा सिद्धांत है, लेकिन डेटा इससे असहमत है।

common_mistake.wrong: Theoretically speaking, it should work.
common_mistake.right: In theory, it should work.
common_mistake.why: 'In theory' is shorter and more natural; the longer phrase sounds stiff.

cloze.sentence: In ____ the plan works; in practice, people forget the steps.

en_def: to get or gain something, such as a skill, property, or a company
hi_def: अर्जित करना, प्राप्त करना, अधिग्रहण करना
hi_nuance: Formal. For skills and languages native speakers say 'pick up' in speech and 'acquire' in writing. 'Acquire' is also the business word for buying a company.

examples.en: Children acquire language without formal lessons.
examples.hi: बच्चे बिना औपचारिक पाठ के भाषा सीख लेते हैं।

examples.en: The company acquired a small startup for its technology.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने उसकी तकनीक के लिए एक छोटे स्टार्टअप का अधिग्रहण किया।

examples.en: He acquired a taste for strong coffee in Italy.
examples.hi: इटली में उसे तेज़ कॉफ़ी का शौक़ लग गया।

examples.en: The attacker acquired admin rights within minutes.
examples.hi: हमलावर ने कुछ ही मिनटों में एडमिन अधिकार हासिल कर लिए।

examples.en: You will acquire new skills on the job.
examples.hi: आप काम के दौरान नए कौशल अर्जित करेंगे।

common_mistake.wrong: I acquired the certificate exam last year.
common_mistake.right: I passed the certificate exam last year.
common_mistake.why: You pass an exam and acquire a certificate or a skill.

cloze.sentence: Large firms often ____ startups instead of building the product themselves.

en_def: enough in amount or good enough in quality for a purpose
hi_nuance: 'Adequate' is neutral-to-cool: it means 'enough, not great'. Do not use it as praise. Stress the first syllable.

examples.en: The backup power is adequate for two hours.
examples.hi: बैकअप बिजली दो घंटे के लिए पर्याप्त है।

examples.en: His answer was adequate but not impressive.
examples.hi: उसका जवाब संतोषजनक था, पर प्रभावशाली नहीं।

examples.en: We need adequate time to test before launch.
examples.hi: लॉन्च से पहले हमें टेस्टिंग के लिए पर्याप्त समय चाहिए।

examples.en: The room has adequate light for reading.
examples.hi: कमरे में पढ़ने के लिए पर्याप्त रोशनी है।

examples.en: The controls were not adequate to stop the attack.
examples.hi: नियंत्रण हमले को रोकने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं थे।

common_mistake.wrong: Your presentation was adequate, congratulations!
common_mistake.right: Your presentation was excellent, congratulations!
common_mistake.why: 'Adequate' means barely enough; it sounds like faint praise.

cloze.sentence: Two reviewers are ____ for a small change; five is too many.

en_def: one of two or more choices; something you can use instead
hi_nuance: 'Alternative to' something. Hindi speakers say 'alternative of'. As an adjective it also means 'unconventional' (alternative music).

examples.en: Is there an alternative to rebooting the server?
examples.hi: क्या सर्वर रीबूट करने का कोई विकल्प है?

examples.en: We have no alternative but to delay the launch.
examples.hi: लॉन्च टालने के अलावा हमारे पास कोई विकल्प नहीं है।

examples.en: Take the alternative route if the highway is closed.
examples.hi: अगर हाईवे बंद हो तो वैकल्पिक रास्ता लें।

examples.en: Solar power is a clean alternative to coal.
examples.hi: सौर ऊर्जा कोयले का एक स्वच्छ विकल्प है।

examples.en: She suggested an alternative approach.
examples.hi: उसने एक वैकल्पिक तरीका सुझाया।

common_mistake.wrong: There is no alternative of this tool.
common_mistake.right: There is no alternative to this tool.
common_mistake.why: 'Alternative' takes 'to', not 'of'.

cloze.sentence: Passkeys are a safer ____ to passwords.

en_def: having more than one possible meaning; not clear
hi_nuance: Not the same as 'vague'. 'Ambiguous' = two clear readings; 'vague' = no clear reading at all.

examples.en: The requirement is ambiguous: does 'user' include admins?
examples.hi: आवश्यकता अस्पष्ट है: क्या 'उपयोगकर्ता' में एडमिन शामिल हैं?

examples.en: His reply was deliberately ambiguous.
examples.hi: उसका जवाब जानबूझकर दोअर्थी था।

examples.en: Avoid ambiguous words in a contract.
examples.hi: अनुबंध में दोअर्थी शब्दों से बचें।

examples.en: The error message is ambiguous, so users get confused.
examples.hi: त्रुटि संदेश अस्पष्ट है, इसलिए उपयोगकर्ता भ्रमित होते हैं।

examples.en: The ending of the film is ambiguous on purpose.
examples.hi: फ़िल्म का अंत जानबूझकर अस्पष्ट रखा गया है।

common_mistake.wrong: The instructions are ambiguous; they say nothing at all.
common_mistake.right: The instructions are vague; they say nothing at all.
common_mistake.why: 'Ambiguous' means two possible meanings, not 'empty' or 'unclear in general'.

cloze.sentence: The word 'host' is ____ in this sentence.

en_def: to expect something and prepare for it
hi_def: पूर्वानुमान लगाना, पहले से सोचना, अपेक्षा करना
hi_nuance: 'Anticipate' = expect and prepare. It is stronger than 'expect'. Followed by a noun, -ing, or 'that'; never 'anticipate to'.

examples.en: We anticipate heavy traffic during the sale.
examples.hi: सेल के दौरान हम भारी ट्रैफ़िक की अपेक्षा करते हैं।

examples.en: A good goalkeeper anticipates the shot.
examples.hi: एक अच्छा गोलकीपर शॉट का पहले से अनुमान लगा लेता है।

examples.en: We did not anticipate that the vendor would fail.
examples.hi: हमने यह अनुमान नहीं लगाया था कि विक्रेता विफल हो जाएगा।

examples.en: Try to anticipate the questions the client will ask.
examples.hi: उन सवालों का पहले से अंदाज़ा लगाएँ जो ग्राहक पूछेगा।

examples.en: The launch is anticipated in March.
examples.hi: लॉन्च मार्च में अपेक्षित है।

common_mistake.wrong: We anticipate to finish by Monday.
common_mistake.right: We anticipate finishing by Monday.
common_mistake.why: 'Anticipate' takes an -ing form, not 'to'.

cloze.sentence: Good defenders ____ the attacker's next move.

en_def: easy to see or understand; seeming to be true but perhaps not
hi_nuance: Two meanings: 'it became apparent' = it became obvious; 'his apparent calm' = calm that may be fake. Learners only know the first.

examples.en: It soon became apparent that the fix had not worked.
examples.hi: जल्द ही स्पष्ट हो गया कि फ़िक्स काम नहीं आया था।

examples.en: For no apparent reason, the service stopped.
examples.hi: बिना किसी स्पष्ट कारण के सेवा बंद हो गई।

examples.en: Her apparent confidence hid a lot of worry.
examples.hi: उसका ऊपरी आत्मविश्वास बहुत सारी चिंता छिपाए हुए था।

examples.en: The apparent cause was a power cut.
examples.hi: प्रत्यक्ष कारण बिजली कटौती थी।

examples.en: It is apparent from the logs that someone logged in at 3 a.m.
examples.hi: लॉग से स्पष्ट है कि कोई रात तीन बजे लॉग इन हुआ।

common_mistake.wrong: Apparently, the server is down (meaning: clearly).
common_mistake.right: Clearly, the server is down.
common_mistake.why: 'Apparently' means 'it seems, I heard', not 'clearly'.

cloze.sentence: There was no ____ link between the two incidents.

en_def: decided by chance or personal choice, not by reason or a system
hi_nuance: In security 'arbitrary code execution' means the attacker chooses any code. In everyday use it is negative: 'an arbitrary decision' = unfair.

examples.en: The limit of 30 days seems arbitrary.
examples.hi: 30 दिनों की सीमा मनमानी लगती है।

examples.en: The bug allows arbitrary file reads.
examples.hi: यह बग मनमाने फ़ाइल रीड की अनुमति देता है।

examples.en: Staff complained about arbitrary changes to the rules.
examples.hi: कर्मचारियों ने नियमों में मनमाने बदलावों की शिकायत की।

examples.en: Pick an arbitrary number between one and ten.
examples.hi: एक से दस के बीच कोई भी संख्या चुनें।

examples.en: The choice of color was completely arbitrary.
examples.hi: रंग का चुनाव पूरी तरह मनमाना था।

common_mistake.wrong: The attacker can run arbitrary any command.
common_mistake.right: The attacker can run arbitrary commands.
common_mistake.why: 'Arbitrary' already means 'any of their choosing'; drop 'any'.

cloze.sentence: The flaw lets a remote user execute ____ code on the server.

en_def: one part or feature of a situation, idea, or problem
hi_nuance: 'Aspect of' something. Hindi speakers sometimes write 'aspects' alone when 'parts' or 'areas' is meant.

examples.en: Security is only one aspect of software quality.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा सॉफ़्टवेयर गुणवत्ता का केवल एक पहलू है।

examples.en: We looked at every aspect of the proposal.
examples.hi: हमने प्रस्ताव के हर पहलू को देखा।

examples.en: The most difficult aspect of the job is the travel.
examples.hi: नौकरी का सबसे कठिन पहलू यात्रा है।

examples.en: Which aspect of English is hardest for you?
examples.hi: अंग्रेज़ी का कौन सा पहलू आपके लिए सबसे कठिन है?

examples.en: The report ignores the financial aspect.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट वित्तीय पहलू को नज़रअंदाज़ करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: We must improve in all aspects.
common_mistake.right: We must improve in every area.
common_mistake.why: 'All aspects' with no 'of' reads awkwardly; 'every area' or 'every aspect of the work' is natural.

cloze.sentence: Pronunciation is the ____ of English most learners neglect.

en_def: to say that something was caused by or created by someone or something; (noun) a quality or feature
hi_def: कारण मानना, श्रेय देना; गुण, विशेषता
hi_nuance: Verb: /əˈtrɪbjuːt/ stressed on 'trib'. Noun: /ˈætrɪbjuːt/ stressed on 'at'. 'Attribute X to Y'.

examples.en: Experts attribute the breach to a phishing email.
examples.hi: विशेषज्ञ उल्लंघन का कारण एक फ़िशिंग ईमेल मानते हैं।

examples.en: The quote is often attributed to Einstein.
examples.hi: यह उद्धरण अक्सर आइंस्टीन का माना जाता है।

examples.en: Patience is an important attribute in a teacher.
examples.hi: धैर्य शिक्षक का एक महत्वपूर्ण गुण है।

examples.en: She attributes her success to hard work.
examples.hi: वह अपनी सफलता का श्रेय कड़ी मेहनत को देती है।

examples.en: Each element has attributes like id and class.
examples.hi: हर एलिमेंट में id और class जैसे गुण होते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: They attributed the delay on the vendor.
common_mistake.right: They attributed the delay to the vendor.
common_mistake.why: 'Attribute' takes 'to', never 'on'.

cloze.sentence: Analysts ____ the attack to a known criminal group.

en_def: the amount something can hold or produce; the ability to do something; an official role
hi_nuance: 'In my capacity as' = in my role as. Learners confuse 'capacity' with 'capability' (skill). A disk has capacity; a person has capability.

examples.en: The hall has a capacity of five hundred.
examples.hi: हॉल की क्षमता पाँच सौ लोगों की है।

examples.en: The database is running at full capacity.
examples.hi: डेटाबेस पूरी क्षमता पर चल रहा है।

examples.en: She spoke in her capacity as legal advisor.
examples.hi: उसने कानूनी सलाहकार की हैसियत से बात की।

examples.en: We do not have the capacity to take on more work.
examples.hi: हमारे पास और काम लेने की क्षमता नहीं है।

examples.en: Add storage capacity before the logs fill the disk.
examples.hi: लॉग डिस्क भरने से पहले स्टोरेज क्षमता बढ़ाएँ।

common_mistake.wrong: He has the capacity of Python and Go.
common_mistake.right: He has the ability to code in Python and Go.
common_mistake.why: For personal skills use 'ability' or 'capability'; 'capacity' is for volume or roles.

cloze.sentence: The server reached its ____ during the sale and slowed down.

en_def: a fact or condition connected with a situation
hi_nuance: Usually plural: 'under the circumstances', 'in no circumstances'. Learners write 'in this circumstance' where 'in this situation' is natural.

examples.en: Under the circumstances, a delay is reasonable.
examples.hi: इन हालात में देरी उचित है।

examples.en: Under no circumstances should you share the key.
examples.hi: किसी भी परिस्थिति में आपको कुंजी साझा नहीं करनी चाहिए।

examples.en: The circumstances of the outage are still unclear.
examples.hi: आउटेज की परिस्थितियाँ अभी भी अस्पष्ट हैं।

examples.en: She left the job due to family circumstances.
examples.hi: पारिवारिक परिस्थितियों के कारण उसने नौकरी छोड़ दी।

examples.en: Circumstances change, and so must the plan.
examples.hi: हालात बदलते हैं, और योजना को भी बदलना चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: In any circumstance, do not restart the database.
common_mistake.right: Under no circumstances should you restart the database.
common_mistake.why: The fixed phrase is 'under no circumstances', with inversion.

cloze.sentence: Under no ____ should passwords be sent by email.

en_def: logical and well organized; easy to understand because the parts fit together
hi_def: सुसंगत, तर्कसंगत, स्पष्ट रूप से जुड़ा हुआ
hi_nuance: Used for essays, arguments, and plans. Learners mix it with 'consistent'; 'coherent' is about parts fitting together, 'consistent' about staying the same.

examples.en: Your essay needs a more coherent structure.
examples.hi: आपके निबंध को एक अधिक सुसंगत संरचना की ज़रूरत है।

examples.en: He gave a coherent account of what happened.
examples.hi: उसने घटना का एक सुसंगत विवरण दिया।

examples.en: The team lacks a coherent strategy.
examples.hi: टीम के पास एक सुसंगत रणनीति की कमी है।

examples.en: After the accident he was barely coherent.
examples.hi: दुर्घटना के बाद वह मुश्किल से स्पष्ट बोल पा रहा था।

examples.en: Keep your paragraphs coherent by using linking words.
examples.hi: जोड़ने वाले शब्दों का उपयोग करके अपने अनुच्छेदों को सुसंगत रखें।

common_mistake.wrong: His story was not coherent with the logs.
common_mistake.right: His story was not consistent with the logs.
common_mistake.why: 'Consistent with' = agreeing with; 'coherent' describes internal logic.

cloze.sentence: A ____ report tells one story from first alert to fix.

en_def: to pay someone for loss or damage; to make up for something bad
hi_def: क्षतिपूर्ति करना, मुआवज़ा देना, भरपाई करना
hi_nuance: 'Compensate for' a loss; 'compensate someone for' something. Learners drop 'for'.

examples.en: The airline compensated passengers for the delay.
examples.hi: एयरलाइन ने यात्रियों को देरी का मुआवज़ा दिया।

examples.en: Speed cannot compensate for poor accuracy.
examples.hi: गति खराब सटीकता की भरपाई नहीं कर सकती।

examples.en: Extra logging compensates for the missing alerts.
examples.hi: अतिरिक्त लॉगिंग लापता अलर्ट की भरपाई करती है।

examples.en: Nothing can compensate for lost data.
examples.hi: खोए हुए डेटा की भरपाई कुछ नहीं कर सकता।

examples.en: Staff are compensated well for weekend work.
examples.hi: सप्ताहांत के काम के लिए कर्मचारियों को अच्छा भुगतान मिलता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The company compensated the loss.
common_mistake.right: The company compensated us for the loss.
common_mistake.why: You compensate a person for a loss; the loss itself is not the object.

cloze.sentence: A firewall rule can ____ for a patch that cannot be applied yet.

en_def: made of many connected parts; difficult to understand
hi_nuance: 'Complex' = many parts; 'complicated' = hard to deal with (often negative). Indian English says 'complexed'; that word does not exist in this sense.

examples.en: Modern supply chains are extremely complex.
examples.hi: आधुनिक आपूर्ति शृंखलाएँ बेहद जटिल हैं।

examples.en: This is a complex issue with no easy answer.
examples.hi: यह एक जटिल मुद्दा है जिसका कोई आसान जवाब नहीं है।

examples.en: The system is too complex for one person to understand.
examples.hi: यह सिस्टम इतना जटिल है कि एक व्यक्ति इसे नहीं समझ सकता।

examples.en: She enjoys solving complex problems.
examples.hi: उसे जटिल समस्याएँ हल करने में मज़ा आता है।

examples.en: They live in a large apartment complex.
examples.hi: वे एक बड़े अपार्टमेंट परिसर में रहते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: The setup is very complexed.
common_mistake.right: The setup is very complex.
common_mistake.why: 'Complex' is already an adjective; 'complexed' is not a word here.

cloze.sentence: Attack chains can be ____, involving five or six steps.

en_def: including everything or nearly everything; complete
hi_nuance: Not 'comprehensible' (understandable). 'A comprehensive report' covers everything; 'a comprehensible report' is easy to read.

examples.en: We ran a comprehensive scan of the network.
examples.hi: हमने नेटवर्क का व्यापक स्कैन किया।

examples.en: The guide is comprehensive but easy to follow.
examples.hi: गाइड व्यापक है, पर अनुसरण करने में आसान है।

examples.en: She has comprehensive knowledge of tax law.
examples.hi: उसे कर कानून का विस्तृत ज्ञान है।

examples.en: The insurance policy is comprehensive.
examples.hi: बीमा पॉलिसी समग्र है।

examples.en: A comprehensive review found twelve issues.
examples.hi: एक व्यापक समीक्षा में बारह समस्याएँ मिलीं।

common_mistake.wrong: The manual is not comprehensive; I cannot understand it.
common_mistake.right: The manual is not comprehensible; I cannot understand it.
common_mistake.why: 'Comprehensive' means complete; 'comprehensible' means understandable.

cloze.sentence: The audit was ____, covering every server and every account.

en_def: to imagine or think of an idea; to become pregnant
hi_nuance: 'Conceive of' + noun; 'conceive that'. Learners confuse with 'concede' (admit). Spelling: 'ei' after c.

examples.en: It is hard to conceive of a world without the internet.
examples.hi: इंटरनेट के बिना दुनिया की कल्पना करना कठिन है।

examples.en: The project was conceived as a small experiment.
examples.hi: यह परियोजना एक छोटे प्रयोग के रूप में सोची गई थी।

examples.en: I cannot conceive why anyone would disable the firewall.
examples.hi: मैं सोच भी नहीं सकता कि कोई फ़ायरवॉल क्यों बंद करेगा।

examples.en: She conceived the idea during a long train ride.
examples.hi: उसे यह विचार एक लंबी ट्रेन यात्रा के दौरान आया।

examples.en: The couple were unable to conceive for years.
examples.hi: दंपति वर्षों तक गर्भधारण नहीं कर सके।

common_mistake.wrong: I conceive that we were wrong.
common_mistake.right: I concede that we were wrong.
common_mistake.why: 'Concede' means admit; 'conceive' means imagine.

cloze.sentence: The app was originally ____ as a tool for students.

en_def: to organize and carry out an activity; (noun) behavior
hi_nuance: Verb /kənˈdʌkt/, noun /ˈkɒndʌkt/. You 'conduct a test/survey/investigation'. Learners say 'do a survey' in formal reports.

examples.en: We conducted a penetration test last quarter.
examples.hi: हमने पिछली तिमाही में एक पेनिट्रेशन टेस्ट किया।

examples.en: The interview was conducted in English.
examples.hi: साक्षात्कार अंग्रेज़ी में लिया गया।

examples.en: His conduct during the meeting was unprofessional.
examples.hi: बैठक के दौरान उसका आचरण अव्यावसायिक था।

examples.en: Researchers conducted the survey over six months.
examples.hi: शोधकर्ताओं ने छह महीने में सर्वेक्षण किया।

examples.en: Please conduct the review before Friday.
examples.hi: कृपया शुक्रवार से पहले समीक्षा करें।

common_mistake.wrong: We made a security audit in May.
common_mistake.right: We conducted a security audit in May.
common_mistake.why: Audits, tests, and surveys are 'conducted' or 'carried out', not 'made'.

cloze.sentence: The team will ____ a full investigation into the leak.

en_def: a serious disagreement or fight; a situation where two things cannot both be true
hi_nuance: Noun stress on 'con', verb (/kənˈflɪkt/) stress on 'flict'. 'Conflict with' something; 'conflict between' two things.

examples.en: There is a conflict between speed and security.
examples.hi: गति और सुरक्षा के बीच टकराव है।

examples.en: The new rule conflicts with the old policy.
examples.hi: नया नियम पुरानी नीति से टकराता है।

examples.en: A merge conflict blocked the release.
examples.hi: एक मर्ज कॉन्फ़्लिक्ट ने रिलीज़ रोक दी।

examples.en: She avoids conflict at work.
examples.hi: वह काम पर टकराव से बचती है।

examples.en: The meeting conflicts with my dentist appointment.
examples.hi: बैठक मेरे दंत चिकित्सक की अपॉइंटमेंट से टकरा रही है।

common_mistake.wrong: The two reports are conflicting each other.
common_mistake.right: The two reports conflict with each other.
common_mistake.why: Use the simple present with 'with', not the continuous.

cloze.sentence: Declare any ____ of interest before the review.

en_def: large in amount, size, or importance
hi_nuance: 'Considerable' (large) vs 'considerate' (thoughtful, kind). Learners swap them.

examples.en: The migration took considerable time and effort.
examples.hi: माइग्रेशन में काफ़ी समय और मेहनत लगी।

examples.en: There was considerable interest in the talk.
examples.hi: वार्ता में काफ़ी रुचि थी।

examples.en: She has considerable experience with cloud systems.
examples.hi: उसे क्लाउड सिस्टम का काफ़ी अनुभव है।

examples.en: The outage caused considerable damage to our reputation.
examples.hi: आउटेज से हमारी प्रतिष्ठा को काफ़ी नुकसान हुआ।

examples.en: A considerable number of users still use old browsers.
examples.hi: उपयोगकर्ताओं की एक बड़ी संख्या अब भी पुराने ब्राउज़र इस्तेमाल करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Thank you for being so considerable.
common_mistake.right: Thank you for being so considerate.
common_mistake.why: 'Considerate' means thoughtful of others; 'considerable' means large.

cloze.sentence: The fix required ____ changes to the authentication code.

en_def: to be or form something; to be considered as
hi_nuance: Formal; not used in continuous or passive in this sense. 'X constitutes Y' = X is/counts as Y. Learners confuse with 'constitution'.

examples.en: Sharing a password constitutes a policy violation.
examples.hi: पासवर्ड साझा करना नीति का उल्लंघन माना जाता है।

examples.en: Women constitute forty percent of the team.
examples.hi: टीम में चालीस प्रतिशत महिलाएँ हैं।

examples.en: What constitutes a critical vulnerability?
examples.hi: किसे गंभीर भेद्यता माना जाता है?

examples.en: These twelve people constitute the committee.
examples.hi: ये बारह लोग समिति का गठन करते हैं।

examples.en: Silence does not constitute agreement.
examples.hi: चुप्पी सहमति नहीं मानी जाती।

common_mistake.wrong: This is constituting a breach.
common_mistake.right: This constitutes a breach.
common_mistake.why: 'Constitute' is a state verb; use the simple present.

cloze.sentence: Reading another user's email ____ unauthorized access.

en_def: something that limits what you can do
hi_nuance: 'Constraint on' something. Common in project talk: 'time constraints', 'budget constraints'. Learners say 'limitations' for everything.

examples.en: We could not test everything because of time constraints.
examples.hi: समय की कमी के कारण हम सब कुछ टेस्ट नहीं कर सके।

examples.en: Budget is the main constraint on this project.
examples.hi: इस परियोजना में बजट मुख्य बाधा है।

examples.en: The database enforces a unique constraint on email.
examples.hi: डेटाबेस ईमेल पर एक अद्वितीय बाधा लागू करता है।

examples.en: Work within the constraints you have.
examples.hi: जो सीमाएँ आपके पास हैं, उनके भीतर काम करें।

examples.en: Legal constraints prevent us from storing that data.
examples.hi: कानूनी प्रतिबंध हमें वह डेटा संग्रहीत करने से रोकते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Due to time constraint, we skipped testing.
common_mistake.right: Due to time constraints, we skipped testing.
common_mistake.why: The set phrase uses the plural.

cloze.sentence: Memory is the main ____ on this small device.

en_def: to ask an expert for advice; to look at a document for information
hi_nuance: 'Consult a doctor', 'consult the manual' (no preposition). 'Consult with' = discuss with colleagues. Learners say 'consult to'.

examples.en: You should consult a lawyer before signing.
examples.hi: हस्ताक्षर करने से पहले आपको वकील से सलाह लेनी चाहिए।

examples.en: Consult the documentation before asking the team.
examples.hi: टीम से पूछने से पहले दस्तावेज़ देखें।

examples.en: We consulted with the legal team about the disclosure.
examples.hi: हमने खुलासे के बारे में कानूनी टीम से परामर्श किया।

examples.en: Doctors recommend consulting a specialist.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर विशेषज्ञ से सलाह लेने की सलाह देते हैं।

examples.en: She was not consulted about the change.
examples.hi: बदलाव के बारे में उससे सलाह नहीं ली गई।

common_mistake.wrong: Please consult to the security team first.
common_mistake.right: Please consult the security team first.
common_mistake.why: 'Consult' takes a direct object, no 'to'.

cloze.sentence: Always ____ the runbook before restarting a production service.

en_def: to say the opposite of what someone said; to be in conflict with something
hi_def: खंडन करना, विरोध करना, विपरीत होना
hi_nuance: Direct object, no preposition: 'contradict the report'. Learners say 'contradict with'.

examples.en: The logs contradict the user's account of events.
examples.hi: लॉग उपयोगकर्ता के घटनाक्रम के विवरण का खंडन करते हैं।

examples.en: Do not contradict your manager in front of clients.
examples.hi: ग्राहकों के सामने अपने मैनेजर का खंडन न करें।

examples.en: The two witnesses contradicted each other.
examples.hi: दोनों गवाहों ने एक-दूसरे का खंडन किया।

examples.en: His actions contradict his words.
examples.hi: उसके काम उसकी बातों के विपरीत हैं।

examples.en: New evidence contradicts the earlier theory.
examples.hi: नए सबूत पहले के सिद्धांत का खंडन करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This finding contradicts with the vendor's statement.
common_mistake.right: This finding contradicts the vendor's statement.
common_mistake.why: 'Contradict' takes a direct object; no 'with'.

cloze.sentence: The timestamps ____ the claim that nobody logged in.

en_def: a lot of public disagreement or argument about something
hi_nuance: American stress on 'con'; British often 'con-TROV-ersy'. Either is fine, but keep it consistent. Adjective 'controversial' is stressed on 'ver'.

examples.en: The new data policy caused a lot of controversy.
examples.hi: नई डेटा नीति ने बहुत विवाद पैदा किया।

examples.en: The decision to pay the ransom was surrounded by controversy.
examples.hi: फिरौती देने का निर्णय विवादों से घिरा रहा।

examples.en: There is still controversy over who was responsible.
examples.hi: इस पर अब भी विवाद है कि ज़िम्मेदार कौन था।

examples.en: The film sparked controversy in several countries.
examples.hi: फ़िल्म ने कई देशों में विवाद खड़ा कर दिया।

examples.en: He avoids controversy and keeps his opinions private.
examples.hi: वह विवाद से बचता है और अपनी राय निजी रखता है।

common_mistake.wrong: There is a big controversy about between the two teams.
common_mistake.right: There is a big controversy between the two teams.
common_mistake.why: Use one preposition: 'controversy between' or 'controversy over'.

cloze.sentence: Full disclosure of bugs is still a matter of ____.

en_def: to organize different people or activities so they work together well
hi_nuance: 'Coordinate with' someone; 'coordinate' + activity. Indian English overuses 'coordinate with' to mean 'talk to'.

examples.en: She coordinates the release across four teams.
examples.hi: वह चार टीमों के बीच रिलीज़ का समन्वय करती है।

examples.en: We need to coordinate with the vendor before disclosure.
examples.hi: खुलासे से पहले हमें विक्रेता के साथ समन्वय करना होगा।

examples.en: The response was poorly coordinated.
examples.hi: प्रतिक्रिया का समन्वय खराब था।

examples.en: Coordinate your schedules so someone is always on call.
examples.hi: अपने कार्यक्रम इस तरह मिलाएँ कि हमेशा कोई ऑन-कॉल रहे।

examples.en: A coordinated attack hit three banks at once.
examples.hi: एक समन्वित हमले ने एक साथ तीन बैंकों को निशाना बनाया।

common_mistake.wrong: I will coordinate with him about lunch.
common_mistake.right: I will check with him about lunch.
common_mistake.why: 'Coordinate' is for organizing work between groups, not casual chats.

cloze.sentence: The security lead will ____ the response with legal and PR.

en_def: the standards used to judge or decide something (plural of criterion)
hi_nuance: 'Criteria' is plural; the singular is 'criterion'. Learners write 'a criteria' and 'criterias', both wrong.

examples.en: What are the criteria for a critical rating?
examples.hi: गंभीर रेटिंग के मानदंड क्या हैं?

examples.en: The proposal meets all our criteria.
examples.hi: प्रस्ताव हमारे सभी मानदंडों को पूरा करता है।

examples.en: Cost is only one criterion; security is another.
examples.hi: लागत केवल एक मानदंड है; सुरक्षा दूसरा है।

examples.en: Set clear acceptance criteria before development starts.
examples.hi: विकास शुरू होने से पहले स्पष्ट स्वीकृति मानदंड तय करें।

examples.en: Candidates are judged against five criteria.
examples.hi: उम्मीदवारों को पाँच मानदंडों पर परखा जाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: This is the main criteria for selection.
common_mistake.right: This is the main criterion for selection.
common_mistake.why: 'Criteria' is plural; one standard is a 'criterion'.

cloze.sentence: A bug is closed only when all acceptance ____ are met.

en_def: extremely important because everything else depends on it
hi_nuance: Stronger than 'important'. Do not write 'very crucial' or 'most crucial'; it is already absolute.

examples.en: Timing is crucial in incident response.
examples.hi: घटना प्रतिक्रिया में समय अत्यंत महत्वपूर्ण है।

examples.en: It is crucial that we back up the data first.
examples.hi: यह बेहद ज़रूरी है कि हम पहले डेटा का बैकअप लें।

examples.en: Her support was crucial to the project.
examples.hi: उसका समर्थन परियोजना के लिए निर्णायक था।

examples.en: The next two weeks are crucial for the launch.
examples.hi: अगले दो हफ़्ते लॉन्च के लिए बेहद अहम हैं।

examples.en: Logs played a crucial role in finding the attacker.
examples.hi: हमलावर को खोजने में लॉग की निर्णायक भूमिका रही।

common_mistake.wrong: This step is very crucial.
common_mistake.right: This step is crucial.
common_mistake.why: 'Crucial' is an absolute adjective; 'very' adds nothing.

cloze.sentence: The first hour after a breach is ____.

en_def: to decrease; to politely refuse
hi_def: घटना, गिरावट आना; विनम्रता से मना करना
hi_nuance: Two meanings. For refusing, 'decline' is polite and formal; 'refuse' is blunt. 'Decline to' + verb.

examples.en: Sales declined by ten percent last quarter.
examples.hi: पिछली तिमाही बिक्री में दस प्रतिशत की गिरावट आई।

examples.en: She declined the job offer.
examples.hi: उसने नौकरी का प्रस्ताव अस्वीकार कर दिया।

examples.en: The vendor declined to comment on the breach.
examples.hi: विक्रेता ने उल्लंघन पर टिप्पणी करने से इनकार कर दिया।

examples.en: Interest in the product is in decline.
examples.hi: उत्पाद में रुचि घट रही है।

examples.en: His health declined rapidly after the surgery.
examples.hi: सर्जरी के बाद उसका स्वास्थ्य तेज़ी से गिरा।

common_mistake.wrong: I declined for the meeting invitation.
common_mistake.right: I declined the meeting invitation.
common_mistake.why: 'Decline' takes a direct object, no 'for'.

cloze.sentence: The number of phishing reports ____ after the training.

en_def: to show clearly how something works or that something is true
hi_nuance: Stress on 'dem'. Hindi speakers say 'give a demo' in speech; in writing use 'demonstrate'. Also 'demonstrate' can mean to protest publicly.

examples.en: The researcher demonstrated the exploit live.
examples.hi: शोधकर्ता ने लाइव एक्सप्लॉइट प्रदर्शित किया।

examples.en: Your report should demonstrate real impact, not just theory.
examples.hi: आपकी रिपोर्ट को सिर्फ़ सिद्धांत नहीं, वास्तविक प्रभाव दिखाना चाहिए।

examples.en: He demonstrated how to reset the device.
examples.hi: उसने दिखाया कि डिवाइस को कैसे रीसेट किया जाता है।

examples.en: The results demonstrate that the fix works.
examples.hi: नतीजे सिद्ध करते हैं कि फ़िक्स काम करता है।

examples.en: Thousands demonstrated against the new law.
examples.hi: हज़ारों लोगों ने नए कानून के विरोध में प्रदर्शन किया।

common_mistake.wrong: Let me demonstrate you the feature.
common_mistake.right: Let me demonstrate the feature to you.
common_mistake.why: 'Demonstrate' does not take two objects; use 'to you'.

cloze.sentence: A proof of concept should ____ the vulnerability without causing damage.

en_def: to be a sign of something; to mean or represent
hi_def: सूचित करना, दर्शाना, का अर्थ होना
hi_nuance: Formal and technical. 'Denote' = literally mean; 'connote' = suggest. In code and math, symbols 'denote' values.

examples.en: In this diagram, red denotes a critical path.
examples.hi: इस आरेख में लाल रंग गंभीर मार्ग को दर्शाता है।

examples.en: The asterisk denotes a required field.
examples.hi: तारांकन एक आवश्यक फ़ील्ड को सूचित करता है।

examples.en: The letter n denotes the number of items.
examples.hi: अक्षर n वस्तुओं की संख्या को दर्शाता है।

examples.en: A high CVSS score denotes severe risk.
examples.hi: उच्च CVSS स्कोर गंभीर जोखिम को दर्शाता है।

examples.en: The word 'home' denotes a place but connotes warmth.
examples.hi: 'घर' शब्द एक स्थान को दर्शाता है पर अपनापन भी जताता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The green tick is denoting the pass.
common_mistake.right: The green tick denotes a pass.
common_mistake.why: 'Denote' is a state verb; no continuous form.

cloze.sentence: In the logs, a 401 status ____ a failed login.

en_def: to move away from what is usual, planned, or expected
hi_nuance: 'Deviate from' a plan or standard. The noun 'deviation' is used in statistics ('standard deviation') and in security ('deviation from baseline').

examples.en: Do not deviate from the approved test plan.
examples.hi: स्वीकृत परीक्षण योजना से विचलित न हों।

examples.en: The system flags any traffic that deviates from normal.
examples.hi: सिस्टम सामान्य से हटकर किसी भी ट्रैफ़िक को चिह्नित करता है।

examples.en: The speaker deviated from her prepared notes.
examples.hi: वक्ता अपने तैयार नोट्स से भटक गई।

examples.en: Results that deviate too much are re-checked.
examples.hi: जो नतीजे बहुत ज़्यादा भिन्न होते हैं, उन्हें दोबारा जाँचा जाता है।

examples.en: The pilot deviated from the flight path to avoid the storm.
examples.hi: पायलट तूफ़ान से बचने के लिए उड़ान पथ से हट गया।

common_mistake.wrong: The process deviated with the standard.
common_mistake.right: The process deviated from the standard.
common_mistake.why: 'Deviate' takes 'from'.

cloze.sentence: Alert on any login pattern that ____ from the user's baseline.

en_def: a measurement of size; one aspect or side of a situation
hi_nuance: Pronounced 'dye-MEN-shun' (US) or 'di-MEN-shun' (UK). Beyond height and width, it means a 'new side' of an issue: 'adds a new dimension'.

examples.en: Please send the dimensions of the server rack.
examples.hi: कृपया सर्वर रैक के माप भेजें।

examples.en: Remote work adds a new dimension to security.
examples.hi: रिमोट काम सुरक्षा में एक नया आयाम जोड़ता है।

examples.en: The problem has a legal dimension as well.
examples.hi: समस्या का एक कानूनी पहलू भी है।

examples.en: A cube has three dimensions.
examples.hi: घन के तीन आयाम होते हैं।

examples.en: The social dimension of the project was ignored.
examples.hi: परियोजना के सामाजिक पहलू की अनदेखी की गई।

common_mistake.wrong: What is the dimension of this box?
common_mistake.right: What are the dimensions of this box?
common_mistake.why: A physical object has several dimensions; use the plural.

cloze.sentence: AI adds a new ____ to phishing attacks.

en_def: clearly different or separate; easy to notice
hi_nuance: 'Distinct from' = different from. 'Distinctive' = characteristic, recognizable. Learners use them interchangeably.

examples.en: These are two distinct problems and need two fixes.
examples.hi: ये दो अलग समस्याएँ हैं और इन्हें दो फ़िक्स चाहिए।

examples.en: There was a distinct smell of smoke.
examples.hi: धुएँ की एक स्पष्ट गंध थी।

examples.en: Authentication is distinct from authorization.
examples.hi: प्रमाणीकरण प्राधिकरण से अलग है।

examples.en: The query returns only distinct values.
examples.hi: क्वेरी केवल विशिष्ट मान लौटाती है।

examples.en: She has a distinct advantage in experience.
examples.hi: अनुभव में उसे स्पष्ट बढ़त हासिल है।

common_mistake.wrong: Her voice is very distinct; you recognize it at once.
common_mistake.right: Her voice is very distinctive; you recognize it at once.
common_mistake.why: 'Distinctive' means recognizable; 'distinct' means separate or clear.

cloze.sentence: The two accounts belong to ____ users, not one person.

en_def: to give or send things to several people or places; to spread over an area
hi_nuance: Stress on 'trib'. 'Distribute X to/among people'. In tech, 'distributed system' means spread across machines.

examples.en: The report was distributed to all managers.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट सभी प्रबंधकों को वितरित की गई।

examples.en: Malware was distributed through a fake update.
examples.hi: मैलवेयर एक नकली अपडेट के ज़रिए फैलाया गया।

examples.en: Distribute the work evenly across the team.
examples.hi: काम को टीम में समान रूप से बाँटें।

examples.en: The app is distributed through the official store only.
examples.hi: ऐप केवल आधिकारिक स्टोर के ज़रिए वितरित किया जाता है।

examples.en: Load is distributed across three servers.
examples.hi: लोड तीन सर्वरों में वितरित है।

common_mistake.wrong: Please DIS-tri-bute the forms.
common_mistake.right: Please dis-TRIB-ute the forms.
common_mistake.why: The stress is on the second syllable.

cloze.sentence: The attacker used a botnet to ____ spam.

en_def: including many different types of people or things
hi_nuance: 'Diverse' describes a group; 'different' compares items. 'A diverse team', not 'a different team' (which means another team).

examples.en: The team is diverse, with people from eight countries.
examples.hi: टीम विविध है, जिसमें आठ देशों के लोग हैं।

examples.en: The city has a diverse food culture.
examples.hi: शहर की खान-पान संस्कृति विविध है।

examples.en: We tested on a diverse set of devices.
examples.hi: हमने विविध प्रकार के उपकरणों पर परीक्षण किया।

examples.en: Her interests are diverse, from chess to rock climbing.
examples.hi: उसकी रुचियाँ शतरंज से लेकर रॉक क्लाइम्बिंग तक विविध हैं।

examples.en: Diverse opinions lead to better decisions.
examples.hi: विविध राय बेहतर निर्णयों की ओर ले जाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: We have different range of products.
common_mistake.right: We have a diverse range of products.
common_mistake.why: 'A diverse range' is the collocation; 'different' also needs an article.

cloze.sentence: A ____ test set catches bugs that a single device would miss.

en_def: to have control or the most important position; to be the largest part of something
hi_nuance: Direct object: 'dominate the market'. Learners say 'dominate on/over'. 'Dominant' is the adjective; 'dominating' as an adjective means bossy.

examples.en: One vendor dominates the antivirus market.
examples.hi: एक विक्रेता एंटीवायरस बाज़ार पर हावी है।

examples.en: Security concerns dominated the meeting.
examples.hi: बैठक में सुरक्षा चिंताएँ छाई रहीं।

examples.en: Try not to dominate the conversation.
examples.hi: बातचीत पर हावी न होने की कोशिश करें।

examples.en: Mobile traffic now dominates our analytics.
examples.hi: मोबाइल ट्रैफ़िक अब हमारे एनालिटिक्स पर हावी है।

examples.en: The tall tower dominates the skyline.
examples.hi: ऊँची मीनार क्षितिज पर छाई रहती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Cloud providers dominate over the industry.
common_mistake.right: Cloud providers dominate the industry.
common_mistake.why: 'Dominate' takes a direct object; no 'over'.

cloze.sentence: Phishing continues to ____ the list of initial attack vectors.

en_def: to remove or get rid of something completely
hi_nuance: Stronger than 'reduce'. In sport, 'eliminated' = knocked out. Learners use 'eliminate' where 'reduce' is honest; say 'reduce' unless the risk is fully gone.

examples.en: The patch eliminates the vulnerability entirely.
examples.hi: यह पैच भेद्यता को पूरी तरह समाप्त कर देता है।

examples.en: We eliminated three steps from the checkout process.
examples.hi: हमने चेकआउट प्रक्रिया से तीन चरण हटा दिए।

examples.en: You cannot eliminate risk, only manage it.
examples.hi: आप जोखिम को खत्म नहीं कर सकते, केवल प्रबंधित कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: India was eliminated in the semifinal.
examples.hi: भारत सेमीफ़ाइनल में बाहर हो गया।

examples.en: The new policy eliminated the need for paper forms.
examples.hi: नई नीति ने काग़ज़ी फ़ॉर्म की ज़रूरत खत्म कर दी।

common_mistake.wrong: MFA eliminates the risk of account takeover.
common_mistake.right: MFA greatly reduces the risk of account takeover.
common_mistake.why: 'Eliminate' means remove completely; overstating it weakens a security report.

cloze.sentence: Input validation can ____ an entire class of injection bugs.

en_def: to appear or come out; to become known
hi_nuance: 'Emerge from' a place; 'it emerged that' = it became known. Learners confuse with 'immerse' (dip into).

examples.en: New details emerged during the investigation.
examples.hi: जाँच के दौरान नए विवरण सामने आए।

examples.en: It emerged that the key had been leaked months ago.
examples.hi: पता चला कि कुंजी महीनों पहले लीक हो चुकी थी।

examples.en: A clear pattern emerged from the data.
examples.hi: डेटा से एक स्पष्ट पैटर्न उभरा।

examples.en: She emerged from the meeting looking tired.
examples.hi: वह बैठक से थकी हुई बाहर निकली।

examples.en: Ransomware emerged as the top threat this year.
examples.hi: इस साल रैंसमवेयर सबसे बड़े खतरे के रूप में उभरा।

common_mistake.wrong: A new competitor has emerged out.
common_mistake.right: A new competitor has emerged.
common_mistake.why: 'Emerge' already contains the idea of 'out'; do not add it.

cloze.sentence: Deepfakes have ____ as a new tool for social engineering.

en_def: to give special importance to something, especially when speaking or writing
hi_nuance: Direct object: 'emphasize the point'. Learners say 'emphasize on'. The noun is 'emphasis' and does take 'on': 'put emphasis on'.

examples.en: The trainer emphasized the importance of backups.
examples.hi: प्रशिक्षक ने बैकअप के महत्व पर ज़ोर दिया।

examples.en: I cannot emphasize this enough: test before you deploy.
examples.hi: मैं इस पर जितना ज़ोर दूँ कम है: डिप्लॉय से पहले टेस्ट करें।

examples.en: The report emphasizes the need for training.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट प्रशिक्षण की ज़रूरत पर ज़ोर देती है।

examples.en: Use bold text to emphasize key words.
examples.hi: मुख्य शब्दों पर ज़ोर देने के लिए बोल्ड टेक्स्ट का प्रयोग करें।

examples.en: She emphasized that the risk was low.
examples.hi: उसने ज़ोर देकर कहा कि जोखिम कम था।

common_mistake.wrong: He emphasized on the need for MFA.
common_mistake.right: He emphasized the need for MFA.
common_mistake.why: The verb takes a direct object; only the noun 'emphasis' takes 'on'.

cloze.sentence: Good reports ____ business impact, not just technical detail.

en_def: to make it possible for someone to do something; to switch a feature on
hi_def: सक्षम बनाना, संभव बनाना; चालू करना
hi_nuance: 'Enable someone to do'. Learners write 'enable to do' without an object, or 'enable doing'. In tech, 'enable' is the opposite of 'disable'.

examples.en: The API enables developers to build integrations.
examples.hi: API डेवलपरों को इंटीग्रेशन बनाने में सक्षम बनाता है।

examples.en: Please enable two-factor authentication today.
examples.hi: कृपया आज ही दो-कारक प्रमाणीकरण चालू करें।

examples.en: Better tools enabled the team to ship faster.
examples.hi: बेहतर टूल्स ने टीम को तेज़ी से शिप करने में सक्षम बनाया।

examples.en: This setting enables logging for all requests.
examples.hi: यह सेटिंग सभी अनुरोधों के लिए लॉगिंग चालू करती है।

examples.en: Scholarships enable poor students to study abroad.
examples.hi: छात्रवृत्तियाँ गरीब छात्रों को विदेश में पढ़ने में सक्षम बनाती हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This feature enables to share files.
common_mistake.right: This feature enables users to share files.
common_mistake.why: 'Enable' needs an object before 'to'.

cloze.sentence: Audit logs ____ us to trace every admin action.

en_def: to experience or meet something, often unexpectedly, especially a problem
hi_nuance: 'Encounter a problem/error' is the natural phrase in tech writing. Learners say 'face an error' or 'get an error', which are fine in speech but less formal.

examples.en: Users encounter an error when they upload large files.
examples.hi: बड़ी फ़ाइलें अपलोड करते समय उपयोगकर्ताओं को त्रुटि मिलती है।

examples.en: We encountered unexpected resistance from the vendor.
examples.hi: हमें विक्रेता से अप्रत्याशित विरोध का सामना करना पड़ा।

examples.en: I encountered an old colleague at the conference.
examples.hi: सम्मेलन में मेरी एक पुराने सहकर्मी से मुलाक़ात हुई।

examples.en: If you encounter any issues, contact support.
examples.hi: अगर कोई समस्या आए तो सहायता से संपर्क करें।

examples.en: The scan encountered three hosts that did not respond.
examples.hi: स्कैन को तीन ऐसे होस्ट मिले जिन्होंने प्रतिक्रिया नहीं दी।

common_mistake.wrong: I encountered with an error on login.
common_mistake.right: I encountered an error on login.
common_mistake.why: 'Encounter' takes a direct object; no 'with'.

cloze.sentence: Report any problem you ____ during the beta.

en_def: to improve the quality, amount, or strength of something
hi_nuance: 'Enhance' is used for quality, reputation, security, and images; not for numbers. You 'increase' sales, but 'enhance' security.

examples.en: The update enhances security without slowing the app.
examples.hi: अपडेट ऐप को धीमा किए बिना सुरक्षा बढ़ाता है।

examples.en: Good lighting enhances the look of a room.
examples.hi: अच्छी रोशनी कमरे की सुंदरता बढ़ाती है।

examples.en: Training enhanced her confidence in meetings.
examples.hi: प्रशिक्षण ने बैठकों में उसका आत्मविश्वास बढ़ाया।

examples.en: We enhanced the logging to capture user agents.
examples.hi: हमने यूज़र एजेंट पकड़ने के लिए लॉगिंग को बेहतर बनाया।

examples.en: A short story can enhance a dull presentation.
examples.hi: एक छोटी कहानी एक नीरस प्रस्तुति को बेहतर बना सकती है।

common_mistake.wrong: We enhanced the number of servers.
common_mistake.right: We increased the number of servers.
common_mistake.why: Numbers are 'increased'; quality is 'enhanced'.

cloze.sentence: Rate limiting will ____ protection against brute-force attacks.

en_def: equal in value, amount, meaning, or importance
hi_nuance: 'Equivalent to' something; as a noun 'the equivalent of'. Learners write 'equivalent with' or 'equivalent as'.

examples.en: One kilobyte is roughly equivalent to a page of text.
examples.hi: एक किलोबाइट लगभग एक पन्ने के पाठ के बराबर है।

examples.en: Her degree is equivalent to a master's in the UK.
examples.hi: उसकी डिग्री यूके के मास्टर्स के समकक्ष है।

examples.en: There is no exact Hindi equivalent of this word.
examples.hi: इस शब्द का कोई सटीक हिन्दी समतुल्य नहीं है।

examples.en: The fine was equivalent to a year's salary.
examples.hi: जुर्माना एक साल के वेतन के बराबर था।

examples.en: The two queries are functionally equivalent.
examples.hi: दोनों क्वेरी कार्यात्मक रूप से समतुल्य हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This certificate is equivalent with a degree.
common_mistake.right: This certificate is equivalent to a degree.
common_mistake.why: 'Equivalent' takes 'to'.

cloze.sentence: Leaving the default password is ____ to having no password at all.

en_def: to be greater than a number, limit, or expectation
hi_nuance: Spelling: 'exceed' with 'ceed', unlike 'precede' and 'proceed'. 'Exceed expectations' is a common phrase in reviews.

examples.en: The file exceeds the 10 MB limit.
examples.hi: फ़ाइल 10 MB की सीमा से अधिक है।

examples.en: Her performance exceeded our expectations.
examples.hi: उसका प्रदर्शन हमारी अपेक्षाओं से बढ़कर रहा।

examples.en: Do not exceed the speed limit.
examples.hi: गति सीमा पार न करें।

examples.en: Costs exceeded the budget by twenty percent.
examples.hi: लागत बजट से बीस प्रतिशत अधिक हो गई।

examples.en: Requests that exceed the rate limit are rejected.
examples.hi: दर सीमा से अधिक अनुरोध अस्वीकार कर दिए जाते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: The usage exceeded than the quota.
common_mistake.right: The usage exceeded the quota.
common_mistake.why: 'Exceed' takes a direct object; do not add 'than'.

cloze.sentence: Memory use must not ____ 512 MB on this plan.

en_def: to deliberately not include something or someone
hi_def: बाहर रखना, अलग करना, शामिल न करना
hi_nuance: 'Exclude from'. The preposition 'excluding' means 'not counting': 'the price excluding tax'.

examples.en: Test files are excluded from the build.
examples.hi: टेस्ट फ़ाइलें बिल्ड से बाहर रखी जाती हैं।

examples.en: The price is 500 rupees, excluding tax.
examples.hi: कीमत 500 रुपये है, कर छोड़कर।

examples.en: Do not exclude anyone from the meeting invite.
examples.hi: मीटिंग आमंत्रण से किसी को बाहर न रखें।

examples.en: We cannot exclude the possibility of insider involvement.
examples.hi: हम अंदरूनी व्यक्ति की संलिप्तता की संभावना को खारिज नहीं कर सकते।

examples.en: The scanner excludes known-good hosts.
examples.hi: स्कैनर ज्ञात-सुरक्षित होस्ट को छोड़ देता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Contractors are excluded of the bonus.
common_mistake.right: Contractors are excluded from the bonus.
common_mistake.why: 'Exclude' takes 'from'.

cloze.sentence: We ____ internal IPs from the external scan.

en_def: stated clearly and directly, leaving no doubt
hi_nuance: Opposite of 'implicit'. Careful: 'explicit content' means sexual or violent material. In tech, 'explicit' means stated in code rather than assumed.

examples.en: The policy is explicit: no personal devices on the network.
examples.hi: नीति स्पष्ट है: नेटवर्क पर कोई निजी उपकरण नहीं।

examples.en: Give explicit instructions so nobody guesses.
examples.hi: स्पष्ट निर्देश दें ताकि किसी को अंदाज़ा न लगाना पड़े।

examples.en: She was explicit about the risks.
examples.hi: उसने जोखिमों के बारे में साफ़-साफ़ बताया।

examples.en: Make the timeout explicit instead of relying on the default.
examples.hi: डिफ़ॉल्ट पर निर्भर रहने के बजाय टाइमआउट को स्पष्ट रूप से तय करें।

examples.en: The contract gives explicit permission to test.
examples.hi: अनुबंध परीक्षण की स्पष्ट अनुमति देता है।

common_mistake.wrong: He gave an explicit that we should stop.
common_mistake.right: He said explicitly that we should stop.
common_mistake.why: 'Explicit' is an adjective; use the adverb 'explicitly' with a verb.

cloze.sentence: Get ____ written consent before scanning a client's network.

en_def: to explain something in more detail; (adjective /ɪˈlæbərət/) detailed and complicated
hi_nuance: 'Elaborate on' something. Learners say 'elaborate it' or 'elaborate more'. As an adjective it means very detailed or fancy.

examples.en: Could you elaborate on the timeline of the attack?
examples.hi: क्या आप हमले की समय-रेखा पर विस्तार से बता सकते हैं?

examples.en: He refused to elaborate.
examples.hi: उसने विस्तार से बताने से इनकार कर दिया।

examples.en: They built an elaborate system of fake websites.
examples.hi: उन्होंने नकली वेबसाइटों की एक जटिल प्रणाली बनाई।

examples.en: The wedding had an elaborate menu.
examples.hi: शादी में एक विस्तृत मेन्यू था।

examples.en: Please elaborate on your second recommendation.
examples.hi: कृपया अपनी दूसरी सिफ़ारिश पर विस्तार से बताइए।

common_mistake.wrong: Please elaborate it more.
common_mistake.right: Please elaborate on it.
common_mistake.why: 'Elaborate' takes 'on', not a direct object.

cloze.sentence: The finding is unclear; please ____ on the steps to reproduce.

en_def: to make a process easier or help it happen
hi_def: सुगम बनाना, आसान बनाना, सहायता करना
hi_nuance: The object is a process, not a person: 'facilitate discussion', not 'facilitate the students'. A 'facilitator' runs a workshop.

examples.en: The new tool facilitates collaboration between teams.
examples.hi: नया टूल टीमों के बीच सहयोग को सुगम बनाता है।

examples.en: She facilitated the workshop on incident response.
examples.hi: उसने घटना प्रतिक्रिया पर कार्यशाला का संचालन किया।

examples.en: Clear documentation facilitates onboarding.
examples.hi: स्पष्ट दस्तावेज़ ऑनबोर्डिंग को आसान बनाते हैं।

examples.en: Weak logging facilitated the attacker's movement.
examples.hi: कमज़ोर लॉगिंग ने हमलावर की गतिविधि को आसान बना दिया।

examples.en: The bank facilitates payments in several currencies.
examples.hi: बैंक कई मुद्राओं में भुगतान की सुविधा देता है।

common_mistake.wrong: We facilitated the new employees with laptops.
common_mistake.right: We provided the new employees with laptops.
common_mistake.why: 'Facilitate' takes a process as its object, not people.

cloze.sentence: A shared channel will ____ faster communication during incidents.

en_def: possible and practical to do
hi_nuance: 'Feasible' = can realistically be done; 'possible' = could happen. A 'feasibility study' checks if a project is worth doing.

examples.en: Is it feasible to migrate everything in one weekend?
examples.hi: क्या एक सप्ताहांत में सब कुछ माइग्रेट करना व्यवहार्य है?

examples.en: The plan is feasible but expensive.
examples.hi: योजना व्यवहार्य है, पर महँगी है।

examples.en: Rewriting the whole app is not feasible this year.
examples.hi: इस साल पूरा ऐप फिर से लिखना संभव नहीं है।

examples.en: We need a feasible schedule, not a wish list.
examples.hi: हमें एक व्यावहारिक कार्यक्रम चाहिए, इच्छा-सूची नहीं।

examples.en: The exploit is feasible only with physical access.
examples.hi: यह एक्सप्लॉइट केवल भौतिक पहुँच के साथ ही संभव है।

common_mistake.wrong: It is not feasible for me to come today (meaning: convenient).
common_mistake.right: It is not convenient for me to come today.
common_mistake.why: 'Feasible' is about practicality of a plan, not personal convenience.

cloze.sentence: Patching all 400 servers tonight is not ____.

en_def: to change frequently in level or amount, going up and down
hi_nuance: Used for prices, temperature, mood, traffic. Learners say 'up and down' in reports; 'fluctuate' is the professional word.

examples.en: Traffic fluctuates during the day, peaking at noon.
examples.hi: दिन में ट्रैफ़िक घटता-बढ़ता है, दोपहर में सबसे ज़्यादा होता है।

examples.en: Exchange rates fluctuate daily.
examples.hi: विनिमय दरें रोज़ बदलती रहती हैं।

examples.en: Her mood fluctuates with the amount of sleep she gets.
examples.hi: उसका मूड नींद की मात्रा के साथ बदलता रहता है।

examples.en: Response times fluctuated between 200 and 900 milliseconds.
examples.hi: प्रतिक्रिया समय 200 और 900 मिलीसेकंड के बीच घटता-बढ़ता रहा।

examples.en: Prices fluctuate wildly in a crisis.
examples.hi: संकट में कीमतों में भारी उतार-चढ़ाव होता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The CPU usage is going up and down all day.
common_mistake.right: CPU usage fluctuates throughout the day.
common_mistake.why: In a report, 'fluctuates' is precise; 'going up and down' is conversational.

cloze.sentence: Latency tends to ____ when the cache is cold.

en_def: forming the base of something; most important and basic
hi_nuance: Stress on 'men'. As a noun, 'the fundamentals' = basic skills. Learners say 'basic' where 'fundamental' adds weight in formal writing.

examples.en: There is a fundamental flaw in the design.
examples.hi: डिज़ाइन में एक बुनियादी खामी है।

examples.en: Trust is fundamental to any team.
examples.hi: किसी भी टीम के लिए विश्वास मूलभूत है।

examples.en: Learn the fundamentals before the advanced topics.
examples.hi: उन्नत विषयों से पहले बुनियादी बातें सीखें।

examples.en: Privacy is a fundamental right.
examples.hi: निजता एक मौलिक अधिकार है।

examples.en: The two approaches are fundamentally different.
examples.hi: दोनों तरीके मूल रूप से अलग हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This is a fundamental of security.
common_mistake.right: This is a fundamental principle of security.
common_mistake.why: As a noun it is normally plural ('the fundamentals'); with a singular use 'principle'.

cloze.sentence: Least privilege is a ____ principle of access control.

en_def: to produce or create something, such as energy, income, ideas, or data
hi_nuance: Used with abstract things: generate revenue, interest, reports, keys. Learners say 'create a report' (fine) or 'make revenue' (wrong).

examples.en: The script generates a report every night.
examples.hi: स्क्रिप्ट हर रात एक रिपोर्ट बनाती है।

examples.en: The campaign generated a lot of interest.
examples.hi: अभियान ने काफ़ी रुचि पैदा की।

examples.en: Solar panels generate electricity even on cloudy days.
examples.hi: सोलर पैनल बादल वाले दिनों में भी बिजली पैदा करते हैं।

examples.en: Generate a new API key and revoke the old one.
examples.hi: एक नई API कुंजी बनाएँ और पुरानी को रद्द करें।

examples.en: Brainstorming generated thirty ideas in ten minutes.
examples.hi: विचार-मंथन से दस मिनट में तीस विचार निकले।

common_mistake.wrong: The new feature made a lot of revenue.
common_mistake.right: The new feature generated a lot of revenue.
common_mistake.why: Revenue is 'generated' or 'earned', not 'made' in formal writing.

cloze.sentence: Use a password manager to ____ long random passwords.

en_def: an idea or explanation that has not yet been proved
hi_nuance: Plural is 'hypotheses' /-siːz/. Pronounce 'th' as /θ/. Learners say 'my hypothesis is like this'; say 'my hypothesis is that'.

examples.en: Our hypothesis is that the cache is returning stale data.
examples.hi: हमारी परिकल्पना है कि कैश पुराना डेटा लौटा रहा है।

examples.en: The experiment failed to support the hypothesis.
examples.hi: प्रयोग परिकल्पना का समर्थन नहीं कर सका।

examples.en: Form a hypothesis, then test it.
examples.hi: एक परिकल्पना बनाएँ, फिर उसका परीक्षण करें।

examples.en: Several hypotheses were rejected before we found the cause.
examples.hi: कारण खोजने से पहले कई परिकल्पनाएँ खारिज हुईं।

examples.en: The hypothesis that users ignore warnings was confirmed.
examples.hi: यह परिकल्पना कि उपयोगकर्ता चेतावनियों को नज़रअंदाज़ करते हैं, पुष्ट हुई।

common_mistake.wrong: We have two hypothesis for the outage.
common_mistake.right: We have two hypotheses for the outage.
common_mistake.why: The plural form is 'hypotheses'.

cloze.sentence: Debugging starts with a ____ about what went wrong.

en_def: to explain or make something clear using examples or pictures
hi_nuance: Stress on 'il'. 'Illustrate' with an example or diagram. Learners use 'show' everywhere; 'illustrate' is better when you clarify with an example.

examples.en: This case illustrates why backups matter.
examples.hi: यह मामला दर्शाता है कि बैकअप क्यों ज़रूरी हैं।

examples.en: Let me illustrate the point with an example.
examples.hi: मुझे एक उदाहरण से यह बात समझाने दीजिए।

examples.en: The chart illustrates the rise in attacks.
examples.hi: चार्ट हमलों में वृद्धि को दर्शाता है।

examples.en: The book is beautifully illustrated.
examples.hi: किताब सुंदर चित्रों से सजी है।

examples.en: A diagram would illustrate the attack chain better than text.
examples.hi: एक आरेख हमले की शृंखला को पाठ से बेहतर समझाएगा।

common_mistake.wrong: To illustrate you, here is an example.
common_mistake.right: To illustrate, here is an example.
common_mistake.why: 'Illustrate' does not take a person as its object.

cloze.sentence: A screenshot will ____ the issue better than a paragraph.

en_def: suggested but not stated directly; (of trust) complete
hi_nuance: Opposite of 'explicit'. 'Implicit trust' means total trust. In code, an implicit conversion happens automatically. Learners confuse with 'implied' (same idea, but a verb form).

examples.en: There was an implicit threat in his message.
examples.hi: उसके संदेश में एक अप्रत्यक्ष धमकी थी।

examples.en: Zero trust removes implicit trust in the internal network.
examples.hi: ज़ीरो ट्रस्ट आंतरिक नेटवर्क में अंतर्निहित विश्वास को हटा देता है।

examples.en: Her agreement was implicit; she never said yes aloud.
examples.hi: उसकी सहमति अप्रत्यक्ष थी; उसने कभी ज़ोर से हाँ नहीं कहा।

examples.en: The rule is implicit in the code but never documented.
examples.hi: नियम कोड में अंतर्निहित है, पर कभी दस्तावेज़ में नहीं लिखा गया।

examples.en: They have implicit faith in the vendor.
examples.hi: उन्हें विक्रेता पर पूरा भरोसा है।

common_mistake.wrong: The password rule is implicit written in the policy.
common_mistake.right: The password rule is stated explicitly in the policy.
common_mistake.why: If it is written, it is explicit; 'implicit' means not stated.

cloze.sentence: Old networks assumed ____ trust once you were inside the firewall.

en_def: to suggest something without saying it directly
hi_def: संकेत करना, अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से कहना, अर्थ निकलना
hi_nuance: The speaker 'implies'; the listener 'infers'. Hindi speakers use 'imply' for both. 'Imply that' + clause.

examples.en: Are you implying that I made the mistake?
examples.hi: क्या आप यह संकेत कर रहे हैं कि गलती मैंने की?

examples.en: A high score implies serious risk.
examples.hi: उच्च स्कोर गंभीर जोखिम का संकेत देता है।

examples.en: Her silence implied disagreement.
examples.hi: उसकी चुप्पी असहमति का संकेत थी।

examples.en: The email implies the deadline has moved.
examples.hi: ईमेल से लगता है कि समय-सीमा बदल गई है।

examples.en: This does not imply that the fix is complete.
examples.hi: इसका यह अर्थ नहीं है कि फ़िक्स पूरा हो गया है।

common_mistake.wrong: From his tone I implied that he was angry.
common_mistake.right: From his tone I inferred that he was angry.
common_mistake.why: The listener infers; the speaker implies.

cloze.sentence: A 500 error does not necessarily ____ a security problem.

en_def: something that encourages you to do something, such as money or a reward
hi_nuance: 'Incentive to do' or 'incentive for'. Learners use 'motivation' for both; 'incentive' is the external reward, 'motivation' is the internal drive.

examples.en: Bug bounties give researchers an incentive to report flaws.
examples.hi: बग बाउंटी शोधकर्ताओं को खामियाँ बताने का प्रोत्साहन देती है।

examples.en: There is little incentive to fix old code nobody uses.
examples.hi: जिस पुराने कोड का कोई उपयोग नहीं करता, उसे ठीक करने का कम प्रोत्साहन है।

examples.en: The company offers tax incentives for electric cars.
examples.hi: कंपनी इलेक्ट्रिक कारों के लिए कर प्रोत्साहन देती है।

examples.en: A bonus is a strong incentive for sales staff.
examples.hi: बोनस बिक्री कर्मचारियों के लिए एक मज़बूत प्रोत्साहन है।

examples.en: Attackers have a financial incentive to steal data.
examples.hi: हमलावरों के पास डेटा चुराने का आर्थिक प्रोत्साहन होता है।

common_mistake.wrong: There is no incentive of reporting bugs.
common_mistake.right: There is no incentive to report bugs.
common_mistake.why: 'Incentive' is followed by 'to' + verb or 'for' + noun.

cloze.sentence: Without an ____, few users bother to enable MFA.

en_def: certain to happen and impossible to avoid
hi_def: अपरिहार्य, अटल, टाला न जा सकने वाला
hi_nuance: Stress on 'ev'. Absolute: not 'very inevitable'. 'The inevitable' as a noun = the thing that must happen.

examples.en: With no patches, a breach was inevitable.
examples.hi: बिना पैच के, सुरक्षा उल्लंघन अपरिहार्य था।

examples.en: Some mistakes are inevitable when you learn a language.
examples.hi: भाषा सीखते समय कुछ गलतियाँ होना तय है।

examples.en: Change is inevitable; resistance is optional.
examples.hi: बदलाव अपरिहार्य है; विरोध वैकल्पिक है।

examples.en: Delays seem inevitable on this project.
examples.hi: इस परियोजना में देरी अटल लगती है।

examples.en: We accepted the inevitable and postponed the launch.
examples.hi: हमने अपरिहार्य को स्वीकार किया और लॉन्च टाल दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: It was very inevitable that the server would fail.
common_mistake.right: It was inevitable that the server would fail.
common_mistake.why: 'Inevitable' is absolute; it cannot be made stronger with 'very'.

cloze.sentence: When passwords are reused, credential stuffing is almost ____.

en_def: to prevent or slow down a process; to make someone feel shy
hi_nuance: 'Inhibit' (slow or block) vs 'prohibit' (forbid by rule). 'Feel inhibited' = feel too shy to act naturally.

examples.en: Fear of mistakes inhibits fluency.
examples.hi: गलतियों का डर प्रवाह को बाधित करता है।

examples.en: The drug inhibits the growth of bacteria.
examples.hi: यह दवा बैक्टीरिया की वृद्धि को रोकती है।

examples.en: Strict rules can inhibit creativity.
examples.hi: सख़्त नियम रचनात्मकता को बाधित कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: He feels inhibited when speaking English in meetings.
examples.hi: बैठकों में अंग्रेज़ी बोलते समय वह संकोच महसूस करता है।

examples.en: Slow approvals inhibit the team's ability to patch quickly.
examples.hi: धीमी स्वीकृतियाँ टीम की जल्दी पैच करने की क्षमता को बाधित करती हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: The policy inhibits smoking in the office.
common_mistake.right: The policy prohibits smoking in the office.
common_mistake.why: A rule 'prohibits'; a force or feeling 'inhibits'.

cloze.sentence: Shyness can ____ your progress more than grammar mistakes.

en_def: to combine two or more things so they work together; to join a group fully
hi_nuance: 'Integrate X with/into Y'. Stress on 'in'. 'Integrated' is often misused for 'included'; it means combined into one working system.

examples.en: We integrated the scanner with our ticketing system.
examples.hi: हमने स्कैनर को अपने टिकटिंग सिस्टम के साथ एकीकृत किया।

examples.en: New employees take time to integrate into the team.
examples.hi: नए कर्मचारियों को टीम में घुलने-मिलने में समय लगता है।

examples.en: The app integrates payments, chat, and maps.
examples.hi: ऐप भुगतान, चैट और नक़्शे को एक साथ जोड़ता है।

examples.en: Security should be integrated into the development process.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा को विकास प्रक्रिया में एकीकृत किया जाना चाहिए।

examples.en: The two databases were integrated last year.
examples.hi: दोनों डेटाबेस पिछले साल एकीकृत किए गए।

common_mistake.wrong: We integrated the tool to Slack.
common_mistake.right: We integrated the tool with Slack.
common_mistake.why: 'Integrate with' (a peer system) or 'into' (a larger system), not 'to'.

cloze.sentence: The alerting tool will ____ with our on-call system.

en_def: very strong, extreme, or serious
hi_nuance: 'Intense' (strong) vs 'intensive' (concentrated effort: 'intensive course', 'intensive care'). Learners swap them.

examples.en: The pressure before launch was intense.
examples.hi: लॉन्च से पहले दबाव बहुत तीव्र था।

examples.en: She felt intense relief when the backup restored.
examples.hi: जब बैकअप रीस्टोर हुआ तो उसे गहरी राहत मिली।

examples.en: The heat was intense in May.
examples.hi: मई में गर्मी बहुत तेज़ थी।

examples.en: There is intense competition for security roles.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा पदों के लिए कड़ी प्रतिस्पर्धा है।

examples.en: He is an intense person who takes everything seriously.
examples.hi: वह एक गंभीर स्वभाव का व्यक्ति है जो हर चीज़ को गंभीरता से लेता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I took an intense English course for two weeks.
common_mistake.right: I took an intensive English course for two weeks.
common_mistake.why: A concentrated course is 'intensive'; 'intense' describes strength of feeling or force.

cloze.sentence: The team faced ____ scrutiny after the breach.

en_def: to put money, time, or effort into something to get a benefit later
hi_nuance: 'Invest in' something. Learners say 'invest on' or 'invest for'. Also 'invest time/effort in', not just money.

examples.en: The company invested heavily in security tooling.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने सुरक्षा टूलिंग में भारी निवेश किया।

examples.en: Invest twenty minutes a day in pronunciation practice.
examples.hi: उच्चारण अभ्यास में रोज़ बीस मिनट लगाएँ।

examples.en: She invests in index funds every month.
examples.hi: वह हर महीने इंडेक्स फ़ंड में निवेश करती है।

examples.en: We are invested in the success of this project.
examples.hi: हम इस परियोजना की सफलता से गहराई से जुड़े हैं।

examples.en: It pays to invest time in good documentation.
examples.hi: अच्छे दस्तावेज़ों में समय लगाना फ़ायदेमंद है।

common_mistake.wrong: He invested on real estate.
common_mistake.right: He invested in real estate.
common_mistake.why: 'Invest' takes 'in'.

cloze.sentence: Companies that ____ in training suffer fewer phishing incidents.

en_def: to give a good reason for something; to show something is right
hi_def: उचित ठहराना, न्यायसंगत सिद्ध करना, कारण देना
hi_nuance: 'Justify' + noun/-ing: 'justify the cost', 'justify spending'. Learners use 'give justification' where the verb is cleaner.

examples.en: Can you justify the cost of the new tool?
examples.hi: क्या आप नए टूल की लागत को उचित ठहरा सकते हैं?

examples.en: Nothing justifies sharing customer data.
examples.hi: ग्राहक डेटा साझा करना किसी भी तरह उचित नहीं है।

examples.en: The results justified the extra week of testing.
examples.hi: नतीजों ने टेस्टिंग के अतिरिक्त हफ़्ते को सही साबित किया।

examples.en: He tried to justify his decision to the board.
examples.hi: उसने बोर्ड के सामने अपने निर्णय को उचित ठहराने की कोशिश की।

examples.en: A high severity rating must be justified with evidence.
examples.hi: उच्च गंभीरता रेटिंग को साक्ष्य के साथ उचित ठहराना होगा।

common_mistake.wrong: Please give justification for why you need admin.
common_mistake.right: Please justify why you need admin access.
common_mistake.why: The verb is shorter and more natural than 'give justification for'.

cloze.sentence: The low usage does not ____ the license cost.

en_def: allowed by law or rules; reasonable and acceptable
hi_nuance: Adjective ends /-mət/; verb 'legitimize' exists but is rare. In security, 'legitimate traffic' = normal, not malicious. Learners say 'genuine' or 'valid' where 'legitimate' fits.

examples.en: The email looked legitimate but was a phishing attempt.
examples.hi: ईमेल वैध लग रहा था, पर वह एक फ़िशिंग प्रयास था।

examples.en: She has a legitimate reason to be upset.
examples.hi: उसके परेशान होने का जायज़ कारण है।

examples.en: Only legitimate users should reach this page.
examples.hi: केवल वैध उपयोगकर्ता ही इस पेज तक पहुँचने चाहिए।

examples.en: Is this a legitimate business or a scam?
examples.hi: क्या यह एक वैध व्यवसाय है या धोखा?

examples.en: The firewall blocked some legitimate traffic by mistake.
examples.hi: फ़ायरवॉल ने गलती से कुछ वैध ट्रैफ़िक रोक दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: The request was from a legitimated user.
common_mistake.right: The request was from a legitimate user.
common_mistake.why: The adjective is 'legitimate'; 'legitimated' is not standard.

cloze.sentence: Attackers hide their traffic among ____ requests.

en_def: in the same way; also
hi_nuance: Used to link two similar statements in formal writing, or as a short reply ('Nice to meet you.' 'Likewise.'). Learners overuse 'also' and never use 'likewise'.

examples.en: The web server was patched; the database was likewise updated.
examples.hi: वेब सर्वर पैच किया गया; डेटाबेस भी इसी तरह अपडेट किया गया।

examples.en: 'It was good to meet you.' 'Likewise.'
examples.hi: 'आपसे मिलकर अच्छा लगा।' 'मुझे भी।'

examples.en: Managers must attend the training; team leads, likewise.
examples.hi: प्रबंधकों को प्रशिक्षण में भाग लेना होगा; टीम लीड को भी।

examples.en: She apologized, and he did likewise.
examples.hi: उसने माफ़ी माँगी, और उसने भी वैसा ही किया।

examples.en: Likewise, the mobile app needs a security review.
examples.hi: इसी प्रकार, मोबाइल ऐप को भी सुरक्षा समीक्षा की ज़रूरत है।

common_mistake.wrong: Likewise to the first server, the second was hacked.
common_mistake.right: Like the first server, the second was hacked.
common_mistake.why: 'Likewise' is an adverb and does not take 'to'; use 'like' for comparison.

cloze.sentence: The API was rate-limited; the login page was ____ protected.

en_def: to reduce something to the smallest possible amount; to make something seem less important
hi_def: कम से कम करना, न्यूनतम करना; कम करके दिखाना
hi_nuance: Opposite of 'maximize'. In security writing, 'minimize the attack surface' is standard. Learners write 'minimise' (British) and 'minimize' (US) in the same document; pick one.

examples.en: Disable unused services to minimize the attack surface.
examples.hi: हमले के दायरे को न्यूनतम करने के लिए अप्रयुक्त सेवाएँ बंद करें।

examples.en: We took steps to minimize downtime during the migration.
examples.hi: हमने माइग्रेशन के दौरान डाउनटाइम कम से कम रखने के कदम उठाए।
