examples.en: Do not minimize the seriousness of the leak.
examples.hi: लीक की गंभीरता को कम करके न दिखाएँ।

examples.en: Click the button to minimize the window.
examples.hi: विंडो को छोटा करने के लिए बटन दबाएँ।

examples.en: Good planning minimizes surprises.
examples.hi: अच्छी योजना आश्चर्यों को न्यूनतम करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: We must minimize down the risk.
common_mistake.right: We must minimize the risk.
common_mistake.why: 'Minimize' already means reduce; 'down' is redundant.

cloze.sentence: Segmenting the network helps ____ the damage from a breach.

en_def: to change something slightly, usually to improve it
hi_nuance: 'Modify' = small change; 'change' = any change; 'alter' = formal. Files have a 'last modified' date. Learners say 'do modification in'.

examples.en: We modified the firewall rules to block the range.
examples.hi: हमने उस रेंज को रोकने के लिए फ़ायरवॉल नियम संशोधित किए।

examples.en: The plan was modified after feedback.
examples.hi: प्रतिक्रिया के बाद योजना में बदलाव किया गया।

examples.en: Do not modify production data without a ticket.
examples.hi: बिना टिकट के प्रोडक्शन डेटा में बदलाव न करें।

examples.en: The attacker modified the log files to hide their tracks.
examples.hi: हमलावर ने अपने निशान छिपाने के लिए लॉग फ़ाइलें बदल दीं।

examples.en: She slightly modified the recipe.
examples.hi: उसने रेसिपी में थोड़ा बदलाव किया।

common_mistake.wrong: Please do the modification in the config.
common_mistake.right: Please modify the config.
common_mistake.why: Use the verb directly instead of 'do the modification in'.

cloze.sentence: Anyone who can ____ the script can run code on the server.

en_def: to watch and check something over a period of time; (noun) a screen
hi_nuance: Verb takes a direct object: 'monitor the traffic'. Learners say 'monitor on'. The noun 'monitor' = screen or the person who watches.

examples.en: We monitor all outbound traffic for unusual patterns.
examples.hi: हम असामान्य पैटर्न के लिए सभी बाहर जाने वाले ट्रैफ़िक की निगरानी करते हैं।

examples.en: Doctors monitored her heart rate overnight.
examples.hi: डॉक्टरों ने रात भर उसकी हृदय गति पर नज़र रखी।

examples.en: Please monitor the ticket queue while I am away.
examples.hi: जब मैं दूर रहूँ, कृपया टिकट कतार पर नज़र रखें।

examples.en: The tool monitors disk usage and alerts at 90%.
examples.hi: टूल डिस्क उपयोग पर नज़र रखता है और 90% पर अलर्ट करता है।

examples.en: I need a bigger monitor for this work.
examples.hi: इस काम के लिए मुझे एक बड़ा मॉनिटर चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: We are monitoring on the server logs.
common_mistake.right: We are monitoring the server logs.
common_mistake.why: 'Monitor' takes a direct object; no 'on'.

cloze.sentence: Continuously ____ privileged accounts for unusual activity.

en_def: to make someone want to do something; to be the reason for an action
hi_nuance: 'Motivate someone to do'. 'Motivated by' = driven by. Learners say 'motivate for'. Also 'a motivated attacker' = determined.

examples.en: A visible streak motivates me to study daily.
examples.hi: दिखने वाला स्ट्रीक मुझे रोज़ पढ़ने के लिए प्रेरित करता है।

examples.en: The attack was motivated by money, not politics.
examples.hi: हमले का उद्देश्य पैसा था, राजनीति नहीं।

examples.en: Good managers know how to motivate their teams.
examples.hi: अच्छे प्रबंधक जानते हैं कि टीम को कैसे प्रेरित किया जाए।

examples.en: A motivated attacker will find another way in.
examples.hi: एक दृढ़ हमलावर अंदर आने का दूसरा रास्ता ढूँढ लेगा।

examples.en: What motivated you to learn English seriously?
examples.hi: आपको गंभीरता से अंग्रेज़ी सीखने की प्रेरणा किससे मिली?

common_mistake.wrong: The bonus motivated the staff for working harder.
common_mistake.right: The bonus motivated the staff to work harder.
common_mistake.why: 'Motivate' takes 'to' + verb.

cloze.sentence: Progress charts ____ learners more than grades do.

en_def: not supporting any side; having no strong quality or color
hi_nuance: 'Neutral' in language register = neither formal nor informal. 'Remain neutral' = take no side. Learners use 'impartial' only for judges; 'neutral' works more broadly.

examples.en: Try to stay neutral when two colleagues argue.
examples.hi: जब दो सहकर्मी बहस करें तो तटस्थ रहने की कोशिश करें।

examples.en: Use a neutral tone in the incident report.
examples.hi: घटना रिपोर्ट में तटस्थ लहजे का प्रयोग करें।

examples.en: Switzerland has been neutral for centuries.
examples.hi: स्विट्ज़रलैंड सदियों से तटस्थ रहा है।

examples.en: The office is painted in neutral colors.
examples.hi: दफ़्तर उदासीन रंगों में रँगा है।

examples.en: The word 'said' is neutral; 'claimed' suggests doubt.
examples.hi: 'कहा' शब्द तटस्थ है; 'दावा किया' संदेह जताता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The report should be written in neutral.
common_mistake.right: The report should be written in a neutral tone.
common_mistake.why: 'Neutral' is an adjective and needs a noun to describe.

cloze.sentence: Keep the wording ____ so the vendor does not feel blamed.

en_def: an idea or belief, often one that is vague or not fully correct
hi_nuance: Often slightly negative or doubtful: 'the notion that hackers are geniuses'. Learners use 'notion' as a fancy synonym for 'idea' in all cases; use it when you want to question the idea.

examples.en: The notion that small companies are not targets is false.
examples.hi: यह धारणा गलत है कि छोटी कंपनियाँ निशाना नहीं होतीं।

examples.en: He has no notion of how much the outage cost.
examples.hi: उसे अंदाज़ा नहीं है कि आउटेज की कितनी कीमत चुकानी पड़ी।

examples.en: She rejected the notion of working weekends.
examples.hi: उसने सप्ताहांत में काम करने के विचार को खारिज कर दिया।

examples.en: The whole notion of privacy is changing.
examples.hi: निजता की पूरी अवधारणा बदल रही है।

examples.en: I had a vague notion that something was wrong.
examples.hi: मुझे एक धुँधला-सा आभास था कि कुछ गड़बड़ है।

common_mistake.wrong: I have a notion for a new feature.
common_mistake.right: I have an idea for a new feature.
common_mistake.why: For a concrete proposal use 'idea'; 'notion' suits vague or questionable beliefs.

cloze.sentence: Zero trust rejects the ____ of a safe internal network.

en_def: a goal you are trying to achieve; (adjective) based on facts, not feelings
hi_nuance: Noun = goal; adjective = fact-based (opposite of 'subjective'). Learners use 'objective' for goals only and 'unbiased' for the adjective.

examples.en: The main objective of the test is to find data exposure.
examples.hi: परीक्षण का मुख्य उद्देश्य डेटा एक्सपोज़र ढूँढना है।

examples.en: Try to be objective when reviewing your own code.
examples.hi: अपना कोड समीक्षा करते समय वस्तुनिष्ठ रहने की कोशिश करें।

examples.en: We met every objective for the quarter.
examples.hi: हमने तिमाही का हर लक्ष्य पूरा किया।

examples.en: An objective measure is better than a gut feeling.
examples.hi: वस्तुनिष्ठ माप अंतर्ज्ञान से बेहतर होता है।

examples.en: State the objective clearly at the top of the report.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट के शीर्ष पर उद्देश्य स्पष्ट रूप से लिखें।

common_mistake.wrong: Our objective is to increasing sales.
common_mistake.right: Our objective is to increase sales.
common_mistake.why: After 'is to', use the base verb.

cloze.sentence: The ____ of the exercise is to test the response plan, not to blame people.

en_def: the result or effect of an action or event
hi_nuance: 'Outcome' is neutral, unlike 'consequence'. 'Outcome of' something. Indian English says 'output' for results of a meeting; use 'outcome'.

examples.en: What was the outcome of the meeting?
examples.hi: बैठक का नतीजा क्या रहा?

examples.en: The outcome of the test surprised everyone.
examples.hi: परीक्षण का परिणाम सबके लिए आश्चर्यजनक था।

examples.en: We cannot predict the outcome of the audit.
examples.hi: हम ऑडिट के नतीजे का अनुमान नहीं लगा सकते।

examples.en: A good outcome depends on early detection.
examples.hi: अच्छा परिणाम शुरुआती पहचान पर निर्भर करता है।

examples.en: Focus on outcomes, not on hours worked.
examples.hi: काम के घंटों पर नहीं, परिणामों पर ध्यान दें।

common_mistake.wrong: The output of the discussion was to delay the launch.
common_mistake.right: The outcome of the discussion was to delay the launch.
common_mistake.why: 'Output' is what a machine produces; a discussion has an 'outcome'.

cloze.sentence: The best possible ____ is that no data left the network.

en_def: including everything; in general
hi_nuance: Adjective: 'the overall risk'. Adverb: 'Overall, the test went well'. Do not write 'overally'; it is not a word. Note 'overalls' = work clothes.

examples.en: Overall, the security posture has improved.
examples.hi: कुल मिलाकर, सुरक्षा स्थिति में सुधार हुआ है।

examples.en: The overall cost was lower than expected.
examples.hi: कुल लागत अपेक्षा से कम थी।

examples.en: She gave an overall score of eight out of ten.
examples.hi: उसने दस में से आठ का समग्र स्कोर दिया।

examples.en: Overall, I am happy with the result.
examples.hi: कुल मिलाकर, मैं नतीजे से खुश हूँ।

examples.en: The overall picture is positive despite two failures.
examples.hi: दो विफलताओं के बावजूद समग्र तस्वीर सकारात्मक है।

common_mistake.wrong: Overally, the project was a success.
common_mistake.right: Overall, the project was a success.
common_mistake.why: 'Overall' is already the adverb; 'overally' does not exist.

cloze.sentence: The ____ rating is high because of the exposed admin panel.

en_def: to continue doing something despite difficulty; to continue to exist
hi_def: डटे रहना, बने रहना, जारी रहना
hi_nuance: 'Persist in' + -ing; 'persist with' + noun. In tech, data 'persists' = is saved. 'Persistence' in security = an attacker staying in the system.

examples.en: If the error persists, contact support.
examples.hi: यदि त्रुटि बनी रहे तो सहायता से संपर्क करें।

examples.en: She persisted with her studies despite the long hours.
examples.hi: लंबे घंटों के बावजूद वह अपनी पढ़ाई में डटी रही।

examples.en: The malware persists across reboots.
examples.hi: यह मैलवेयर रीबूट के बाद भी बना रहता है।

examples.en: Settings persist in the browser's storage.
examples.hi: सेटिंग्स ब्राउज़र के स्टोरेज में सहेजी रहती हैं।

examples.en: He persisted in asking the same question.
examples.hi: वह वही सवाल पूछता रहा।

common_mistake.wrong: The issue is still persisting.
common_mistake.right: The issue persists.
common_mistake.why: 'Still persisting' is redundant; 'persists' already means it continues.

cloze.sentence: The attacker created a scheduled task to ____ on the machine.

en_def: something that happens or exists and can be observed, especially something unusual
hi_nuance: Plural is 'phenomena'. Learners write 'a phenomena', which is wrong. Also used for a very impressive person or thing.

examples.en: Password reuse is a widespread phenomenon.
examples.hi: पासवर्ड का दोबारा उपयोग एक व्यापक घटना है।

examples.en: Lightning is a natural phenomenon.
examples.hi: बिजली गिरना एक प्राकृतिक परिघटना है।

examples.en: Scientists cannot fully explain the phenomenon.
examples.hi: वैज्ञानिक इस परिघटना को पूरी तरह नहीं समझा सकते।

examples.en: Remote work is no longer a new phenomenon.
examples.hi: रिमोट काम अब कोई नई बात नहीं है।

examples.en: Several strange phenomena were recorded in the logs.
examples.hi: लॉग में कई अजीब घटनाएँ दर्ज की गईं।

common_mistake.wrong: This is a common phenomena in startups.
common_mistake.right: This is a common phenomenon in startups.
common_mistake.why: 'Phenomena' is plural; the singular is 'phenomenon'.

cloze.sentence: Alert fatigue is a well-known ____ in security teams.

en_def: the most common, largest, or most noticeable
hi_nuance: Formal. 'Predominantly' = mostly. Learners say 'mostly' in speech, which is fine; use 'predominantly' in reports.

examples.en: Phishing remains the predominant attack method.
examples.hi: फ़िशिंग हमले का प्रमुख तरीका बनी हुई है।

examples.en: The predominant color in the design is blue.
examples.hi: डिज़ाइन में प्रमुख रंग नीला है।

examples.en: Our users are predominantly on mobile.
examples.hi: हमारे उपयोगकर्ता मुख्यतः मोबाइल पर हैं।

examples.en: English is the predominant language in the office.
examples.hi: दफ़्तर में अंग्रेज़ी प्रमुख भाषा है।

examples.en: The predominant view is that the fix is safe.
examples.hi: प्रमुख राय यह है कि फ़िक्स सुरक्षित है।

common_mistake.wrong: The most predominant cause is human error.
common_mistake.right: The predominant cause is human error.
common_mistake.why: 'Predominant' already means 'most'; do not add 'most'.

cloze.sentence: Credential theft is the ____ cause of breaches in our sector.

en_def: happening before the main event or as preparation for it
hi_nuance: 'Preliminary findings' = early results that may change. Learners say 'initial' for everything; 'preliminary' signals 'not final'.

examples.en: Our preliminary findings suggest no data was taken.
examples.hi: हमारे प्रारंभिक निष्कर्ष बताते हैं कि कोई डेटा नहीं लिया गया।

examples.en: The preliminary report is due Monday; the full one next month.
examples.hi: प्रारंभिक रिपोर्ट सोमवार को देय है; पूरी रिपोर्ट अगले महीने।

examples.en: She passed the preliminary round of interviews.
examples.hi: उसने साक्षात्कार का प्रारंभिक दौर पास कर लिया।

examples.en: A preliminary scan found three open ports.
examples.hi: एक प्रारंभिक स्कैन में तीन खुले पोर्ट मिले।

examples.en: These numbers are preliminary and may change.
examples.hi: ये आँकड़े प्रारंभिक हैं और बदल सकते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This is the final preliminary report.
common_mistake.right: This is the preliminary report; the final one follows.
common_mistake.why: 'Final' and 'preliminary' contradict each other.

cloze.sentence: Share ____ findings within 24 hours, even if they are incomplete.

en_def: to suppose something is true because it is likely, without proof
hi_def: मान लेना (संभावना के आधार पर), अनुमान करना
hi_nuance: 'Presume' = believe because probable; 'assume' = believe without evidence. 'Presumed dead', 'innocent until proven guilty' both use this idea.

examples.en: I presume you have already read the report.
examples.hi: मैं मानता हूँ कि आपने रिपोर्ट पहले ही पढ़ ली होगी।

examples.en: The missing laptop is presumed stolen.
examples.hi: गुम हुए लैपटॉप को चोरी हुआ माना जा रहा है।

examples.en: Do not presume the user is at fault.
examples.hi: यह मत मान लो कि उपयोगकर्ता की गलती है।

examples.en: Everyone is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
examples.hi: दोष सिद्ध होने तक हर किसी को निर्दोष माना जाता है।

examples.en: We presumed the backup was recent; it was six months old.
examples.hi: हमने मान लिया था कि बैकअप हाल का है; वह छह महीने पुराना था।

common_mistake.wrong: I presume to think the server is safe.
common_mistake.right: I presume the server is safe.
common_mistake.why: 'Presume to' means 'dare to'; for belief use 'presume that'.

cloze.sentence: Until we verify, we must ____ the credentials are compromised.

en_def: a part or share of a whole; the relationship in size between two things
hi_nuance: 'A large proportion of' + plural/uncountable noun. 'Out of proportion' = too big. Learners confuse 'proportion' (share) with 'portion' (serving of food).

examples.en: A large proportion of users never update their apps.
examples.hi: उपयोगकर्ताओं का एक बड़ा हिस्सा कभी अपने ऐप अपडेट नहीं करता।

examples.en: The response was out of all proportion to the risk.
examples.hi: प्रतिक्रिया जोखिम के अनुपात से कहीं ज़्यादा थी।

examples.en: What proportion of the budget goes to security?
examples.hi: बजट का कितना हिस्सा सुरक्षा में जाता है?

examples.en: Keep the image in proportion when you resize it.
examples.hi: आकार बदलते समय छवि का अनुपात बनाए रखें।

examples.en: The proportion of remote staff has doubled.
examples.hi: रिमोट कर्मचारियों का अनुपात दोगुना हो गया है।

common_mistake.wrong: A big portion of the traffic is bots.
common_mistake.right: A large proportion of the traffic is bots.
common_mistake.why: 'Proportion' is the share of a whole; 'portion' is a piece or serving.

cloze.sentence: Only a small ____ of alerts turn out to be real incidents.

en_def: to follow a course of action or a goal; to chase
hi_nuance: 'Pursue a career/goal/degree/lead'. Indian English says 'I am pursuing B.Tech'; native speakers say 'I am doing/studying'. 'Pursue' is fine for careers and investigations.

examples.en: She decided to pursue a career in cybersecurity.
examples.hi: उसने साइबर सुरक्षा में करियर बनाने का फ़ैसला किया।

examples.en: We will not pursue legal action this time.
examples.hi: इस बार हम कानूनी कार्रवाई नहीं करेंगे।

examples.en: The police pursued the suspect for three miles.
examples.hi: पुलिस ने संदिग्ध का तीन मील तक पीछा किया।

examples.en: The team is pursuing two leads in the investigation.
examples.hi: टीम जाँच में दो सुरागों पर काम कर रही है।

examples.en: It is worth pursuing the vendor for a fix.
examples.hi: फ़िक्स के लिए विक्रेता पर दबाव बनाना उचित है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am pursuing my graduation from Delhi University.
common_mistake.right: I am studying for my degree at Delhi University.
common_mistake.why: 'Pursuing graduation' is Indian English; 'graduation' is the ceremony, not the degree.

cloze.sentence: We chose not to ____ the low-severity findings this quarter.

en_def: happening or chosen without any plan or pattern
hi_nuance: 'At random' = without choosing. Informally, 'random' can mean 'strange or unexpected' ('a random guy'). In security, 'random' must be truly unpredictable.

examples.en: Pick a random sample of ten tickets to review.
examples.hi: समीक्षा के लिए दस टिकटों का एक यादृच्छिक नमूना चुनें।

examples.en: The password must be long and random.
examples.hi: पासवर्ड लंबा और यादृच्छिक होना चाहिए।

examples.en: Errors appeared at random, with no clear trigger.
examples.hi: त्रुटियाँ बेतरतीब ढंग से दिखीं, बिना किसी स्पष्ट कारण के।

examples.en: A random stranger asked me for directions.
examples.hi: एक अनजान व्यक्ति ने मुझसे रास्ता पूछा।

examples.en: The tokens were not random enough and could be guessed.
examples.hi: टोकन पर्याप्त यादृच्छिक नहीं थे और उनका अनुमान लगाया जा सकता था।

common_mistake.wrong: Choose any random one.
common_mistake.right: Choose one at random.
common_mistake.why: 'At random' is the fixed phrase; 'any random one' is redundant.

cloze.sentence: Session IDs must be ____ so attackers cannot predict them.

en_def: to make something stronger, especially an idea, feeling, or structure
hi_def: मज़बूत करना, सुदृढ़ करना, पुष्ट करना
hi_nuance: Used for beliefs, habits, structures, and lessons. Learners say 'strengthen' for all; 'reinforce' is better for ideas and learning ('reinforce vocabulary').

examples.en: Spaced repetition reinforces what you learn.
examples.hi: अंतराल पर दोहराव आपके सीखे हुए को मज़बूत करता है।

examples.en: The incident reinforced the need for backups.
examples.hi: घटना ने बैकअप की ज़रूरत को और पुष्ट किया।

examples.en: Steel bars reinforce the concrete.
examples.hi: इस्पात की छड़ें कंक्रीट को मज़बूत करती हैं।

examples.en: Praise reinforces good behavior.
examples.hi: प्रशंसा अच्छे व्यवहार को मज़बूत करती है।

examples.en: We reinforced the login page with rate limiting.
examples.hi: हमने लॉगिन पेज को रेट लिमिटिंग से सुदृढ़ किया।

common_mistake.wrong: This example enforces the rule you learned.
common_mistake.right: This example reinforces the rule you learned.
common_mistake.why: 'Enforce' means make people obey; 'reinforce' means strengthen.

cloze.sentence: Reviewing mistakes the next day helps ____ the correct form.

en_def: not willing to do something and therefore slow to do it
hi_nuance: 'Reluctant to' + verb. Learners say 'hesitating' or 'not interested'; 'reluctant' captures unwillingness politely.

examples.en: The vendor was reluctant to admit the flaw.
examples.hi: विक्रेता खामी स्वीकार करने में हिचकिचा रहा था।

examples.en: She is reluctant to speak English in front of others.
examples.hi: वह दूसरों के सामने अंग्रेज़ी बोलने में हिचकिचाती है।

examples.en: Users are reluctant to change their habits.
examples.hi: उपयोगकर्ता अपनी आदतें बदलने के अनिच्छुक हैं।

examples.en: He gave a reluctant yes.
examples.hi: उसने अनमने ढंग से हाँ कहा।

examples.en: Management was reluctant to spend on training.
examples.hi: प्रबंधन प्रशिक्षण पर खर्च करने का अनिच्छुक था।

common_mistake.wrong: He was reluctant for sharing the logs.
common_mistake.right: He was reluctant to share the logs.
common_mistake.why: 'Reluctant' takes 'to' + verb.

cloze.sentence: Teams are often ____ to report their own mistakes.

en_def: to limit something in size, amount, or range; to control who can do something
hi_def: सीमित करना, प्रतिबंधित करना, रोक लगाना
hi_nuance: 'Restrict X to Y' = limit X to only Y. 'Restricted area' = no entry. Learners say 'restrict from' when they mean 'prevent from'.

examples.en: Restrict admin access to two people.
examples.hi: एडमिन पहुँच को दो लोगों तक सीमित करें।

examples.en: The doctor restricted his salt intake.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने उसके नमक के सेवन पर रोक लगाई।

examples.en: Uploads are restricted to 5 MB.
examples.hi: अपलोड 5 MB तक सीमित हैं।

examples.en: The firewall restricts outbound traffic to port 443.
examples.hi: फ़ायरवॉल बाहर जाने वाले ट्रैफ़िक को पोर्ट 443 तक सीमित करता है।

examples.en: This document is restricted; do not forward it.
examples.hi: यह दस्तावेज़ प्रतिबंधित है; इसे आगे न भेजें।

common_mistake.wrong: We restricted users from the admin panel.
common_mistake.right: We restricted access to the admin panel.
common_mistake.why: 'Restrict' limits a thing; to stop a person, use 'prevent from' or 'restrict access to'.

cloze.sentence: ____ database access to the application account only.

en_def: to keep something or continue to have it
hi_nuance: Formal for 'keep'. Common in policies: 'retain logs for 90 days', 'retain staff'. Learners say 'keep' everywhere; 'retain' is expected in written policy.

examples.en: We retain access logs for one year.
examples.hi: हम एक साल तक एक्सेस लॉग रखते हैं।

examples.en: It is cheaper to retain staff than to hire new ones.
examples.hi: नए लोगों को भर्ती करने से सस्ता है मौजूदा कर्मचारियों को बनाए रखना।

examples.en: She retained her calm during the outage.
examples.hi: आउटेज के दौरान उसने अपना धैर्य बनाए रखा।

examples.en: The company retained a lawyer for the case.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने मामले के लिए एक वकील नियुक्त किया।

examples.en: Spaced review helps you retain vocabulary.
examples.hi: अंतराल पर दोहराव आपको शब्दावली याद रखने में मदद करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: We keep the logs for 90 days as per policy (in a formal policy document).
common_mistake.right: Logs are retained for 90 days.
common_mistake.why: Policy language uses 'retain'; 'keep' sounds conversational.

cloze.sentence: How long do we ____ customer records after they close an account?

en_def: to make something known that was secret or hidden; to show
hi_def: प्रकट करना, उजागर करना, खुलासा करना
hi_nuance: 'Reveal that' or 'reveal' + noun. In security, an error page that 'reveals' the stack trace is a finding. Learners use 'disclose' and 'reveal' interchangeably; 'disclose' is more formal and official.

examples.en: The audit revealed several unpatched servers.
examples.hi: ऑडिट में कई बिना पैच वाले सर्वर सामने आए।

examples.en: The error message reveals the database version.
examples.hi: त्रुटि संदेश डेटाबेस का संस्करण उजागर कर देता है।

examples.en: She refused to reveal her source.
examples.hi: उसने अपना स्रोत बताने से इनकार कर दिया।

examples.en: Tests revealed that the fix broke the login page.
examples.hi: परीक्षणों से पता चला कि फ़िक्स ने लॉगिन पेज को तोड़ दिया।

examples.en: The survey revealed a surprising trend.
examples.hi: सर्वेक्षण ने एक आश्चर्यजनक प्रवृत्ति उजागर की।

common_mistake.wrong: The scan revealed out three open ports.
common_mistake.right: The scan revealed three open ports.
common_mistake.why: 'Reveal' takes a direct object; no 'out'.

cloze.sentence: Verbose errors can ____ internal file paths to attackers.

en_def: not able to bend or change; strict and not flexible
hi_nuance: Physical (a rigid frame) or abstract (rigid rules). Slightly negative when describing people or rules. 'Strict' is about enforcement; 'rigid' is about inflexibility.

examples.en: The process is too rigid to handle exceptions.
examples.hi: यह प्रक्रिया अपवादों को संभालने के लिए बहुत कठोर है।

examples.en: The frame must be rigid so the screen does not wobble.
examples.hi: फ़्रेम कठोर होना चाहिए ताकि स्क्रीन हिले नहीं।

examples.en: He has a rigid view of how code should be written.
examples.hi: कोड कैसे लिखा जाना चाहिए, इस पर उसका नज़रिया बहुत कठोर है।

examples.en: Rigid schedules do not work for on-call teams.
examples.hi: ऑन-कॉल टीमों के लिए अनम्य कार्यक्रम काम नहीं करते।

examples.en: Her body went rigid with fear.
examples.hi: डर से उसका शरीर अकड़ गया।

common_mistake.wrong: The security policy is very rigid, which is good.
common_mistake.right: The security policy is very strict, which is good.
common_mistake.why: 'Rigid' implies inflexibility, usually a criticism; 'strict' can be praise.

cloze.sentence: A ____ change process slows down urgent patches.

en_def: a description of a possible situation or sequence of events
hi_nuance: Pronounce 'suh-NAIR-ee-oh'. 'Worst-case scenario' is the key phrase. Indian English uses 'scenario' to mean 'the current situation' ('in today's scenario'), which sounds odd; say 'in today's world' or 'currently'.

examples.en: In the worst-case scenario, we lose a day of data.
examples.hi: सबसे बुरी स्थिति में हम एक दिन का डेटा खो देंगे।

examples.en: Let's walk through the attack scenario step by step.
examples.hi: चलिए हमले के परिदृश्य को चरण-दर-चरण देखते हैं।

examples.en: We tested three recovery scenarios.
examples.hi: हमने तीन रिकवरी परिदृश्यों का परीक्षण किया।

examples.en: That scenario is unlikely but possible.
examples.hi: वह परिदृश्य असंभावित है, पर संभव है।

examples.en: Plan for the likely scenario, not the perfect one.
examples.hi: संभावित परिदृश्य के लिए योजना बनाएँ, आदर्श के लिए नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: In today's scenario, everyone works remotely.
common_mistake.right: These days, everyone works remotely.
common_mistake.why: 'Scenario' means a hypothetical sequence of events, not the present situation.

cloze.sentence: The tabletop exercise used a ransomware ____.

en_def: existing in large amounts; more than enough
hi_nuance: 'Abundant in' = rich in. 'An abundance of' is the noun phrase. Learners write 'plenty' in formal writing; 'abundant' is stronger and more formal.

examples.en: There is abundant evidence that the account was misused.
examples.hi: इस बात के प्रचुर प्रमाण हैं कि खाते का दुरुपयोग हुआ।

examples.en: The region is abundant in natural gas.
examples.hi: यह क्षेत्र प्राकृतिक गैस से भरपूर है।

examples.en: Free learning material is abundant online.
examples.hi: मुफ़्त सीखने की सामग्री ऑनलाइन बहुतायत में है।

examples.en: We have an abundance of logs but no way to search them.
examples.hi: हमारे पास लॉग की भरमार है, पर उन्हें खोजने का कोई तरीका नहीं।

examples.en: Rain was abundant this monsoon.
examples.hi: इस मानसून में बारिश भरपूर हुई।

common_mistake.wrong: There are abundant of examples.
common_mistake.right: There are abundant examples.
common_mistake.why: 'Abundant' is an adjective; 'abundance of' is the noun form.

cloze.sentence: Public exploit code is ____ for this old version.

en_def: safe from attack or harm; (verb) to make safe, or to obtain something after effort
hi_nuance: Verb meaning 'obtain' surprises learners: 'secure funding', 'secure a contract'. 'Secure' (protected) vs 'safe' (not in danger): a 'secure' server, a 'safe' neighborhood.

examples.en: Is this connection secure?
examples.hi: क्या यह कनेक्शन सुरक्षित है?

examples.en: We secured the server by closing unused ports.
examples.hi: हमने अप्रयुक्त पोर्ट बंद करके सर्वर को सुरक्षित किया।

examples.en: She secured a contract with a major bank.
examples.hi: उसने एक बड़े बैंक के साथ अनुबंध हासिल किया।

examples.en: Keep the backup in a secure location.
examples.hi: बैकअप को सुरक्षित स्थान पर रखें।

examples.en: He feels secure in his new job.
examples.hi: वह अपनी नई नौकरी में सुरक्षित महसूस करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The website is safe from hackers.
common_mistake.right: The website is secure against hackers.
common_mistake.why: For protection from attack, 'secure' is the technical term.

cloze.sentence: The team ____ the budget for a new SIEM tool.

en_def: a series of things or events that follow each other in a particular order
hi_nuance: 'In sequence' = in order. 'Sequence of events' is standard in incident reports. Learners write 'series' and 'sequence' interchangeably; 'sequence' stresses the order.

examples.en: Describe the sequence of events before the crash.
examples.hi: क्रैश से पहले की घटनाओं का क्रम बताइए।

examples.en: Run the scripts in sequence, not in parallel.
examples.hi: स्क्रिप्ट को समानांतर नहीं, क्रम में चलाएँ।

examples.en: The boot sequence takes about forty seconds.
examples.hi: बूट क्रम में लगभग चालीस सेकंड लगते हैं।

examples.en: The attacker followed a predictable sequence of steps.
examples.hi: हमलावर ने चरणों के एक अनुमानित क्रम का पालन किया।

examples.en: Learn the numbers in sequence before you mix them.
examples.hi: मिलाने से पहले संख्याओं को क्रम में सीखें।

common_mistake.wrong: Do the steps in a sequence manner.
common_mistake.right: Do the steps in sequence.
common_mistake.why: 'In sequence' is complete; 'sequence manner' is not English.

cloze.sentence: The report must list the ____ of events with timestamps.

en_def: a change in position, direction, or attitude; a period of work; (verb) to move or change
hi_nuance: Indian English uses 'shift' for moving house ('we shifted to Pune'); native speakers say 'moved'. 'Shift' is fine for work shifts and changes in opinion.

examples.en: There has been a shift toward passwordless login.
examples.hi: पासवर्ड-रहित लॉगिन की ओर एक बदलाव आया है।

examples.en: I work the night shift this week.
examples.hi: इस हफ़्ते मैं रात की पारी में काम कर रहा हूँ।

examples.en: Shift the focus from tools to training.
examples.hi: ध्यान टूल्स से हटाकर प्रशिक्षण पर लगाएँ।

examples.en: Public opinion shifted after the leak.
examples.hi: लीक के बाद जनमत बदल गया।

examples.en: Shift-left means testing earlier in development.
examples.hi: शिफ़्ट-लेफ़्ट का अर्थ है विकास में पहले परीक्षण करना।

common_mistake.wrong: We shifted to a new flat last month.
common_mistake.right: We moved to a new flat last month.
common_mistake.why: For changing homes, native speakers say 'move'.

cloze.sentence: The company saw a ____ from on-premise servers to the cloud.

en_def: to create a model of a real situation for testing or training; to pretend
hi_def: अनुकरण करना, नकल करना, कृत्रिम रूप से दोहराना
hi_nuance: Stress on 'sim'. 'Simulate an attack' = perform a safe copy of one. 'Simulation' is the noun. Learners confuse with 'stimulate' (excite, encourage).

examples.en: We simulated a phishing campaign to test staff.
examples.hi: कर्मचारियों को परखने के लिए हमने एक फ़िशिंग अभियान का अनुकरण किया।

examples.en: The tool simulates 10,000 users hitting the site.
examples.hi: टूल साइट पर 10,000 उपयोगकर्ताओं के आने का अनुकरण करता है।

examples.en: Pilots train in a flight simulator.
examples.hi: पायलट फ़्लाइट सिम्युलेटर में प्रशिक्षण लेते हैं।

examples.en: The model simulates how a disease spreads.
examples.hi: यह मॉडल बीमारी के फैलने का अनुकरण करता है।

examples.en: He simulated surprise, but he already knew.
examples.hi: उसने आश्चर्य का दिखावा किया, पर उसे पहले से पता था।

common_mistake.wrong: We stimulated an outage to test the runbook.
common_mistake.right: We simulated an outage to test the runbook.
common_mistake.why: 'Stimulate' means encourage; 'simulate' means imitate.

cloze.sentence: Red teams ____ real attackers to find weaknesses.

en_def: advanced and complex; (of a person) experienced and knowing about culture
hi_nuance: In security reports 'sophisticated attacker' is overused to excuse failures. Use it only when the attack was truly advanced. Stress on 'fis'.

examples.en: The malware used sophisticated evasion techniques.
examples.hi: मैलवेयर ने परिष्कृत बचाव तकनीकों का उपयोग किया।

examples.en: Modern phones are sophisticated computers.
examples.hi: आधुनिक फ़ोन परिष्कृत कंप्यूटर हैं।

examples.en: She has sophisticated taste in music.
examples.hi: उसकी संगीत में परिष्कृत रुचि है।

examples.en: The attack was not sophisticated; it was a guessed password.
examples.hi: हमला उन्नत नहीं था; वह एक अनुमानित पासवर्ड था।

examples.en: We need a more sophisticated model to predict demand.
examples.hi: माँग का अनुमान लगाने के लिए हमें एक अधिक उन्नत मॉडल चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: A very sophisticated attacker guessed the password 'admin123'.
common_mistake.right: An attacker guessed the weak password 'admin123'.
common_mistake.why: Calling a trivial attack 'sophisticated' misleads the reader.

cloze.sentence: Deepfake voice calls are a ____ form of social engineering.

en_def: easy to understand or do; honest and direct
hi_nuance: One word. Learners say 'very simple' or 'easy'; 'straightforward' is the natural professional word for a task with no complications.

examples.en: The fix is straightforward: update the library.
examples.hi: समाधान सीधा है: लाइब्रेरी अपडेट करें।

examples.en: The instructions were clear and straightforward.
examples.hi: निर्देश स्पष्ट और सीधे थे।

examples.en: He is straightforward; you always know where you stand.
examples.hi: वह सीधा-सादा है; आपको हमेशा पता रहता है कि आप कहाँ खड़े हैं।

examples.en: Reproducing the bug was not straightforward.
examples.hi: बग को दोहराना आसान नहीं था।

examples.en: It is a straightforward question with a yes-or-no answer.
examples.hi: यह एक सीधा सवाल है जिसका जवाब हाँ या ना है।

common_mistake.wrong: The setup is straight forward.
common_mistake.right: The setup is straightforward.
common_mistake.why: It is written as one word.

cloze.sentence: Exploiting the flaw is ____ and needs no special tools.

en_def: a plan designed to achieve a long-term goal
hi_nuance: 'Strategy for' something; 'strategy to' + verb. Adjective 'strategic' is stressed on 'te'. Learners use 'strategy' for small tactics; a strategy is the big plan, tactics are the steps.

examples.en: Our strategy is to patch critical systems first.
examples.hi: हमारी रणनीति पहले गंभीर सिस्टम को पैच करने की है।

examples.en: The company needs a clear cloud strategy.
examples.hi: कंपनी को एक स्पष्ट क्लाउड रणनीति चाहिए।

examples.en: A good learning strategy beats long hours.
examples.hi: एक अच्छी सीखने की रणनीति लंबे घंटों से बेहतर है।

examples.en: They changed strategy after losing two clients.
examples.hi: दो ग्राहक खोने के बाद उन्होंने रणनीति बदल दी।

examples.en: What is your strategy for handling alerts at night?
examples.hi: रात में अलर्ट संभालने की आपकी रणनीति क्या है?

common_mistake.wrong: Our strategy of security is to patch quickly.
common_mistake.right: Our security strategy is to patch quickly.
common_mistake.why: Put the topic before 'strategy' as an adjective, or use 'strategy for'.

cloze.sentence: Defense in depth is a ____, not a single product.

en_def: to give a document or request to someone in authority; to accept someone's power
hi_def: प्रस्तुत करना, जमा करना; समर्पण करना
hi_nuance: Double the t: 'submitted', 'submission'. 'Submit to' = give in to. Learners write 'submit the form to HR' correctly but say 'submitted' as 'sub-MIT-ed' with the wrong vowel.

examples.en: Please submit the report by Friday.
examples.hi: कृपया शुक्रवार तक रिपोर्ट जमा करें।

examples.en: I submitted a bug report through the portal.
examples.hi: मैंने पोर्टल के ज़रिए एक बग रिपोर्ट जमा की।

examples.en: The form was submitted twice by mistake.
examples.hi: फ़ॉर्म गलती से दो बार जमा हो गया।

examples.en: All changes must be submitted for review.
examples.hi: सभी बदलाव समीक्षा के लिए प्रस्तुत किए जाने चाहिए।

examples.en: He refused to submit to pressure from the client.
examples.hi: उसने ग्राहक के दबाव के आगे झुकने से इनकार कर दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: I have submited the form.
common_mistake.right: I have submitted the form.
common_mistake.why: The past participle doubles the t.

cloze.sentence: Researchers can ____ findings through the bug bounty portal.

en_def: large in amount or importance; solid
hi_nuance: Near-synonym of 'considerable'. 'Substantially' = to a large degree. Learners confuse with 'substantive' (dealing with real issues).

examples.en: The change required substantial testing.
examples.hi: बदलाव के लिए काफ़ी परीक्षण की आवश्यकता थी।

examples.en: We saw a substantial drop in spam after the filter.
examples.hi: फ़िल्टर के बाद हमने स्पैम में पर्याप्त गिरावट देखी।

examples.en: She made a substantial contribution to the project.
examples.hi: उसने परियोजना में महत्वपूर्ण योगदान दिया।

examples.en: The fine was substantial: two percent of revenue.
examples.hi: जुर्माना बड़ा था: राजस्व का दो प्रतिशत।

examples.en: A substantial number of users still use the old app.
examples.hi: उपयोगकर्ताओं की एक बड़ी संख्या अब भी पुराना ऐप इस्तेमाल करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The report is substantial (meaning: it deals with real issues).
common_mistake.right: The report is substantive.
common_mistake.why: 'Substantial' means large; 'substantive' means meaningful in content.

cloze.sentence: The migration brought a ____ improvement in uptime.

en_def: enough for a particular purpose
hi_nuance: Formal for 'enough'. 'Sufficient for' + noun; 'sufficient to' + verb. Learners write 'sufficient enough', which repeats the meaning.

examples.en: One reviewer is sufficient for a small change.
examples.hi: एक छोटे बदलाव के लिए एक समीक्षक पर्याप्त है।

examples.en: We did not have sufficient evidence to confirm the breach.
examples.hi: उल्लंघन की पुष्टि के लिए हमारे पास पर्याप्त साक्ष्य नहीं थे।

examples.en: Is the budget sufficient to cover training?
examples.hi: क्या बजट प्रशिक्षण को कवर करने के लिए पर्याप्त है?

examples.en: A password alone is no longer sufficient.
examples.hi: केवल पासवर्ड अब पर्याप्त नहीं है।

examples.en: Make sure the disk has sufficient space for logs.
examples.hi: सुनिश्चित करें कि डिस्क में लॉग के लिए पर्याप्त जगह हो।

common_mistake.wrong: The logging is sufficient enough.
common_mistake.right: The logging is sufficient.
common_mistake.why: 'Sufficient' already means 'enough'.

cloze.sentence: Two weeks is not ____ time to test a payment system.

en_def: to give the main points of something in a short form
hi_nuance: Stress on 'sum'. 'To summarize,' is a good closing phrase in a presentation. Learners say 'in short' or 'in a nutshell' in formal reports; use 'to summarize' or 'in summary'.

examples.en: Summarize the findings in three bullet points.
examples.hi: निष्कर्षों को तीन बिंदुओं में संक्षेप करें।

examples.en: To summarize, the risk is high but the fix is easy.
examples.hi: संक्षेप में, जोखिम ज़्यादा है पर समाधान आसान है।

examples.en: The executive summary summarizes the whole report.
examples.hi: कार्यकारी सारांश पूरी रिपोर्ट का सार देता है।

examples.en: Can you summarize what the client said?
examples.hi: क्या आप बता सकते हैं कि ग्राहक ने संक्षेप में क्या कहा?

examples.en: The tool summarizes long threads automatically.
examples.hi: यह टूल लंबे थ्रेड का सारांश अपने आप बनाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: In a nutshell, the server was compromised (in a formal report).
common_mistake.right: In summary, the server was compromised.
common_mistake.why: 'In a nutshell' is informal; use 'in summary' or 'to summarize' in reports.

cloze.sentence: ____ the impact in one sentence at the top of the report.

en_def: to keep something going over time; to suffer damage or injury
hi_nuance: Two meanings: 'sustain growth' (keep going) and 'sustain an injury' (suffer). 'Sustainable' = can continue long-term. Learners know only the environmental sense.

examples.en: We cannot sustain this pace for another month.
examples.hi: हम इस गति को एक और महीने तक बनाए नहीं रख सकते।

examples.en: The company sustained heavy losses after the breach.
examples.hi: उल्लंघन के बाद कंपनी को भारी नुकसान झेलना पड़ा।

examples.en: Daily practice sustains progress.
examples.hi: रोज़ का अभ्यास प्रगति को बनाए रखता है।

examples.en: The server sustained 5,000 requests per second without errors.
examples.hi: सर्वर ने बिना त्रुटि के प्रति सेकंड 5,000 अनुरोध संभाले।

examples.en: Two workers sustained minor injuries.
examples.hi: दो कर्मचारियों को मामूली चोटें आईं।

common_mistake.wrong: The team is not sustainable to work like this.
common_mistake.right: This way of working is not sustainable for the team.
common_mistake.why: 'Sustainable' describes a practice or pace, not a group of people.

cloze.sentence: Alert volume this high cannot be ____ by a two-person team.

en_def: to deal with a difficult problem; (in sport) to stop an opponent
hi_nuance: Natural verb for problems: 'tackle the backlog'. Learners say 'solve' (finish) where 'tackle' (begin to deal with) is meant. No preposition: 'tackle the issue', not 'tackle with'.

examples.en: Let's tackle the critical bugs first.
examples.hi: चलिए पहले गंभीर बग से निपटते हैं।

examples.en: The government is trying to tackle cybercrime.
examples.hi: सरकार साइबर अपराध से निपटने की कोशिश कर रही है।

examples.en: How should we tackle the alert fatigue problem?
examples.hi: हमें अलर्ट थकान की समस्या से कैसे निपटना चाहिए?

examples.en: She tackled the presentation with confidence.
examples.hi: उसने आत्मविश्वास के साथ प्रस्तुति का सामना किया।

examples.en: The defender tackled the striker just outside the box.
examples.hi: डिफ़ेंडर ने बॉक्स के ठीक बाहर स्ट्राइकर को रोक लिया।

common_mistake.wrong: We need to tackle with this problem.
common_mistake.right: We need to tackle this problem.
common_mistake.why: 'Tackle' takes a direct object; no 'with'.

cloze.sentence: We will ____ the technical debt after the release.

en_def: boring and taking a long time
hi_nuance: Describes tasks, not people. Learners say 'boring' for all; 'tedious' adds the idea of slow, repetitive effort.

examples.en: Manually reviewing 500 logs is tedious.
examples.hi: 500 लॉग की मैन्युअल समीक्षा थकाऊ है।

examples.en: Data entry is tedious but necessary.
examples.hi: डेटा एंट्री उबाऊ है, पर ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: The meeting was long and tedious.
examples.hi: बैठक लंबी और नीरस थी।

examples.en: Automate the tedious parts so you can focus on analysis.
examples.hi: थकाऊ हिस्सों को स्वचालित करें ताकि आप विश्लेषण पर ध्यान दे सकें।

examples.en: Filling in the same form ten times is tedious.
examples.hi: एक ही फ़ॉर्म दस बार भरना उबाऊ है।

common_mistake.wrong: My colleague is very tedious.
common_mistake.right: My colleague is very boring.
common_mistake.why: 'Tedious' describes tasks and processes, not people.

cloze.sentence: Rotating passwords by hand is ____; use a script.

en_def: not certain or fixed; done without confidence
hi_nuance: Indian English uses 'tentative' correctly for dates ('tentative date'). It also describes hesitant actions: 'a tentative smile'. Stress on 'ten'.

examples.en: The tentative launch date is 15 March.
examples.hi: लॉन्च की अस्थायी तारीख़ 15 मार्च है।

examples.en: We reached a tentative agreement with the vendor.
examples.hi: हम विक्रेता के साथ एक अस्थायी समझौते पर पहुँचे।

examples.en: She gave a tentative answer and promised to confirm.
examples.hi: उसने एक अनिश्चित जवाब दिया और पुष्टि करने का वादा किया।

examples.en: These are tentative conclusions based on early data.
examples.hi: ये शुरुआती डेटा पर आधारित अस्थायी निष्कर्ष हैं।

examples.en: He took a tentative step onto the ice.
examples.hi: उसने बर्फ़ पर संकोच के साथ एक कदम रखा।

common_mistake.wrong: The date is tentatively confirmed.
common_mistake.right: The date is tentative; we will confirm it next week.
common_mistake.why: 'Tentatively confirmed' contradicts itself.

cloze.sentence: Our ____ estimate is that 200 accounts were affected.

en_def: done carefully and completely, with attention to every detail
hi_nuance: Spelling trap: 'thorough' (careful), 'through' (from one side to the other), 'though' (however). Pronounce /ˈθɜːroʊ/ with a /θ/.

examples.en: The team did a thorough review of the code.
examples.hi: टीम ने कोड की गहन समीक्षा की।

examples.en: Be thorough: check every endpoint, not just the main ones.
examples.hi: पूरी सावधानी बरतें: हर एंडपॉइंट जाँचें, सिर्फ़ मुख्य नहीं।

examples.en: She is thorough and rarely misses a detail.
examples.hi: वह सावधान है और शायद ही कोई विवरण छोड़ती है।

examples.en: A thorough investigation took three weeks.
examples.hi: एक गहन जाँच में तीन हफ़्ते लगे।

examples.en: The cleaning was not thorough enough.
examples.hi: सफ़ाई पर्याप्त गहन नहीं थी।

common_mistake.wrong: We did a through check of the server.
common_mistake.right: We did a thorough check of the server.
common_mistake.why: 'Through' is a preposition; 'thorough' is the adjective meaning careful.

cloze.sentence: A ____ scan found issues the quick scan had missed.

en_def: to cause something to start happening; (noun) the thing that causes it
hi_def: शुरू करना, सक्रिय करना, कारण बनना; ट्रिगर
hi_nuance: Common in tech: 'trigger an alert', 'trigger a build'. Learners say 'fire' or 'start'; 'trigger' is precise for automatic reactions.

examples.en: Five failed logins trigger an alert.
examples.hi: पाँच असफल लॉगिन एक अलर्ट को सक्रिय करते हैं।

examples.en: The update triggered a wave of complaints.
examples.hi: अपडेट ने शिकायतों की लहर पैदा कर दी।

examples.en: What triggered the outage?
examples.hi: आउटेज की शुरुआत किस कारण हुई?

examples.en: Pushing to main triggers the deployment pipeline.
examples.hi: मेन पर पुश करने से डिप्लॉयमेंट पाइपलाइन शुरू हो जाती है।

examples.en: Stress is a common trigger for headaches.
examples.hi: तनाव सिरदर्द का एक आम कारण है।

common_mistake.wrong: The rule is fired when there are many logins.
common_mistake.right: The rule is triggered when there are many logins.
common_mistake.why: 'Fire' is fine in speech, but 'trigger' is clearer in written documentation.

cloze.sentence: Any change to the admin group should ____ a notification.

en_def: final or most important; the best or most extreme example
hi_nuance: 'Ultimately' = in the end. Marketing uses 'ultimate' to mean 'best' ('the ultimate guide'). Learners misuse 'ultimately' to mean 'finally' in a sequence; use 'finally' for the last step.

examples.en: The ultimate goal is zero critical findings.
examples.hi: अंतिम लक्ष्य शून्य गंभीर निष्कर्ष है।

examples.en: Ultimately, the CEO is responsible for security.
examples.hi: अंततः, सुरक्षा के लिए सीईओ ज़िम्मेदार है।

examples.en: The ultimate test of a backup is a real restore.
examples.hi: बैकअप की असली परीक्षा वास्तविक रीस्टोर है।

examples.en: He has ultimate authority over the budget.
examples.hi: बजट पर उसका सर्वोच्च अधिकार है।

examples.en: This is the ultimate guide to phishing defense.
examples.hi: यह फ़िशिंग से बचाव की सबसे संपूर्ण मार्गदर्शिका है।

common_mistake.wrong: First we scan, then we patch, and ultimately we retest.
common_mistake.right: First we scan, then we patch, and finally we retest.
common_mistake.why: 'Ultimately' means 'in the end, after everything'; for the last step in a list use 'finally'.

cloze.sentence: The ____ decision on paying the ransom rests with the board.

en_def: to experience something, especially a change, a test, or a medical treatment
hi_nuance: Irregular: undergo, underwent, undergone. Used for processes done to you: surgery, testing, training. Learners say 'go through' in speech; 'undergo' is formal.

examples.en: All new code must undergo security review.
examples.hi: सभी नए कोड को सुरक्षा समीक्षा से गुज़रना होगा।

examples.en: She underwent surgery last month.
examples.hi: पिछले महीने उसकी सर्जरी हुई।

examples.en: The system underwent major changes in 2024.
examples.hi: 2024 में सिस्टम में बड़े बदलाव हुए।

examples.en: Staff undergo training every six months.
examples.hi: कर्मचारी हर छह महीने में प्रशिक्षण लेते हैं।

examples.en: The bridge is undergoing repairs.
examples.hi: पुल की मरम्मत चल रही है।

common_mistake.wrong: The app undergoed a full audit.
common_mistake.right: The app underwent a full audit.
common_mistake.why: 'Undergo' is irregular: the past tense is 'underwent'.

cloze.sentence: Every vendor must ____ a security assessment before onboarding.

en_def: real but not immediately obvious; forming the base of something
hi_nuance: 'Underlying cause' = root cause. Learners say 'the hidden reason' or 'root reason'; 'underlying cause' and 'root cause' are the standard phrases.

examples.en: The underlying cause was a misconfigured load balancer.
examples.hi: मूल कारण एक गलत कॉन्फ़िगर किया गया लोड बैलेंसर था।

examples.en: Treat the underlying problem, not just the symptom.
examples.hi: सिर्फ़ लक्षण नहीं, अंतर्निहित समस्या का इलाज करें।

examples.en: The app runs on an underlying Linux system.
examples.hi: ऐप एक अंतर्निहित लिनक्स सिस्टम पर चलता है।

examples.en: There is an underlying tension between the two teams.
examples.hi: दोनों टीमों के बीच एक छिपा हुआ तनाव है।

examples.en: The underlying principle is simple: trust nothing.
examples.hi: मूल सिद्धांत सरल है: किसी पर भरोसा न करें।

common_mistake.wrong: We fixed the symptom but the underlying is still there.
common_mistake.right: We fixed the symptom but the underlying problem is still there.
common_mistake.why: 'Underlying' is an adjective and needs a noun.

cloze.sentence: Restarting the server hides the ____ memory leak.

en_def: to start and take responsibility for a task; to promise to do something
hi_def: ज़िम्मा लेना, शुरू करना, वचन देना
hi_nuance: Irregular: undertake, undertook, undertaken. An 'undertaking' is a big task or a formal promise. Do not confuse with 'undertaker' (funeral director).

examples.en: We undertook a full review of access rights.
examples.hi: हमने एक्सेस अधिकारों की पूरी समीक्षा का ज़िम्मा लिया।

examples.en: The vendor undertook to fix the bug within 30 days.
examples.hi: विक्रेता ने 30 दिनों के भीतर बग ठीक करने का वचन दिया।

examples.en: Migrating the database is a major undertaking.
examples.hi: डेटाबेस माइग्रेट करना एक बड़ा काम है।

examples.en: She undertook the project despite the tight deadline.
examples.hi: कम समय-सीमा के बावजूद उसने परियोजना का ज़िम्मा लिया।

examples.en: No testing should be undertaken without written consent.
examples.hi: बिना लिखित सहमति के कोई परीक्षण नहीं किया जाना चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: We undertaked a survey of all staff.
common_mistake.right: We undertook a survey of all staff.
common_mistake.why: 'Undertake' is irregular; the past is 'undertook'.

cloze.sentence: The team will ____ a risk assessment of every third-party app.

en_def: never having happened or existed before
hi_nuance: Stress on 'pres'. Strong word; overused in news. Use it only when something truly never happened before.

examples.en: The attack was unprecedented in scale.
examples.hi: यह हमला पैमाने में अभूतपूर्व था।

examples.en: We saw unprecedented traffic during the event.
examples.hi: आयोजन के दौरान हमने अभूतपूर्व ट्रैफ़िक देखा।

examples.en: The court made an unprecedented decision.
examples.hi: अदालत ने एक अभूतपूर्व फ़ैसला सुनाया।

examples.en: This level of cooperation between rivals is unprecedented.
examples.hi: प्रतिद्वंद्वियों के बीच इस स्तर का सहयोग अभूतपूर्व है।

examples.en: The company grew at an unprecedented rate.
examples.hi: कंपनी अभूतपूर्व दर से बढ़ी।

common_mistake.wrong: We had an unprecedented outage (the third this month).
common_mistake.right: We had another outage, the third this month.
common_mistake.why: If it has happened before, it is not unprecedented.

cloze.sentence: The breach exposed an ____ number of records.

en_def: to use something, especially in an effective or practical way
hi_nuance: Indian English overuses 'utilize' where 'use' is better. Native writers prefer 'use'; keep 'utilize' for making practical use of a resource that was not designed for it.

examples.en: We utilized spare servers as a test environment.
examples.hi: हमने अतिरिक्त सर्वरों को परीक्षण वातावरण के रूप में काम में लिया।

examples.en: The attacker utilized a built-in Windows tool to move laterally.
examples.hi: हमलावर ने आगे बढ़ने के लिए विंडोज़ के एक अंतर्निहित टूल का उपयोग किया।

examples.en: The team is not fully utilized this month.
examples.hi: इस महीने टीम का पूरा उपयोग नहीं हो रहा है।

examples.en: Utilize the free tier before paying for a plan.
examples.hi: किसी योजना के लिए भुगतान करने से पहले मुफ़्त स्तर का उपयोग करें।

examples.en: Only 40% of the storage is utilized.
examples.hi: केवल 40% स्टोरेज का उपयोग हो रहा है।

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly utilize the new form for leave requests.
common_mistake.right: Please use the new form for leave requests.
common_mistake.why: 'Use' is simpler and preferred; 'utilize' sounds pompous here.

cloze.sentence: Attackers often ____ legitimate admin tools to avoid detection.

en_def: legally or officially acceptable; based on good reasoning
hi_nuance: 'Valid' (acceptable now) vs 'legitimate' (allowed, real). A ticket is 'valid until'; an argument is 'valid'. Pronounce /ˈvælɪd/, not 'va-LEED'.

examples.en: Your session token is no longer valid.
examples.hi: आपका सेशन टोकन अब मान्य नहीं है।

examples.en: The certificate is valid until December.
examples.hi: प्रमाणपत्र दिसंबर तक वैध है।

examples.en: That is a valid point; let's add it to the report.
examples.hi: यह एक तर्कसंगत बात है; इसे रिपोर्ट में जोड़ते हैं।

examples.en: Is this a valid email address?
examples.hi: क्या यह एक मान्य ईमेल पता है?

examples.en: The test results are not valid because the sample was too small.
examples.hi: नमूना बहुत छोटा होने के कारण परीक्षण के नतीजे मान्य नहीं हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: My passport is valid till up to 2030.
common_mistake.right: My passport is valid until 2030.
common_mistake.why: 'Till up to' doubles the preposition; use 'until' or 'till'.

cloze.sentence: The app must reject any request without a ____ token.

en_def: to be different in different situations; to change something
hi_nuance: 'Vary from X to Y', 'vary depending on'. 'Various' = several different. Spelling: 'varies', 'varied'. Learners confuse 'vary' with 'very' in speech; the vowel is longer in 'vary'.

examples.en: Response times vary depending on the region.
examples.hi: प्रतिक्रिया समय क्षेत्र के अनुसार भिन्न होता है।

examples.en: Prices vary from 500 to 2,000 rupees.
examples.hi: कीमतें 500 से 2,000 रुपये तक भिन्न होती हैं।

examples.en: Vary your practice: reading, listening, and speaking.
examples.hi: अपने अभ्यास में विविधता लाएँ: पढ़ना, सुनना और बोलना।

examples.en: The severity varies with the type of data exposed.
examples.hi: गंभीरता उजागर हुए डेटा के प्रकार के साथ बदलती है।

examples.en: Opinions vary on whether to pay the ransom.
examples.hi: फिरौती देने पर राय अलग-अलग है।

common_mistake.wrong: The results are varying from day to day.
common_mistake.right: The results vary from day to day.
common_mistake.why: For a general truth, use the simple present.

cloze.sentence: Patch timelines ____ from days to months across vendors.

en_def: not clear or detailed; not expressed precisely
hi_nuance: Pronounce /veɪɡ/ with a hard g, rhyming with 'plague'. Learners say 'vay-gyoo'. 'Vague about' = not giving details.

examples.en: The bug report is too vague to act on.
examples.hi: बग रिपोर्ट इतनी अस्पष्ट है कि उस पर कार्रवाई नहीं हो सकती।

examples.en: He gave a vague answer about the timeline.
examples.hi: उसने समय-सीमा के बारे में अस्पष्ट जवाब दिया।

examples.en: I have only a vague memory of the meeting.
examples.hi: मुझे बैठक की केवल धुँधली याद है।

examples.en: The requirements are vague; ask the client for specifics.
examples.hi: आवश्यकताएँ अस्पष्ट हैं; ग्राहक से विशिष्ट विवरण माँगें।

examples.en: She was vague about where she had been.
examples.hi: वह इस बारे में अस्पष्ट थी कि वह कहाँ गई थी।

common_mistake.wrong: Please don't be vague; give me a clear cut answer.
common_mistake.right: Please don't be vague; give me a clear answer.
common_mistake.why: 'Clear-cut' is a set phrase, but 'clear' alone is enough and more natural here.

cloze.sentence: 'It sometimes breaks' is too ____ for a bug report.

en_def: able to work successfully; practical and realistic
hi_def: व्यवहार्य, कारगर, सफल हो सकने योग्ग
hi_nuance: 'Viable' = can succeed; 'feasible' = can be done. A plan can be feasible but not viable if it costs too much. 'Minimum viable product' (MVP) is a common tech phrase.

examples.en: Is the new tool a viable replacement for the old one?
examples.hi: क्या नया टूल पुराने का व्यवहार्य विकल्प है?

examples.en: Without funding, the project is not viable.
examples.hi: धन के बिना यह परियोजना व्यवहार्य नहीं है।

examples.en: We shipped a minimum viable product in six weeks.
examples.hi: हमने छह हफ़्तों में एक न्यूनतम व्यवहार्य उत्पाद शिप किया।

examples.en: A paper backup is not a viable long-term solution.
examples.hi: काग़ज़ी बैकअप कोई व्यवहार्य दीर्घकालिक समाधान नहीं है।

examples.en: The exploit is viable only on unpatched systems.
examples.hi: यह एक्सप्लॉइट केवल बिना पैच वाले सिस्टम पर कारगर है।

common_mistake.wrong: Rewriting in Rust is viable but not feasible this quarter (reversed).
common_mistake.right: Rewriting in Rust is feasible but not viable this quarter.
common_mistake.why: 'Feasible' = can be done; 'viable' = worth doing / will succeed.

cloze.sentence: Passkeys are now a ____ alternative to passwords for most users.

en_def: able to be seen; noticeable
hi_nuance: 'Visible to' someone. 'Visibility' in security means the ability to see what happens on the network. Learners say 'visible for'.

examples.en: The admin panel was visible to anyone on the internet.
examples.hi: एडमिन पैनल इंटरनेट पर किसी को भी दिखाई दे रहा था।

examples.en: There is a visible improvement in her fluency.
examples.hi: उसकी प्रवाहशीलता में स्पष्ट सुधार है।

examples.en: Make the error message visible on the page.
examples.hi: त्रुटि संदेश को पेज पर दिखाई देने योग्य बनाएँ।

examples.en: The mountains are visible on a clear day.
examples.hi: साफ़ दिन में पहाड़ दिखाई देते हैं।

examples.en: We have no visibility into what the contractors do.
examples.hi: ठेकेदार क्या करते हैं, इसकी हमें कोई जानकारी नहीं दिखती।

common_mistake.wrong: The password is visible for everyone in the log.
common_mistake.right: The password is visible to everyone in the log.
common_mistake.why: 'Visible' takes 'to'.

cloze.sentence: Internal hostnames should never be ____ in public error pages.

en_def: existing or happening in many places or among many people
hi_nuance: One word. Describes problems, beliefs, and use: 'widespread outage', 'widespread belief'. Learners write 'wide spread' or use 'common' where 'widespread' fits.

examples.en: The outage was widespread, affecting all regions.
examples.hi: आउटेज व्यापक था, जिसने सभी क्षेत्रों को प्रभावित किया।

examples.en: There is widespread concern about data privacy.
examples.hi: डेटा निजता को लेकर व्यापक चिंता है।

examples.en: Password reuse is widespread among employees.
examples.hi: कर्मचारियों में पासवर्ड का दोबारा उपयोग व्यापक है।

examples.en: The vulnerability is widespread because the library is popular.
examples.hi: लाइब्रेरी लोकप्रिय होने के कारण यह भेद्यता व्यापक है।

examples.en: The practice is widespread but rarely discussed.
examples.hi: यह चलन व्यापक है, पर इस पर शायद ही चर्चा होती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The bug is wide spread across the fleet.
common_mistake.right: The bug is widespread across the fleet.
common_mistake.why: 'Widespread' is one word.

cloze.sentence: The flaw affects a ____ library used by thousands of sites.

en_def: to take money out; to remove or take back; to leave a place or activity
hi_nuance: Irregular: withdraw, withdrew, withdrawn. 'Withdraw from' a competition; 'withdraw' an offer. Learners say 'take back' for offers; 'withdraw' is the formal verb.

examples.en: I withdrew cash from the ATM.
examples.hi: मैंने एटीएम से नकद निकाला।

examples.en: The vendor withdrew the faulty update.
examples.hi: विक्रेता ने खराब अपडेट वापस ले लिया।

examples.en: She withdrew from the project for health reasons.
examples.hi: स्वास्थ्य कारणों से वह परियोजना से हट गई।

examples.en: The company withdrew its offer after the background check.
examples.hi: पृष्ठभूमि जाँच के बाद कंपनी ने अपना प्रस्ताव वापस ले लिया।

examples.en: Users can withdraw consent at any time.
examples.hi: उपयोगकर्ता किसी भी समय सहमति वापस ले सकते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: They withdrawed the product from the market.
common_mistake.right: They withdrew the product from the market.
common_mistake.why: 'Withdraw' is irregular; the past is 'withdrew'.

cloze.sentence: The researcher agreed to ____ the blog post until the patch shipped.

en_def: the amount of work a person or machine has to do
hi_nuance: One word, usually singular. 'Heavy workload'. In cloud computing, a 'workload' is an application running on infrastructure. Learners say 'work pressure' for a heavy workload.

examples.en: My workload has doubled since the merger.
examples.hi: विलय के बाद से मेरा कार्यभार दोगुना हो गया है।

examples.en: Spread the workload evenly across the team.
examples.hi: कार्यभार को टीम में समान रूप से बाँटें।

examples.en: Each cloud workload needs its own firewall rules.
examples.hi: हर क्लाउड वर्कलोड को अपने फ़ायरवॉल नियम चाहिए।

examples.en: A heavy workload leads to rushed reviews.
examples.hi: भारी कार्यभार से जल्दबाज़ी में समीक्षाएँ होती हैं।

examples.en: Talk to your manager if the workload is unmanageable.
examples.hi: अगर कार्यभार असहनीय हो तो अपने मैनेजर से बात करें।

common_mistake.wrong: I have too much work pressure these days.
common_mistake.right: I have a heavy workload these days.
common_mistake.why: 'Work pressure' is Indian English; 'heavy workload' or 'a lot of pressure at work' is natural.

cloze.sentence: Automation cut the analyst ____ by a third.

en_def: an experienced person who advises and guides a less experienced one; (verb) to guide someone in this way
hi_nuance: A mentor guides your career over time; a 'coach' trains specific skills; a 'guide' shows the way. The person being mentored is a 'mentee'.

examples.en: My mentor helped me plan my move into security.
examples.hi: मेरे मार्गदर्शक ने सुरक्षा क्षेत्र में जाने की योजना बनाने में मदद की।

examples.en: Senior engineers mentor new hires for six months.
examples.hi: वरिष्ठ इंजीनियर नए कर्मचारियों का छह महीने मार्गदर्शन करते हैं।

examples.en: Find a mentor who gives honest feedback.
examples.hi: ऐसा मार्गदर्शक ढूँढें जो ईमानदार प्रतिक्रिया दे।

examples.en: She has mentored several people into leadership roles.
examples.hi: उसने कई लोगों को नेतृत्व की भूमिकाओं तक पहुँचने में मार्गदर्शन दिया है।

examples.en: The program pairs each mentee with a mentor.
examples.hi: यह कार्यक्रम हर शिष्य को एक मार्गदर्शक से जोड़ता है।

common_mistake.wrong: He is my guide in the company.
common_mistake.right: He is my mentor in the company.
common_mistake.why: For a career adviser, 'mentor' is the standard word; 'guide' suggests a tour guide.

cloze.sentence: A good ____ asks questions instead of giving answers.

en_def: to pay another company to do work instead of doing it yourself
hi_def: बाहरी कंपनी से काम कराना, आउटसोर्स करना
hi_nuance: 'Outsource X to Y'. 'Offshore' means moving work abroad; 'outsource' means using another company, which may be local. Learners use them as synonyms.

examples.en: We outsource penetration testing to a specialist firm.
examples.hi: हम पेनिट्रेशन टेस्टिंग एक विशेषज्ञ फ़र्म से कराते हैं।

examples.en: The company outsourced customer support in 2020.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने 2020 में ग्राहक सहायता आउटसोर्स कर दी।

examples.en: Outsourcing saves money but adds risk.
examples.hi: आउटसोर्सिंग पैसा बचाती है, पर जोखिम बढ़ाती है।

examples.en: You can outsource the work, but not the responsibility.
examples.hi: आप काम आउटसोर्स कर सकते हैं, ज़िम्मेदारी नहीं।

examples.en: Payroll is outsourced to a vendor in Pune.
examples.hi: पेरोल पुणे के एक विक्रेता को आउटसोर्स किया गया है।

common_mistake.wrong: We offshored the SOC to a company in the same city.
common_mistake.right: We outsourced the SOC to a company in the same city.
common_mistake.why: 'Offshore' means abroad; a local vendor is 'outsourced'.

cloze.sentence: Many small firms ____ their security monitoring to an MSSP.

en_def: an important stage or event in the progress of a project or a life
hi_nuance: 'Reach/hit a milestone'. Project plans list milestones with dates. Learners say 'landmark' which is a physical place, or 'target' which is a number.

examples.en: Passing the audit was a major milestone for the team.
examples.hi: ऑडिट पास करना टीम के लिए एक बड़ा पड़ाव था।

examples.en: The next milestone is the beta release in May.
examples.hi: अगला मील का पत्थर मई में बीटा रिलीज़ है।

examples.en: We hit the 1,000-word milestone today.
examples.hi: आज हमने 1,000 शब्दों का पड़ाव पार किया।

examples.en: List the milestones and their deadlines in the plan.
examples.hi: योजना में मील के पत्थर और उनकी समय-सीमाएँ सूचीबद्ध करें।

examples.en: Her first conference talk was a personal milestone.
examples.hi: उसकी पहली सम्मेलन वार्ता एक व्यक्तिगत उपलब्धि थी।

common_mistake.wrong: Launching the app was a landmark for us.
common_mistake.right: Launching the app was a milestone for us.
common_mistake.why: 'Landmark' is a physical feature or a historic event; project stages are 'milestones'.

cloze.sentence: Full MFA coverage is the first ____ in the security roadmap.

en_def: to gradually collect or increase over time
hi_def: जमा होना, इकट्ठा होना, संचित करना
hi_nuance: Both transitive (accumulate wealth) and intransitive (dust accumulates). 'Technical debt accumulates' is a common tech phrase. Learners say 'collect' where slow build-up is meant.

examples.en: Unpatched systems accumulate risk over time.
examples.hi: समय के साथ बिना पैच वाले सिस्टम में जोखिम जमा होता जाता है।

examples.en: Logs accumulate quickly and fill the disk.
examples.hi: लॉग तेज़ी से जमा होते हैं और डिस्क भर देते हैं।

examples.en: She has accumulated ten years of experience.
examples.hi: उसने दस साल का अनुभव अर्जित किया है।

examples.en: Technical debt accumulated during the rush to launch.
examples.hi: लॉन्च की जल्दबाज़ी में तकनीकी ऋण जमा हो गया।

examples.en: Dust had accumulated on the old servers.
examples.hi: पुराने सर्वरों पर धूल जम गई थी।

common_mistake.wrong: Errors are accumulating up in the queue.
common_mistake.right: Errors are accumulating in the queue.
common_mistake.why: 'Accumulate' already means build up; no 'up'.

cloze.sentence: Small shortcuts ____ into serious security debt.

en_def: to make a process simpler and more efficient
hi_def: सरल और कुशल बनाना, सुव्यवस्थित करना
hi_nuance: Positive business verb. 'Streamline the process' = remove unnecessary steps. Learners say 'make it smooth' or 'simplify'; 'streamline' also implies speed.

examples.en: We streamlined the approval process from five steps to two.
examples.hi: हमने स्वीकृति प्रक्रिया को पाँच चरणों से घटाकर दो कर दिया।

examples.en: The new tool streamlines incident reporting.
examples.hi: नया टूल घटना रिपोर्टिंग को सुव्यवस्थित करता है।

examples.en: Streamlining onboarding saved each new hire a full day.
examples.hi: ऑनबोर्डिंग को सुव्यवस्थित करने से हर नए कर्मचारी का पूरा दिन बचा।

examples.en: The company plans to streamline its product line.
examples.hi: कंपनी अपनी उत्पाद शृंखला को सुव्यवस्थित करने की योजना बना रही है।

examples.en: A streamlined checkout increases sales.
examples.hi: एक सुव्यवस्थित चेकआउट बिक्री बढ़ाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: We need to make the process smooth and streamline.
common_mistake.right: We need to streamline the process.
common_mistake.why: 'Streamline' is a verb; use it directly.

cloze.sentence: Single sign-on helps ____ access management.

en_def: to give a share of money, time, or resources to a particular purpose
hi_nuance: 'Allocate X to Y' or 'allocate Y X'. Stress on 'al'. In programming, 'allocate memory'. Learners say 'allot', which is fine but rarer.

examples.en: We allocated two engineers to the incident.
examples.hi: हमने घटना के लिए दो इंजीनियर नियुक्त किए।

examples.en: Allocate at least an hour a day to practice.
examples.hi: अभ्यास के लिए रोज़ कम से कम एक घंटा निर्धारित करें।

examples.en: The budget allocated to security doubled this year.
examples.hi: इस साल सुरक्षा के लिए आवंटित बजट दोगुना हो गया।

examples.en: The program failed to allocate enough memory.
examples.hi: प्रोग्राम पर्याप्त मेमोरी आवंटित नहीं कर सका।

examples.en: Resources should be allocated based on risk.
examples.hi: संसाधनों का आवंटन जोखिम के आधार पर होना चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: We allocated for two hours on testing.
common_mistake.right: We allocated two hours to testing.
common_mistake.why: 'Allocate' takes the resource as its direct object and 'to' for the purpose.

cloze.sentence: ____ a fixed budget for bug bounty rewards each quarter.

en_def: to produce many ideas quickly in a group, without judging them at first
hi_def: विचार-मंथन करना, सामूहिक रूप से विचार सुझाना
hi_nuance: Verb and noun. 'Brainstorm ideas' or 'have a brainstorm'. Learners say 'do brainstorming session'; say 'hold a brainstorming session' or just 'brainstorm'.

examples.en: Let's brainstorm ways to reduce false positives.
examples.hi: चलिए झूठे अलर्ट कम करने के तरीकों पर विचार-मंथन करते हैं।

examples.en: The team brainstormed for an hour and picked three ideas.
examples.hi: टीम ने एक घंटे विचार-मंथन किया और तीन विचार चुने।

examples.en: During a brainstorm, no idea is a bad idea.
examples.hi: विचार-मंथन के दौरान कोई विचार बुरा नहीं होता।

examples.en: We brainstormed possible attack paths on a whiteboard.
examples.hi: हमने व्हाइटबोर्ड पर संभावित हमले के रास्तों पर विचार-मंथन किया।

examples.en: Brainstorm first, then evaluate.
examples.hi: पहले विचार सुझाएँ, फिर मूल्यांकन करें।

common_mistake.wrong: Let us do brainstorming on this topic.
common_mistake.right: Let's brainstorm this topic.
common_mistake.why: Use the verb directly instead of 'do brainstorming on'.

cloze.sentence: Before the tabletop exercise, ____ the scenarios most likely to hit us.

en_def: an agreement where each side gives up something; (verb) to weaken or expose something to danger
hi_def: समझौता; (सुरक्षा) भंग करना, ख़तरे में डालना
hi_nuance: Two very different meanings. In security, 'compromised' = breached or taken over. In negotiation, 'reach a compromise' = meet in the middle. Learners know only the first sense.

examples.en: The account was compromised through a phishing link.
examples.hi: फ़िशिंग लिंक के ज़रिए खाता भंग कर दिया गया।

examples.en: We reached a compromise on the launch date.
examples.hi: हम लॉन्च की तारीख़ पर एक समझौते पर पहुँचे।

examples.en: Do not compromise on security to save time.
examples.hi: समय बचाने के लिए सुरक्षा से समझौता न करें।

examples.en: Assume the server is compromised and rebuild it.
examples.hi: मान लें कि सर्वर भंग हो चुका है और उसे फिर से बनाएँ।

examples.en: Speed without testing compromises quality.
examples.hi: बिना परीक्षण के गति गुणवत्ता को कमज़ोर करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The hacker compromised with our server.
common_mistake.right: The hacker compromised our server.
common_mistake.why: In the security sense, 'compromise' takes a direct object.

cloze.sentence: Rotate every key that the ____ machine could access.

en_def: general agreement among a group of people
hi_nuance: Uncountable. 'Reach a consensus', 'the consensus is that'. Do not write 'general consensus' (redundant) or 'consensus of opinion'. Spelling: 'consensus', not 'concensus'.

examples.en: The consensus is that we should patch tonight.
examples.hi: आम सहमति यह है कि हमें आज रात पैच करना चाहिए।

examples.en: After two hours we reached a consensus.
examples.hi: दो घंटे बाद हम आम सहमति पर पहुँचे।

examples.en: There is no consensus on the best password policy.
examples.hi: सबसे अच्छी पासवर्ड नीति पर कोई आम सहमति नहीं है।

examples.en: Decisions are made by consensus, not by vote.
examples.hi: निर्णय मतदान से नहीं, आम सहमति से लिए जाते हैं।

examples.en: Scientific consensus supports the finding.
examples.hi: वैज्ञानिक सर्वसम्मति इस निष्कर्ष का समर्थन करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The general consensus of opinion is to delay.
common_mistake.right: The consensus is to delay.
common_mistake.why: 'General' and 'of opinion' repeat what 'consensus' already means.

cloze.sentence: The team could not reach a ____ on the severity rating.

en_def: a new plan to solve a problem; the ability to act without being told
hi_def: पहल, नई योजना; स्वयं कार्य करने की क्षमता
hi_nuance: 'Take the initiative' = act first. 'Show initiative' = act without instructions. 'An initiative' = a program. Pronounce /ɪˈnɪʃətɪv/ with 'sh'.

examples.en: She took the initiative and wrote the runbook herself.
examples.hi: उसने पहल की और खुद रनबुक लिख डाली।

examples.en: The company launched a security awareness initiative.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने एक सुरक्षा जागरूकता पहल शुरू की।

examples.en: We want people who show initiative.
examples.hi: हम ऐसे लोग चाहते हैं जो पहल दिखाएँ।

examples.en: The initiative failed because nobody owned it.
examples.hi: यह पहल विफल रही क्योंकि किसी ने इसकी ज़िम्मेदारी नहीं ली।

examples.en: On his own initiative, he set up alerts for the admin group.
examples.hi: अपनी पहल पर उसने एडमिन समूह के लिए अलर्ट सेट किए।

common_mistake.wrong: He always takes initiatives without asking.
common_mistake.right: He always takes the initiative without asking.
common_mistake.why: The fixed phrase is 'take the initiative' (singular, with 'the').

cloze.sentence: Good engineers take the ____ to fix small problems before they grow.

en_def: to work with and exchange information with another person or group
hi_def: संपर्क और तालमेल रखना, समन्वय में काम करना
hi_nuance: Pronounce 'lee-AYZ'. Always 'liaise with'. Common in British business English; Americans say 'coordinate with'. The noun is 'liaison' (a contact person).

examples.en: I liaise with the legal team on every disclosure.
examples.hi: मैं हर खुलासे पर कानूनी टीम के साथ तालमेल रखता हूँ।

examples.en: She will liaise between the vendor and our engineers.
examples.hi: वह विक्रेता और हमारे इंजीनियरों के बीच संपर्क का काम करेगी।

examples.en: Please liaise with HR about the training dates.
examples.hi: कृपया प्रशिक्षण की तारीख़ों के बारे में एचआर से तालमेल रखें।

examples.en: He acts as the security liaison for the sales team.
examples.hi: वह बिक्री टीम के लिए सुरक्षा संपर्क व्यक्ति के रूप में काम करता है।

examples.en: We liaised closely with the police during the incident.
examples.hi: घटना के दौरान हमने पुलिस के साथ नज़दीकी तालमेल रखा।

common_mistake.wrong: I will liaise the client about the report.
common_mistake.right: I will liaise with the client about the report.
common_mistake.why: 'Liaise' always takes 'with'.

cloze.sentence: The incident manager will ____ with PR on the public statement.

en_def: to be too much for someone to handle; to defeat completely by force or number
hi_def: अभिभूत करना, हावी होना, दबा देना
hi_nuance: Often passive: 'be overwhelmed by/with'. 'Overwhelmed with work' = too much work; 'overwhelmed by kindness' = deeply moved. Learners say 'overloaded' for feelings, which sounds mechanical.

examples.en: The team was overwhelmed by the number of alerts.
examples.hi: टीम अलर्ट की संख्या से अभिभूत हो गई।

examples.en: A flood of requests overwhelmed the server.
examples.hi: अनुरोधों की बाढ़ ने सर्वर को दबा दिया।

examples.en: Do not overwhelm new learners with too many rules.
examples.hi: नए सीखने वालों पर बहुत ज़्यादा नियम न थोपें।

examples.en: She was overwhelmed with support after the talk.
examples.hi: वार्ता के बाद मिले समर्थन से वह अभिभूत थी।

examples.en: The evidence against him was overwhelming.
examples.hi: उसके ख़िलाफ़ सबूत ज़बरदस्त थे।

common_mistake.wrong: I am overwhelmed of work this week.
common_mistake.right: I am overwhelmed with work this week.
common_mistake.why: 'Overwhelmed' takes 'with' (work) or 'by' (a force).

cloze.sentence: A DDoS attack tries to ____ a server with traffic.
